--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/src/WaylandSurfaceRenderer.cpp ---
#include "WaylandSurfaceRenderer.h"

#include <iostream>
#include <ctime>
#include <cmath>

// Load glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES at runtime via eglGetProcAddress.
// The function may not be exported directly by libGLESv2.so on all Mesa builds,
// but is always available via the EGL proc-address mechanism.
static PFNGLEGLIMAGETARGETTEXTURE2DOESPROC s_glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES = nullptr;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Shader sources
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
namespace {

// Standard vertex shader shared by all programs
const char *VERTEX_SHADER_SRC = R"(
    attribute vec2 a_pos;
    attribute vec2 a_texcoord;
    varying vec2 v_texcoord;
    uniform mat4 u_proj;

    void main() {
        gl_Position = u_proj * vec4(a_pos, 0.0, 1.0);
        v_texcoord = a_texcoord;
    }
)";

// Standard sampler2D fragment shader (CPU-upload textures, GL_TEXTURE_2D)
const char *FRAGMENT_SHADER_2D_SRC = R"(
    precision mediump float;
    varying vec2 v_texcoord;
    uniform sampler2D u_texture;

    void main() {
        gl_FragColor = texture2D(u_texture, v_texcoord);
    }
)";

// GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES shader — required for EGLImageKHR import and
// for DMA-BUF textures created directly in wlroots' context.
const char *FRAGMENT_SHADER_EXTERNAL_SRC = R"(
    #extension GL_OES_EGL_image_external : require
    precision mediump float;
    varying vec2 v_texcoord;
    uniform samplerExternalOES u_texture;

    void main() {
        gl_FragColor = texture2D(u_texture, v_texcoord);
    }
)";

} // namespace

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Construction / destruction
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

WaylandSurfaceRenderer::WaylandSurfaceRenderer() = default;

WaylandSurfaceRenderer::~WaylandSurfaceRenderer() {
    if (m_program2D)         glDeleteProgram(m_program2D);
    if (m_programExternalOES) glDeleteProgram(m_programExternalOES);
    if (m_vbo)   glDeleteBuffers(1, &m_vbo);
    if (m_cpuTex) glDeleteTextures(1, &m_cpuTex);
    if (m_oesTex) glDeleteTextures(1, &m_oesTex);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Shader helpers
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

GLuint WaylandSurfaceRenderer::createProgram(const char *vertSrc, const char *fragSrc) {
    auto compileShader = [](GLenum type, const char *src) -> GLuint {
        GLuint shader = glCreateShader(type);
        glShaderSource(shader, 1, &src, nullptr);
        glCompileShader(shader);

        GLint compiled = 0;
        glGetShaderiv(shader, GL_COMPILE_STATUS, &compiled);
        if (!compiled) {
            GLint infoLen = 0;
            glGetShaderiv(shader, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &infoLen);
            if (infoLen > 0) {
                std::string log(infoLen, '\0');
                glGetShaderInfoLog(shader, infoLen, nullptr, log.data());
                std::cerr << "[Renderer] Shader compilation error: " << log << std::endl;
            }
            glDeleteShader(shader);
            return 0;
        }
        return shader;
    };

    GLuint vert = compileShader(GL_VERTEX_SHADER, vertSrc);
    if (!vert) return 0;

    GLuint frag = compileShader(GL_FRAGMENT_SHADER, fragSrc);
    if (!frag) { glDeleteShader(vert); return 0; }

    GLuint program = glCreateProgram();
    glAttachShader(program, vert);
    glAttachShader(program, frag);
    glBindAttribLocation(program, 0, "a_pos");
    glBindAttribLocation(program, 1, "a_texcoord");
    glLinkProgram(program);
    glDeleteShader(vert);
    glDeleteShader(frag);

    GLint linked = 0;
    glGetProgramiv(program, GL_LINK_STATUS, &linked);
    if (!linked) {
        GLint infoLen = 0;
        glGetProgramiv(program, GL_INFO_LOG_LENGTH, &infoLen);
        if (infoLen > 0) {
            std::string log(infoLen, '\0');
            glGetProgramInfoLog(program, infoLen, nullptr, log.data());
            std::cerr << "[Renderer] Program link error: " << log << std::endl;
        }
        glDeleteProgram(program);
        return 0;
    }
    return program;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Initialize (call inside Qt's initializeGL)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool WaylandSurfaceRenderer::initialize() {
    if (m_initialized) return true;

    // 1. GL_TEXTURE_2D sampler (CPU-upload & readback textures)
    m_program2D = createProgram(VERTEX_SHADER_SRC, FRAGMENT_SHADER_2D_SRC);
    if (!m_program2D) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] Error: Failed to compile 2D shader program." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }
    m_uProj2D = glGetUniformLocation(m_program2D, "u_proj");
    m_uTex2D  = glGetUniformLocation(m_program2D, "u_texture");

    // 2. samplerExternalOES (EGLImageKHR cross-context import and DMA-BUF)
    m_programExternalOES = createProgram(VERTEX_SHADER_SRC, FRAGMENT_SHADER_EXTERNAL_SRC);
    if (!m_programExternalOES) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] Warning: GL_OES_EGL_image_external unavailable; "
                     "falling back to 2D sampler." << std::endl;
    } else {
        m_uProjExternal = glGetUniformLocation(m_programExternalOES, "u_proj");
        m_uTexExternal  = glGetUniformLocation(m_programExternalOES, "u_texture");
    }

    // 3. Dynamic VBO for quad geometry
    glGenBuffers(1, &m_vbo);

    // 4. Persistent CPU-upload texture (avoid per-frame allocation)
    glGenTextures(1, &m_cpuTex);

    // 5. Persistent OES texture for EGLImageKHR import
    glGenTextures(1, &m_oesTex);

    // 6. Load OES EGL image extension function pointer at runtime
    s_glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES =
        reinterpret_cast<PFNGLEGLIMAGETARGETTEXTURE2DOESPROC>(
            eglGetProcAddress("glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES"));
    if (!s_glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] Warning: glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES unavailable — "
                     "EGLImageKHR import path disabled; will use CPU readback." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "[Renderer] glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES loaded successfully." << std::endl;
    }

    m_initialized = true;
    std::cout << "[Renderer] Wayland Surface GLES2 Renderer initialized successfully." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Ortho projection matrix
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void WaylandSurfaceRenderer::setupOrthoMatrix(float left, float right, float bottom, float top,
                                              std::array<float, 16> &out) {
    out.fill(0.0f);
    out[0]  =  2.0f / (right - left);
    out[5]  =  2.0f / (top - bottom);
    out[10] = -1.0f;
    out[12] = -(right + left) / (right - left);
    out[13] = -(top + bottom) / (top - bottom);
    out[15] =  1.0f;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Internal helper: draw a textured quad into destRect
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool WaylandSurfaceRenderer::drawQuad(GLuint program, GLint uProj, GLint uTex,
                                      GLenum texTarget, GLuint texId,
                                      const ViewportRect &destRect,
                                      int windowWidth, int windowHeight) {
    if (!program || texId == 0) return false;

    glUseProgram(program);

    std::array<float, 16> orthoMatrix;
    setupOrthoMatrix(0.0f, static_cast<float>(windowWidth),
                     static_cast<float>(windowHeight), 0.0f, orthoMatrix);
    glUniformMatrix4fv(uProj, 1, GL_FALSE, orthoMatrix.data());

    float x1 = static_cast<float>(destRect.x);
    float y1 = static_cast<float>(destRect.y);
    float x2 = x1 + static_cast<float>(destRect.width);
    float y2 = y1 + static_cast<float>(destRect.height);

    // {pos.x, pos.y, tex.u, tex.v}
    float vertices[] = {
        x1, y1,  0.0f, 0.0f,
        x1, y2,  0.0f, 1.0f,
        x2, y1,  1.0f, 0.0f,
        x2, y1,  1.0f, 0.0f,
        x1, y2,  0.0f, 1.0f,
        x2, y2,  1.0f, 1.0f
    };

    glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, m_vbo);
    glBufferData(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, sizeof(vertices), vertices, GL_DYNAMIC_DRAW);

    glEnableVertexAttribArray(0);
    glVertexAttribPointer(0, 2, GL_FLOAT, GL_FALSE, 4 * sizeof(float),
                          reinterpret_cast<void *>(0));
    glEnableVertexAttribArray(1);
    glVertexAttribPointer(1, 2, GL_FLOAT, GL_FALSE, 4 * sizeof(float),
                          reinterpret_cast<void *>(2 * sizeof(float)));

    glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
    glBindTexture(texTarget, texId);
    glTexParameteri(texTarget, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    glTexParameteri(texTarget, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
    glTexParameteri(texTarget, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    glTexParameteri(texTarget, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
    glUniform1i(uTex, 0);

    glEnable(GL_BLEND);
    glBlendFunc(GL_ONE, GL_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA);

    glDrawArrays(GL_TRIANGLES, 0, 6);

    glBindBuffer(GL_ARRAY_BUFFER, 0);
    glBindTexture(texTarget, 0);
    glUseProgram(0);

    return true;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// renderSurface — legacy path (wlroots context must be current)
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool WaylandSurfaceRenderer::renderSurface(struct wlr_surface *surface,
                                           const ViewportRect &destRect,
                                           int windowWidth, int windowHeight) {
    if (!surface || !m_initialized) return false;

    struct wlr_texture *wlrTex = wlr_bridge_surface_get_texture(surface);
    if (!wlrTex) return false;
    if (!wlr_bridge_texture_is_gles2(wlrTex)) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] Warning: Surface texture is not GLES2." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    uint32_t target = 0, tex = 0;
    if (!wlr_bridge_gles2_texture_get_attribs(wlrTex, &target, &tex) || tex == 0) {
        return false;
    }

    GLuint prog  = (target == GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES && m_programExternalOES)
                   ? m_programExternalOES : m_program2D;
    GLint  uProj = (prog == m_programExternalOES) ? m_uProjExternal : m_uProj2D;
    GLint  uTex  = (prog == m_programExternalOES) ? m_uTexExternal  : m_uTex2D;

    return drawQuad(prog, uProj, uTex, target, tex,
                    destRect, windowWidth, windowHeight);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// renderEglImage — zero-copy path (Qt context current, wlroots GL_TEXTURE_2D source)
//
// Creates an OES texture in Qt's context backed by the EGLImageKHR that was
// created from wlroots' GL_TEXTURE_2D.  This is a true zero-copy path:
// no pixel data crosses the CPU.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool WaylandSurfaceRenderer::renderEglImage(EGLImage eglImage, bool /*hasAlpha*/,
                                            int /*srcW*/, int /*srcH*/,
                                            const ViewportRect &destRect,
                                            int windowWidth, int windowHeight) {
    if (!m_initialized || eglImage == EGL_NO_IMAGE) return false;
    if (!m_programExternalOES) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] renderEglImage: OES shader unavailable." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }
    if (!s_glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES) {
        std::cerr << "[Renderer] renderEglImage: glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES not loaded." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Bind the persistent OES texture and attach the EGLImage to it
    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES, m_oesTex);
    s_glEGLImageTargetTexture2DOES(GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES,
                                   static_cast<GLeglImageOES>(eglImage));

    bool ok = drawQuad(m_programExternalOES, m_uProjExternal, m_uTexExternal,
                       GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES, m_oesTex,
                       destRect, windowWidth, windowHeight);

    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES, 0);
    return ok;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// renderCpuPixels — CPU-readback fallback (Qt context current)
//
// Used when wlroots gives us a GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES (DMA-BUF import) that
// cannot be wrapped in an EGL_GL_TEXTURE_2D_KHR EGLImage.  Uploads RGBA8888
// pixels into a persistent GL_TEXTURE_2D and renders with the standard 2D shader.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

bool WaylandSurfaceRenderer::renderCpuPixels(const uint8_t *pixels,
                                             int srcW, int srcH,
                                             const ViewportRect &destRect,
                                             int windowWidth, int windowHeight) {
    if (!m_initialized || !pixels || srcW <= 0 || srcH <= 0) return false;

    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, m_cpuTex);

    if (srcW != m_cpuTexW || srcH != m_cpuTexH) {
        // Re-allocate the texture storage for the new dimensions
        glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGBA,
                     srcW, srcH, 0, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, pixels);
        m_cpuTexW = srcW;
        m_cpuTexH = srcH;
    } else {
        // Same size — cheaper sub-image upload
        glTexSubImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, 0, 0,
                        srcW, srcH, GL_RGBA, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, pixels);
    }

    glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0);

    return drawQuad(m_program2D, m_uProj2D, m_uTex2D,
                    GL_TEXTURE_2D, m_cpuTex,
                    destRect, windowWidth, windowHeight);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// sendFrameDone — must be called with wlroots' EGL context current
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void WaylandSurfaceRenderer::sendFrameDone(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return;
    wlr_bridge_surface_send_frame_done(surface);
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// clearLetterboxBars
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void WaylandSurfaceRenderer::clearLetterboxBars(const ViewportRect &destRect,
                                                int windowWidth, int windowHeight) {
    glEnable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
    glClearColor(0.05f, 0.05f, 0.07f, 1.0f);

    // Top bar
    if (destRect.y > 0) {
        glScissor(0, windowHeight - destRect.y, windowWidth, destRect.y);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    }
    // Bottom bar
    int bottomY = destRect.y + destRect.height;
    if (bottomY < windowHeight) {
        glScissor(0, 0, windowWidth, windowHeight - bottomY);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    }
    // Left bar
    if (destRect.x > 0) {
        glScissor(0, 0, destRect.x, windowHeight);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    }
    // Right bar
    int rightX = destRect.x + destRect.width;
    if (rightX < windowWidth) {
        glScissor(rightX, 0, windowWidth - rightX, windowHeight);
        glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);
    }

    glDisable(GL_SCISSOR_TEST);
}

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/src/EmbeddedCompositor.cpp ---
#include "EmbeddedCompositor.h"

#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <algorithm>

EmbeddedCompositor::EmbeddedCompositor(const EmbeddedCompositorConfig &config)
    : m_config(config)
{
}

EmbeddedCompositor::~EmbeddedCompositor() {
    shutdown();
}

bool EmbeddedCompositor::makeCurrent() {
    EGLDisplay dpy = getEglDisplay();
    EGLContext ctx = getEglContext();
    if (dpy == EGL_NO_DISPLAY || ctx == EGL_NO_CONTEXT) return false;
    return eglMakeCurrent(dpy, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, ctx) == EGL_TRUE;
}

EGLDisplay EmbeddedCompositor::getEglDisplay() const {
    if (!m_renderer) return EGL_NO_DISPLAY;
    return wlr_bridge_get_egl_display(m_renderer);
}

EGLContext EmbeddedCompositor::getEglContext() const {
    if (!m_renderer) return EGL_NO_CONTEXT;
    return wlr_bridge_get_egl_context(m_renderer);
}

bool EmbeddedCompositor::initialize() {
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Initializing Wayland display server..." << std::endl;

    m_display = wlr_bridge_display_create();
    if (!m_display) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to create Wayland display." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    m_eventLoop = wlr_bridge_display_get_event_loop(m_display);
    if (!m_eventLoop) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to get Wayland event loop." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Listen to incoming Wayland client connections
    m_clientCreatedListener = wlr_bridge_display_add_client_created_listener(
        m_display,
        [](void *user, struct wl_client *client) {
            static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleClientCreated(client);
        },
        this
    );

    // 1. Create headless backend for the embedded container
    m_backend = wlr_bridge_headless_backend_create(m_eventLoop);
    if (!m_backend) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to create headless wlroots backend." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // 2. Hardware-accelerated GLES2 renderer bound to Intel / AMD / DRM render node
    setenv("WLR_RENDER_DRM_DEVICE", "/dev/dri/renderD128", 1);
    m_drmFd = open("/dev/dri/renderD128", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (m_drmFd >= 0) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Opened DRM render node /dev/dri/renderD128 (fd: " << m_drmFd << ")" << std::endl;
        m_renderer = wlr_bridge_gles2_renderer_create_with_drm_fd(m_drmFd);
    }
    if (!m_renderer) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Falling back to wlr_renderer_autocreate..." << std::endl;
        m_renderer = wlr_bridge_renderer_autocreate(m_backend);
    }
    if (!m_renderer) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to create wlroots renderer." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    m_allocator = wlr_bridge_allocator_autocreate(m_backend, m_renderer);
    if (!m_allocator) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to create wlroots allocator." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    // Bind renderer to Wayland display
    wlr_bridge_renderer_init_wl_display(m_renderer, m_display);

    // 3. Register virtual headless output and output layout for Android hwcomposer
    m_outputLayout = wlr_bridge_output_layout_create(m_display);
    m_headlessOutput = wlr_bridge_headless_add_output(m_backend, m_config.defaultWidth, m_config.defaultHeight);
    if (m_headlessOutput) {
        wlr_bridge_output_init_render(m_headlessOutput, m_allocator, m_renderer);
        wlr_bridge_output_configure(m_headlessOutput, m_config.defaultWidth, m_config.defaultHeight,
                                    m_config.refreshRate > 0 ? m_config.refreshRate : 60);
        wlr_bridge_output_layout_add_auto(m_outputLayout, m_headlessOutput);
        wlr_bridge_output_create_global(m_headlessOutput, m_display);
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Virtual headless output configured: "
                  << m_config.defaultWidth << "x" << m_config.defaultHeight << " @ "
                  << (m_config.refreshRate > 0 ? m_config.refreshRate : 60) << "Hz" << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Warning: Failed to create headless output for container." << std::endl;
    }

    // XDG Output Manager
    m_xdgOutputManager = wlr_bridge_xdg_output_manager_create(m_display, m_outputLayout);
    if (m_xdgOutputManager) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] zxdg_output_manager_v1 interface registered." << std::endl;
    }

    // 4. Core Wayland Compositor (version 5) with renderer backing
    m_compositor = wlr_bridge_compositor_create(m_display, 5, m_renderer);
    m_newSurfaceListener = wlr_bridge_compositor_add_new_surface_listener(
        m_compositor,
        [](void *user, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
            static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleNewSurface(surface);
        },
        this
    );

    // Subcompositor & Data Device Manager
    m_subcompositor = wlr_bridge_subcompositor_create(m_display);
    m_dataDeviceManager = wlr_bridge_data_device_manager_create(m_display);

    // 5. Shared Memory (wl_shm) + Linux DMA-BUF v1 zero-copy buffer sharing
    m_shm = wlr_bridge_shm_create_with_renderer(m_display, 1, m_renderer);
    if (!m_shm) {
        wlr_bridge_display_init_shm(m_display);
    }
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] wl_shm interface registered." << std::endl;

    m_linuxDmabuf = wlr_bridge_linux_dmabuf_create(m_display, 4, m_renderer);
    if (!m_linuxDmabuf) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Warning: Failed to create linux-dmabuf-v1 global." << std::endl;
    } else {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] linux-dmabuf-v1 interface initialized for zero-copy DMA-BUF import." << std::endl;
    }

    // 6. Presentation Time Protocol for VSync frame synchronization feedback
    m_presentation = wlr_bridge_presentation_create(m_display, m_backend, 1);
    if (m_presentation) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] wp_presentation interface registered for VSync presentation feedback." << std::endl;
    }

    // 7. Viewporter & Single Pixel Buffer Manager
    m_viewporter = wlr_bridge_viewporter_create(m_display);
    if (m_viewporter) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] wp_viewporter interface registered." << std::endl;
    }
    m_singlePixelBuffer = wlr_bridge_single_pixel_buffer_create(m_display);

    // Fractional scale & Pointer constraints
    m_fractionalScale = wlr_bridge_fractional_scale_create(m_display, 1);
    if (m_fractionalScale) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] wp_fractional_scale_manager_v1 interface registered." << std::endl;
    }
    m_pointerConstraints = wlr_bridge_pointer_constraints_create(m_display);
    if (m_pointerConstraints) {
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] zwp_pointer_constraints_v1 interface registered." << std::endl;
    }

    // 8. XDG Shell v3 interface
    m_xdgShell = wlr_bridge_xdg_shell_create(m_display, 3);
    m_newXdgSurfaceListener = wlr_bridge_xdg_shell_add_new_surface_listener(
        m_xdgShell,
        [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface) {
            static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleNewXdgSurface(xdgSurface);
        },
        this
    );
    m_newXdgToplevelListener = wlr_bridge_xdg_shell_add_new_toplevel_listener(
        m_xdgShell,
        [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel) {
            static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleNewXdgToplevel(toplevel);
        },
        this
    );

    // 9. Wayland input seat (multi-touch, pointer, keyboard)
    m_seat = wlr_bridge_seat_create(m_display, "linstack-seat-0");
    wlr_bridge_seat_set_capabilities(m_seat,
                                    WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_POINTER |
                                    WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_KEYBOARD |
                                    WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_TOUCH);

    // Initialize virtual keyboard directly via C bridge
    m_virtualKeyboard = wlr_bridge_virtual_keyboard_create(m_seat);

    // 10. Relative pointer manager for FPS mouse look
    m_relativePointerManager = wlr_bridge_relative_pointer_manager_create(m_display);

    // 11. Bind dedicated Wayland display socket
    const char *xdgRuntime = getenv("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR");
    if (xdgRuntime) {
        std::string sock = std::string(xdgRuntime) + "/" + m_config.socketName;
        std::string lock = sock + ".lock";
        unlink(sock.c_str());
        unlink(lock.c_str());
    }

    int res = wlr_bridge_display_add_socket(m_display, m_config.socketName.c_str());
    if (res != 0) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to bind socket: " << m_config.socketName << std::endl;
        return false;
    }

    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Successfully listening on Wayland socket: " << m_config.socketName << std::endl;
    return true;
}

bool EmbeddedCompositor::start() {
    if (!m_backend) return false;
    if (!wlr_bridge_backend_start(m_backend)) {
        std::cerr << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Error: Failed to start wlroots backend." << std::endl;
        return false;
    }
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Headless backend running successfully." << std::endl;
    return true;
}

int EmbeddedCompositor::dispatch(int timeoutMs) {
    if (!m_display || !m_eventLoop) return -1;
    wlr_bridge_display_flush_clients(m_display);
    int res = wlr_bridge_event_loop_dispatch(m_eventLoop, timeoutMs);
    wlr_bridge_display_flush_clients(m_display);
    return res;
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::shutdown() {
    if (!m_display) return;

    EGLDisplay dpy = getEglDisplay();
    if (dpy != EGL_NO_DISPLAY) {
        eglMakeCurrent(dpy, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_SURFACE, EGL_NO_CONTEXT);
    }

    m_toplevelRecords.clear();
    m_surfaceRecords.clear();
    m_rawSurfaceRecords.clear();
    m_activeSurface = nullptr;
    m_activeToplevel = nullptr;

    if (m_clientCreatedListener) {
        wlr_bridge_listener_destroy(m_clientCreatedListener);
        m_clientCreatedListener = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_newSurfaceListener) {
        wlr_bridge_listener_destroy(m_newSurfaceListener);
        m_newSurfaceListener = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_newXdgSurfaceListener) {
        wlr_bridge_listener_destroy(m_newXdgSurfaceListener);
        m_newXdgSurfaceListener = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_newXdgToplevelListener) {
        wlr_bridge_listener_destroy(m_newXdgToplevelListener);
        m_newXdgToplevelListener = nullptr;
    }

    if (m_virtualKeyboard) {
        wlr_bridge_virtual_keyboard_destroy(m_virtualKeyboard);
        m_virtualKeyboard = nullptr;
    }

    if (m_outputLayout) {
        wlr_bridge_output_layout_destroy(m_outputLayout);
        m_outputLayout = nullptr;
    }
    m_headlessOutput = nullptr;

    if (m_backend) {
        wlr_bridge_backend_destroy(m_backend);
        m_backend = nullptr;
    }

    if (m_display) {
        wlr_bridge_display_destroy_clients(m_display);
        wlr_bridge_display_destroy(m_display);
        m_display = nullptr;
    }

    if (m_drmFd >= 0) {
        close(m_drmFd);
        m_drmFd = -1;
    }
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Compositor shutdown complete." << std::endl;
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleClientCreated(struct wl_client *client) {
    pid_t pid = 0;
    uid_t uid = 0;
    gid_t gid = 0;
    wlr_bridge_client_get_credentials(client, &pid, &uid, &gid);
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] >>> Wayland Client Connected: PID=" << pid
              << ", UID=" << uid << ", GID=" << gid << " <<<" << std::endl;
    if (onClientConnected) {
        onClientConnected(client);
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleNewSurface(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return;
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] New wlr_surface created (" << surface << ")" << std::endl;

    auto record = std::unique_ptr<struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record, void(*)(struct wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record*)>(
        wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_create(
            surface,
            [](void *user, struct wlr_surface *s) {
                static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleSurfaceCommit(s);
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_surface *s) {
                static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleRawSurfaceDestroy(s);
            },
            this
        ),
        wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_destroy
    );

    if (record) {
        m_rawSurfaceRecords.push_back(std::move(record));
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleRawSurfaceDestroy(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return;
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] wlr_surface destroyed (" << surface << ")" << std::endl;
    if (m_activeSurface == surface) {
        m_activeSurface = nullptr;
        for (const auto &rec : m_rawSurfaceRecords) {
            struct wlr_surface *s = wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_get_surface(rec.get());
            if (s && s != surface && wlr_bridge_surface_has_buffer(s)) {
                m_activeSurface = s;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (onSurfaceUnmapped) {
            onSurfaceUnmapped(surface);
        }
    }

    auto it = std::remove_if(m_rawSurfaceRecords.begin(), m_rawSurfaceRecords.end(),
                             [surface](const auto &rec) {
                                 return wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_get_surface(rec.get()) == surface;
                             });
    m_rawSurfaceRecords.erase(it, m_rawSurfaceRecords.end());
}

struct wlr_surface *EmbeddedCompositor::getRenderableSurface() const {
    struct wlr_surface *bestSurface = nullptr;
    int maxArea = 0;

    for (const auto &rec : m_rawSurfaceRecords) {
        struct wlr_surface *s = wlr_bridge_raw_surface_record_get_surface(rec.get());
        if (s && (wlr_bridge_surface_has_buffer(s) || wlr_bridge_surface_get_texture(s))) {
            int w = 0, h = 0;
            wlr_bridge_surface_get_size(s, &w, &h);
            int area = w * h;
            if (area > maxArea) {
                maxArea = area;
                bestSurface = s;
            }
        }
    }
    if (bestSurface) return bestSurface;
    return m_activeSurface;
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleNewXdgSurface(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface) {
    if (!xdgSurface) return;

    struct wlr_surface *surf = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_surface(xdgSurface);
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Incoming XDG surface created (surface: "
              << surf << ") — awaiting role assignment" << std::endl;

    auto record = std::unique_ptr<struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record, void(*)(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record*)>(
        wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record_create(
            xdgSurface,
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xs) {
                static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleXdgSurfaceMap(xs);
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xs) {
                static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleXdgSurfaceUnmap(xs);
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xs) {
                static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user)->handleXdgSurfaceDestroy(xs);
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_surface *xs) {
                EmbeddedCompositor *comp = static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user);
                struct wlr_surface *s = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_surface(xs);
                struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *xdgToplevel = wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_try_from_surface(s);
                if (xdgToplevel && wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_is_initial_commit(xdgToplevel)) {
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_size(xdgToplevel, comp->m_config.defaultWidth, comp->m_config.defaultHeight);
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_activated(xdgToplevel, true);
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_fullscreen(xdgToplevel, true);
                    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] initial_commit: configure "
                              << comp->m_config.defaultWidth << "x" << comp->m_config.defaultHeight
                              << " fullscreen+activated -> toplevel " << xdgToplevel << std::endl;
                }
                comp->handleSurfaceCommit(s);
            },
            this
        ),
        wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record_destroy
    );

    if (record) {
        m_surfaceRecords.push_back(std::move(record));
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleXdgSurfaceMap(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface) {
    if (!xdgSurface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *surf = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_surface(xdgSurface);
    if (!surf) return;

    m_activeSurface = surf;
    struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel = wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_try_from_surface(surf);
    int surfW = 0, surfH = 0;
    wlr_bridge_surface_get_size(surf, &surfW, &surfH);

    if (toplevel && (surfW != m_config.defaultWidth || surfH != m_config.defaultHeight)) {
        wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_size(toplevel, m_config.defaultWidth, m_config.defaultHeight);
        wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_schedule_configure(xdgSurface);
    }
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Android Wayland surface mapped ("
              << surfW << "x" << surfH << ", surface: " << surf << ")" << std::endl;

    if (onSurfaceMapped) {
        onSurfaceMapped(m_activeSurface);
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleXdgSurfaceUnmap(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface) {
    if (!xdgSurface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *surf = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_surface(xdgSurface);
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Android Wayland surface unmapped (" << surf << ")" << std::endl;
    if (m_activeSurface == surf) {
        m_activeSurface = nullptr;
    }
    if (onSurfaceUnmapped) {
        onSurfaceUnmapped(surf);
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleXdgSurfaceDestroy(struct wlr_xdg_surface *xdgSurface) {
    if (!xdgSurface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *surf = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_surface(xdgSurface);
    struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *top = wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_get_toplevel(xdgSurface);

    if (m_activeSurface == surf) {
        m_activeSurface = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_activeToplevel == top) {
        m_activeToplevel = nullptr;
    }

    auto it = std::remove_if(m_surfaceRecords.begin(), m_surfaceRecords.end(),
                             [xdgSurface](const auto &rec) {
                                 return wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_record_get_xdg_surface(rec.get()) == xdgSurface;
                             });
    m_surfaceRecords.erase(it, m_surfaceRecords.end());
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleNewXdgToplevel(struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *toplevel) {
    if (!toplevel) return;

    struct wlr_surface *surf = wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_get_surface(toplevel);
    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] >>> New XDG toplevel (role assigned): "
              << toplevel << " surface=" << surf << std::endl;

    m_activeToplevel = toplevel;

    auto record = std::unique_ptr<struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record, void(*)(struct wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record*)>(
        wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record_create(
            toplevel,
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *tl) {
                (void)user;
                if (tl && wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_is_initialized(tl)) {
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_maximized(tl, true);
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_schedule_configure(wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_get_base(tl));
                }
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *tl) {
                (void)user;
                if (tl && wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_is_initialized(tl)) {
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_set_fullscreen(tl, true);
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_schedule_configure(wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_get_base(tl));
                    std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Granted fullscreen to XDG toplevel" << std::endl;
                }
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *tl) {
                (void)user;
                if (tl && wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_is_initialized(tl)) {
                    wlr_bridge_xdg_surface_schedule_configure(wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_get_base(tl));
                }
            },
            [](void *user, struct wlr_xdg_toplevel *tl) {
                EmbeddedCompositor *comp = static_cast<EmbeddedCompositor*>(user);
                if (comp->m_activeToplevel == tl) {
                    comp->m_activeToplevel = nullptr;
                }
                auto it = std::remove_if(comp->m_toplevelRecords.begin(), comp->m_toplevelRecords.end(),
                                         [tl](const auto &r) {
                                             return wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record_get_toplevel(r.get()) == tl;
                                         });
                comp->m_toplevelRecords.erase(it, comp->m_toplevelRecords.end());
                std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] XDG toplevel destroyed" << std::endl;
            },
            this
        ),
        wlr_bridge_xdg_toplevel_record_destroy
    );

    if (record) {
        m_toplevelRecords.push_back(std::move(record));
    }
}

void EmbeddedCompositor::handleSurfaceCommit(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return;

    bool hasBuf = wlr_bridge_surface_has_buffer(surface);
    int surfW = 0, surfH = 0;
    wlr_bridge_surface_get_size(surface, &surfW, &surfH);

    if (!m_activeSurface && (hasBuf || surfW > 200)) {
        m_activeSurface = surface;
        std::cout << "[EmbeddedCompositor] Promoting wlr_surface " << surface << " to active surface" << std::endl;
        if (onSurfaceMapped) {
            onSurfaceMapped(m_activeSurface);
        }
    }

    if (onSurfaceCommit) {
        onSurfaceCommit(surface);
    }
}

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/src/InputMapper.cpp ---
#include "InputMapper.h"
#include <iostream>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

InputMapper::InputMapper(struct wlr_seat *seat, struct wlr_relative_pointer_manager_v1 *relPointerMgr)
: m_seat(seat)
, m_relPointerMgr(relPointerMgr)
{
    setupDefaultProfile();
}

InputMapper::~InputMapper() = default;

uint32_t InputMapper::getTimestampMs() const {
    auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch();
    return static_cast<uint32_t>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now).count());
}

int32_t InputMapper::allocateSlot() {
    for (int32_t s = 0; s < 10; ++s) {
        if (m_activeSlots.find(s) == m_activeSlots.end()) {
            m_activeSlots.insert(s);
            return s;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

void InputMapper::releaseSlot(int32_t slot) {
    if (slot >= 0) {
        m_activeSlots.erase(slot);
    }
}

void InputMapper::setGeometry(const ViewportRect &viewport, int androidWidth, int androidHeight) {
    m_viewport = viewport;
    m_androidWidth = std::max(1, androidWidth);
    m_androidHeight = std::max(1, androidHeight);
}

void InputMapper::windowToAndroid(int winX, int winY, double &outAndroidX, double &outAndroidY) const {
    if (m_viewport.width <= 0 || m_viewport.height <= 0) {
        outAndroidX = 0.0;
        outAndroidY = 0.0;
        return;
    }
    double relX = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(winX - m_viewport.x) / m_viewport.width, 0.0, 1.0);
    double relY = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(winY - m_viewport.y) / m_viewport.height, 0.0, 1.0);
    outAndroidX = relX * m_androidWidth;
    outAndroidY = relY * m_androidHeight;
}

void InputMapper::windowToNormalized(int winX, int winY, float &outNormX, float &outNormY) const {
    if (m_viewport.width <= 0 || m_viewport.height <= 0) {
        outNormX = 0.0f;
        outNormY = 0.0f;
        return;
    }
    outNormX = std::clamp(static_cast<float>(winX - m_viewport.x) / m_viewport.width, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    outNormY = std::clamp(static_cast<float>(winY - m_viewport.y) / m_viewport.height, 0.0f, 1.0f);
}

void InputMapper::setupDefaultProfile() {
    m_tapNodes.clear();
    m_tapNodes.push_back(KeyNode{"jump", WlrKeyNodeType::Tap, 65, 0.88f, 0.78f, 0});
    m_tapNodes.push_back(KeyNode{"reload", WlrKeyNodeType::Tap, 27, 0.88f, 0.52f, 0});
    m_tapNodes.push_back(KeyNode{"crouch", WlrKeyNodeType::Tap, 54, 0.82f, 0.86f, 0});
    m_tapNodes.push_back(KeyNode{"interact", WlrKeyNodeType::Tap, 26, 0.75f, 0.40f, 0});

    m_dpad.centerX = 0.18f;
    m_dpad.centerY = 0.70f;
    m_dpad.radius = 0.08f;
    m_dpad.scanUp = 25;
    m_dpad.scanLeft = 38;
    m_dpad.scanDown = 39;
    m_dpad.scanRight = 40;
    m_dpad.touchSlot = 0;

    m_aimNodes.clear();
    AimLockNodeConfig aim;
    aim.id = "aim_lock_1";
    aim.toggleScanCode = 67;
    aim.centerX = 0.50f;
    aim.centerY = 0.50f;
    aim.fireX = 0.82f;
    aim.fireY = 0.64f;
    aim.sensitivityX = 1.2f;
    aim.sensitivityY = 1.2f;
    aim.acceleration = false;
    aim.maxSweepRadius = 0.18f;
    aim.cameraTouchSlot = 0;
    aim.fireTouchSlot = 1;
    m_aimNodes.push_back(aim);
}

const AimLockNodeConfig* InputMapper::activeAimNode() const {
    if (m_aimLockActive && m_activeAimIndex >= 0 && m_activeAimIndex < static_cast<int>(m_aimNodes.size())) {
        return &m_aimNodes[m_activeAimIndex];
    }
    return nullptr;
}

const FreeLookConfig* InputMapper::activeFreeLookNode() const {
    if (m_freeLookActive && m_activeFreeLookIndex >= 0 && m_activeFreeLookIndex < static_cast<int>(m_freeLookNodes.size())) {
        return &m_freeLookNodes[m_activeFreeLookIndex];
    }
    return nullptr;
}

void InputMapper::setAimLockActive(bool active, int nodeIndex) {
    if (active && (nodeIndex < 0 || nodeIndex >= static_cast<int>(m_aimNodes.size()))) {
        return;
    }

    if (m_aimLockActive == active && (!active || m_activeAimIndex == nodeIndex)) {
        return;
    }

    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    if (m_aimLockActive && m_seat) {
        if (m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot);
            m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot = -1;
        }
        if (m_activeAimCameraSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 1, m_activeAimCameraSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeAimCameraSlot);
            m_activeAimCameraSlot = -1;
        }
        if (m_firing && m_activeAimFireSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 2, m_activeAimFireSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeAimFireSlot);
            m_activeAimFireSlot = -1;
            m_firing = false;
        }
    }

    m_aimLockActive = active;
    m_activeAimIndex = active ? nodeIndex : -1;
    m_accumAimX = 0.0f;
    m_accumAimY = 0.0f;
}

void InputMapper::tick(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    // 1. Burst Tap
    for (auto &kv : m_activeBursts) {
        ActiveBurst &b = kv.second;
        uint32_t intervalMs = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::max(10, 1000 / std::clamp(b.cfg.burstHz, 1, 100)));
        if (b.isDown && (now - b.lastClickMs >= intervalMs / 2)) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, b.slot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            b.isDown = false;
        } else if (!b.isDown && (now - b.lastClickMs >= intervalMs)) {
            double tx = b.cfg.relX * m_androidWidth;
            double ty = b.cfg.relY * m_androidHeight;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, b.slot, tx, ty);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            b.isDown = true;
            b.lastClickMs = now;
        }
    }

    // 2. Swipe
    for (auto it = m_activeSwipes.begin(); it != m_activeSwipes.end(); ) {
        uint32_t elapsed = now - it->startMs;
        float progress = std::clamp(static_cast<float>(elapsed) / std::max(1, it->cfg.durationMs), 0.0f, 1.0f);

        float rx = 0.0f, ry = 0.0f;
        if (it->cfg.pathPoints.size() >= 2) {
            float scaled = progress * (it->cfg.pathPoints.size() - 1);
            size_t idx0 = std::min(static_cast<size_t>(scaled), it->cfg.pathPoints.size() - 1);
            size_t idx1 = std::min(idx0 + 1, it->cfg.pathPoints.size() - 1);
            float localT = scaled - idx0;
            rx = it->cfg.pathPoints[idx0].first + (it->cfg.pathPoints[idx1].first - it->cfg.pathPoints[idx0].first) * localT;
            ry = it->cfg.pathPoints[idx0].second + (it->cfg.pathPoints[idx1].second - it->cfg.pathPoints[idx0].second) * localT;
        } else {
            rx = it->cfg.startX + (it->cfg.endX - it->cfg.startX) * progress;
            ry = it->cfg.startY + (it->cfg.endY - it->cfg.startY) * progress;
        }

        double ax = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(rx * m_androidWidth), 1.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidWidth - 2));
        double ay = std::clamp(static_cast<double>(ry * m_androidHeight), 1.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidHeight - 2));

        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, it->slot, ax, ay);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);

        if (progress >= 1.0f) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 1, it->slot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(it->slot);
            it = m_activeSwipes.erase(it);
        } else {
            ++it;
        }
    }
}

void InputMapper::updateDpad(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;

    bool up    = m_heldScanCodes.count(m_dpad.scanUp) > 0;
    bool down  = m_heldScanCodes.count(m_dpad.scanDown) > 0;
    bool left  = m_heldScanCodes.count(m_dpad.scanLeft) > 0;
    bool right = m_heldScanCodes.count(m_dpad.scanRight) > 0;

    float dx = 0.0f;
    float dy = 0.0f;

    if (up) dy -= 1.0f;
    if (down) dy += 1.0f;
    if (left) dx -= 1.0f;
    if (right) dx += 1.0f;

    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    if (dx == 0.0f && dy == 0.0f) {
        if (m_dpadActive && m_activeDpadSlot >= 0) {
            m_dpadActive = false;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_activeDpadSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeDpadSlot);
            m_activeDpadSlot = -1;
        }
        return;
    }

    float len = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    dx /= len;
    dy /= len;

    double centerX = m_dpad.centerX * m_androidWidth;
    double centerY = m_dpad.centerY * m_androidHeight;
    double targetX = (m_dpad.centerX + dx * m_dpad.radius) * m_androidWidth;
    double targetY = (m_dpad.centerY + dy * m_dpad.radius) * m_androidHeight;

    if (!m_dpadActive) {
        m_dpadActive = true;
        m_activeDpadSlot = allocateSlot();
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeDpadSlot, centerX, centerY);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now + 1, m_activeDpadSlot, targetX, targetY);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
    } else if (m_activeDpadSlot >= 0) {
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, m_activeDpadSlot, targetX, targetY);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
    }
}


void InputMapper::sendRecentsCombo(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;

    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_enter(m_seat, rootSurf);

    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now, 56, 1);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(m_seat);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now + 10, 15, 1);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now + 25, 15, 0);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now + 35, 56, 0);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(m_seat);
}

void InputMapper::sendSystemKey(uint32_t evdevKeyCode, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;

    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_enter(m_seat, rootSurf);

    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now, evdevKeyCode, 1);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now + 15, evdevKeyCode, 0);
}

void InputMapper::forwardNativeKey(uint32_t scanCode, bool pressed, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface || scanCode == 0) return;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;

    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_enter(m_seat, rootSurf);

    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();
    uint32_t evdevKey = (scanCode >= 8) ? (scanCode - 8) : scanCode;
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_key(m_seat, now, evdevKey, pressed ? 1 : 0);
    wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(m_seat);
}

bool InputMapper::handleScanCodeDown(uint32_t scanCode, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (scanCode == 0) return false;

    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(m_aimNodes.size()); ++i) {
        if (m_aimNodes[i].toggleScanCode == scanCode) {
            if (m_aimLockActive && m_activeAimIndex == i) {
                setAimLockActive(false, -1);
            } else {
                setAimLockActive(true, i);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    if (scanCode == 9) {
        bool handledEsc = false;
        if (m_aimLockActive) {
            setAimLockActive(false, -1);
            handledEsc = true;
        }
        if (m_freeLookActive && m_seat) {
            uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();
            m_freeLookActive = false;
            m_activeFreeLookIndex = -1;
            if (m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
                releaseSlot(m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
                m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot = -1;
            }
            if (m_activeFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 1, m_activeFreeLookSlot);
                releaseSlot(m_activeFreeLookSlot);
                m_activeFreeLookSlot = -1;
            }
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            handledEsc = true;
        }
        if (handledEsc) return true;
    }

    m_heldScanCodes.insert(scanCode);

    if (scanCode == m_dpad.scanUp || scanCode == m_dpad.scanDown ||
        scanCode == m_dpad.scanLeft || scanCode == m_dpad.scanRight) {
        updateDpad(surface);
        return true;
    }

    if (!m_seat || !surface) return false;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    // 1. Free Look
    for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(m_freeLookNodes.size()); ++i) {
        if (m_freeLookNodes[i].holdScanCode == scanCode) {
            if (!m_freeLookActive) {
                m_freeLookActive = true;
                m_activeFreeLookIndex = i;
                m_accumFreeLookX = 0.0f;
                m_accumFreeLookY = 0.0f;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // 2. Burst Tap
    for (const auto &bn : m_burstNodes) {
        if (bn.scanCode == scanCode) {
            if (m_activeBursts.find(scanCode) == m_activeBursts.end()) {
                ActiveBurst ab;
                ab.cfg = bn;
                ab.slot = allocateSlot();
                ab.lastClickMs = now;
                ab.isDown = true;
                m_activeBursts[scanCode] = ab;

                double tx = bn.relX * m_androidWidth;
                double ty = bn.relY * m_androidHeight;
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, ab.slot, tx, ty);
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // 3. Swipe
    for (const auto &sw : m_swipeNodes) {
        if (sw.scanCode == scanCode) {
            ActiveSwipe as;
            as.cfg = sw;
            as.slot = allocateSlot();
            as.startMs = now;
            m_activeSwipes.push_back(as);

            double sx = sw.startX * m_androidWidth;
            double sy = sw.startY * m_androidHeight;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, as.slot, sx, sy);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            return true;
        }
    }

    // 4. Smart Cast
    for (const auto &sc : m_smartCastNodes) {
        if (sc.scanCode == scanCode) {
            if (!m_smartCasting) {
                m_smartCasting = true;
                m_activeSmartCast = sc;
                m_activeSmartCastSlot = allocateSlot();
                m_smartCastAccumX = 0.0f;
                m_smartCastAccumY = 0.0f;

                double cx = sc.centerX * m_androidWidth;
                double cy = sc.centerY * m_androidHeight;
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeSmartCastSlot, cx, cy);
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // 5. Tap
    for (const auto &node : m_tapNodes) {
        if (node.scanCode == scanCode) {
            if (m_scanCodeToSlot.find(scanCode) != m_scanCodeToSlot.end()) {
                return true;
            }
            int32_t slot = allocateSlot();
            m_scanCodeToSlot[scanCode] = slot;

            double tx = node.relX * m_androidWidth;
            double ty = node.relY * m_androidHeight;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, slot, tx, ty);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            return true;
        }
    }

    return false;
}

bool InputMapper::handleScanCodeUp(uint32_t scanCode, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (scanCode == 0) return false;
    m_heldScanCodes.erase(scanCode);

    if (scanCode == m_dpad.scanUp || scanCode == m_dpad.scanDown ||
        scanCode == m_dpad.scanLeft || scanCode == m_dpad.scanRight) {
        updateDpad(surface);
        return true;
    }

    if (!m_seat) return false;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();
    // Free Look release
    if (m_freeLookActive && m_activeFreeLookIndex >= 0 &&
        m_freeLookNodes[m_activeFreeLookIndex].holdScanCode == scanCode) {
        m_freeLookActive = false;
        m_activeFreeLookIndex = -1;
        if (m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
            releaseSlot(m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
            m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot = -1;
        }
        if (m_activeFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now + 1, m_activeFreeLookSlot);
            releaseSlot(m_activeFreeLookSlot);
            m_activeFreeLookSlot = -1;
        }
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        return true;
    }

    // Burst Tap release
    auto burstIt = m_activeBursts.find(scanCode);
    if (burstIt != m_activeBursts.end()) {
        if (burstIt->second.isDown) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, burstIt->second.slot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        }
        releaseSlot(burstIt->second.slot);
        m_activeBursts.erase(burstIt);
        return true;
    }

    // Smart Cast release
    if (m_smartCasting && m_activeSmartCast.scanCode == scanCode) {
        m_smartCasting = false;
        if (m_activeSmartCastSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_activeSmartCastSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeSmartCastSlot);
            m_activeSmartCastSlot = -1;
        }
        return true;
    }

    auto it = m_scanCodeToSlot.find(scanCode);
    if (it != m_scanCodeToSlot.end()) {
        int32_t slot = it->second;
        m_scanCodeToSlot.erase(it);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, slot);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        releaseSlot(slot);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

bool InputMapper::handleMouseDown(int button, int winX, int winY, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return false;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    const auto *aim = activeAimNode();
    if (aim) {
        if (button == 1 && !m_firing) {
            m_firing = true;
            m_activeAimFireSlot = allocateSlot();
            double fx = aim->fireX * m_androidWidth;
            double fy = aim->fireY * m_androidHeight;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeAimFireSlot, fx, fy);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    if (button == 1 && !m_isTouching) {
        m_isTouching = true;
        m_activeMouseSlot = allocateSlot();
        double ax, ay;
        windowToAndroid(winX, winY, ax, ay);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeMouseSlot, ax, ay);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

bool InputMapper::handleMouseUp(int button, int winX, int winY, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    (void)winX;
    (void)winY;
    (void)surface;

    if (!m_seat) return false;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    const auto *aim = activeAimNode();
    if (aim) {
        if (button == 1 && m_firing) {
            m_firing = false;
            if (m_activeAimFireSlot >= 0) {
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_activeAimFireSlot);
                wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
                releaseSlot(m_activeAimFireSlot);
                m_activeAimFireSlot = -1;
            }
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    if (button == 1 && m_isTouching) {
        m_isTouching = false;
        if (m_activeMouseSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_activeMouseSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_activeMouseSlot);
            m_activeMouseSlot = -1;
        }
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

bool InputMapper::handleMouseMove(int winX, int winY, int deltaX, int deltaY, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!m_seat || !surface) return false;
    struct wlr_surface *rootSurf = wlr_bridge_surface_get_root_surface(surface);
    if (!rootSurf) rootSurf = surface;
    uint32_t now = getTimestampMs();

    // 1. Smart Cast
    if (m_smartCasting && m_activeSmartCastSlot >= 0) {
        double cx = m_activeSmartCast.centerX * m_androidWidth;
        double cy = m_activeSmartCast.centerY * m_androidHeight;

        float mx = 0.0f, my = 0.0f;
        if (m_aimLockActive && (deltaX != 0 || deltaY != 0)) {
            m_smartCastAccumX += deltaX * 1.5f;
            m_smartCastAccumY += deltaY * 1.5f;
            mx = m_smartCastAccumX;
            my = m_smartCastAccumY;
        } else {
            double ax, ay;
            windowToAndroid(winX, winY, ax, ay);
            mx = static_cast<float>(ax - cx);
            my = static_cast<float>(ay - cy);
        }

        float dist = std::sqrt(mx * mx + my * my);
        float maxR = m_activeSmartCast.castRadius;
        if (dist > maxR && dist > 0.001f) {
            mx = (mx / dist) * maxR;
            my = (my / dist) * maxR;
            m_smartCastAccumX = mx;
            m_smartCastAccumY = my;
        }

        double tx = std::clamp(cx + mx, 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidWidth - 3));
        double ty = std::clamp(cy + my, 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidHeight - 3));
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, m_activeSmartCastSlot, tx, ty);
        wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        return true;
    }

    // 2. Free Look
    if (m_freeLookActive && m_activeFreeLookIndex >= 0 && m_activeFreeLookIndex < static_cast<int>(m_freeLookNodes.size())) {
        const auto &fl = m_freeLookNodes[m_activeFreeLookIndex];
        if (m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot);
            m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot = -1;
            now += 1;
        }

        float effDx = static_cast<float>(deltaX);
        float effDy = static_cast<float>(deltaY);
        if (fl.acceleration) {
            float speed = std::sqrt(effDx * effDx + effDy * effDy);
            float factor = 1.0f + std::min(speed * 0.02f, 1.5f);
            effDx *= factor;
            effDy *= factor;
        }

        float normDx = (effDx * fl.sensitivityX) / std::max(1, m_viewport.width);
        float normDy = (effDy * fl.sensitivityY) / std::max(1, m_viewport.height);
        const float baseX = std::clamp(fl.centerX, 0.05f, 0.95f);
        const float baseY = std::clamp(fl.centerY, 0.05f, 0.95f);

        if (m_activeFreeLookSlot < 0) {
            m_activeFreeLookSlot = allocateSlot();
            m_accumFreeLookX = 0.0f;
            m_accumFreeLookY = 0.0f;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeFreeLookSlot, baseX * m_androidWidth, baseY * m_androidHeight);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            now += 1;
        }

        float nextX = baseX + m_accumFreeLookX + normDx;
        float nextY = baseY + m_accumFreeLookY + normDy;
        if (nextX <= 0.04f || nextX >= 0.96f || nextY <= 0.04f || nextY >= 0.96f) {
            int32_t oldSlot = m_activeFreeLookSlot;
            int32_t newSlot = allocateSlot();
            m_accumFreeLookX = normDx;
            m_accumFreeLookY = normDy;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, newSlot, baseX * m_androidWidth, baseY * m_androidHeight);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            double tx = std::clamp(static_cast<double>((baseX + m_accumFreeLookX) * m_androidWidth), 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidWidth - 3));
            double ty = std::clamp(static_cast<double>((baseY + m_accumFreeLookY) * m_androidHeight), 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidHeight - 3));
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now + 1, newSlot, tx, ty);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            m_pendingReleaseFreeLookSlot = oldSlot;
            m_activeFreeLookSlot = newSlot;
        } else {
            m_accumFreeLookX += normDx;
            m_accumFreeLookY += normDy;
            double tx = std::clamp(static_cast<double>((baseX + m_accumFreeLookX) * m_androidWidth), 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidWidth - 3));
            double ty = std::clamp(static_cast<double>((baseY + m_accumFreeLookY) * m_androidHeight), 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidHeight - 3));
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, m_activeFreeLookSlot, tx, ty);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        }
        return true;
    }

    // 3. Aim Lock
    const auto *aim = activeAimNode();
    if (aim) {
        if (m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot >= 0) {
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_up(m_seat, now, m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            releaseSlot(m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot);
            m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot = -1;
            now += 1;
        }

        float effDx = static_cast<float>(deltaX);
        float effDy = static_cast<float>(deltaY);

        if (aim->acceleration) {
            float speed = std::sqrt(effDx * effDx + effDy * effDy);
            float factor = 1.0f + std::min(speed * 0.02f, 1.5f);
            effDx *= factor;
            effDy *= factor;
        }

        float normDx = (effDx * aim->sensitivityX) / std::max(1, m_viewport.width);
        float normDy = (effDy * aim->sensitivityY) / std::max(1, m_viewport.height);

        const float baseCenterX = std::clamp(aim->centerX, 0.05f, 0.95f);
        const float baseCenterY = std::clamp(aim->centerY, 0.05f, 0.95f);

        if (m_activeAimCameraSlot < 0) {
            m_activeAimCameraSlot = allocateSlot();
            m_accumAimX = 0.0f;
            m_accumAimY = 0.0f;
            double cx = baseCenterX * m_androidWidth;
            double cy = baseCenterY * m_androidHeight;
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, m_activeAimCameraSlot, cx, cy);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
            now += 1;
        }

        float nextX = baseCenterX + m_accumAimX + normDx;
        float nextY = baseCenterY + m_accumAimY + normDy;

        if (nextX <= 0.04f || nextX >= 0.96f || nextY <= 0.04f || nextY >= 0.96f) {
            int32_t oldSlot = m_activeAimCameraSlot;
            int32_t newSlot = allocateSlot();

            m_accumAimX = normDx;
            m_accumAimY = normDy;

            double cx = baseCenterX * m_androidWidth;
            double cy = baseCenterY * m_androidHeight;

            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(m_seat, rootSurf, now, newSlot, cx, cy);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);

            double tx = std::clamp(static_cast<double>((baseCenterX + m_accumAimX) * m_androidWidth), 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidWidth - 3));
            double ty = std::clamp(static_cast<double>((baseCenterY + m_accumAimY) * m_androidHeight), 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidHeight - 3));
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now + 1, newSlot, tx, ty);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);

            m_pendingReleaseCameraSlot = oldSlot;
            m_activeAimCameraSlot = newSlot;
        } else {
            m_accumAimX += normDx;
            m_accumAimY += normDy;
            double targetX = std::clamp(static_cast<double>((baseCenterX + m_accumAimX) * m_androidWidth), 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidWidth - 3));
            double targetY = std::clamp(static_cast<double>((baseCenterY + m_accumAimY) * m_androidHeight), 2.0, static_cast<double>(m_androidHeight - 3));
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, m_activeAimCameraSlot, targetX, targetY);
            wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
        }
        return true;
    }

    if (!m_isTouching || m_activeMouseSlot < 0) return false;

    double ax, ay;
    windowToAndroid(winX, winY, ax, ay);
    wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_motion(m_seat, now, m_activeMouseSlot, ax, ay);
    wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_frame(m_seat);
    return true;
}

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/src/main.cpp ---
#include "EmbeddedCompositor.h"
#include "WaylandSurfaceRenderer.h"
#include "InputMapper.h"
#include "AspectRatioWindow.h"

#include <iostream>
#include <csignal>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

static std::atomic<bool> g_running{true};

static void sigHandler(int sig) {
    (void)sig;
    g_running = false;
}

int main(int argc, char *argv[]) {
    std::cout << "========================================================" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  LinStack Embedded wlroots Compositor Engine v1.0      " << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  Native Waydroid / Android Container Integration       " << std::endl;
    std::cout << "========================================================" << std::endl;

    std::signal(SIGINT, sigHandler);
    std::signal(SIGTERM, sigHandler);

    // 1. Configure Compositor with dedicated socket and resolution
    EmbeddedCompositorConfig config;
    config.socketName = "wayland-linstack-0";
    config.defaultWidth = 1920;
    config.defaultHeight = 1080;

    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg == "--socket" && i + 1 < argc) {
            config.socketName = argv[++i];
        } else if (arg == "--res" && i + 1 < argc) {
            std::string resStr = argv[++i];
            size_t xPos = resStr.find('x');
            if (xPos != std::string::npos) {
                config.defaultWidth = std::stoi(resStr.substr(0, xPos));
                config.defaultHeight = std::stoi(resStr.substr(xPos + 1));
            }
        }
    }

    EmbeddedCompositor compositor(config);

    if (!compositor.initialize()) {
        std::cerr << "[Main] Fatal: Failed to initialize embedded compositor." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    if (!compositor.start()) {
        std::cerr << "[Main] Fatal: Failed to start wlroots backend." << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    // Bind EGL context to current thread
    compositor.makeCurrent();

    // 2. Initialize Hardware-Accelerated Zero-Copy Renderer
    WaylandSurfaceRenderer renderer;
    // Renderer GLES2 shader compilation
    renderer.initialize();

    // 3. Aspect Ratio and Window geometry manager
    AspectRatioWindow window(config.defaultWidth, config.defaultHeight);
    int currentWinWidth = 1280;
    int currentWinHeight = 720;
    ViewportRect viewport = window.computeViewport(currentWinWidth, currentWinHeight);

    // 4. Native Multi-Touch Input Engine
    InputMapper inputMapper(compositor.getSeat(), compositor.getRelativePointerManager());
    inputMapper.setGeometry(viewport, config.defaultWidth, config.defaultHeight);

    // Setup default game profile
    inputMapper.setupDefaultProfile();

    // 5. Connect Surface lifecycle callbacks
    compositor.onSurfaceMapped = [&](struct wlr_surface *surface) {
        std::cout << "[Main] >>> Android Surface is now ACTIVE and rendering inside viewport <<<" << std::endl;
    };

    compositor.onSurfaceUnmapped = [&](struct wlr_surface *surface) {
        (void)surface;
        std::cout << "[Main] <<< Android Surface unmapped >>>" << std::endl;
    };

    compositor.onSurfaceCommit = [&](struct wlr_surface *surface) {
        // Zero-copy render loop invocation on client commit
        renderer.clearLetterboxBars(viewport, currentWinWidth, currentWinHeight);
        if (renderer.renderSurface(surface, viewport, currentWinWidth, currentWinHeight)) {
            // Signal SurfaceFlinger that the frame has been presented
            renderer.sendFrameDone(surface);
        }
    };

    std::cout << "\n[Main] Compositor is READY." << std::endl;
    std::cout << "[Main] Socket: " << compositor.getSocketName() << std::endl;
    std::cout << "[Main] Launch container with:" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=" << compositor.getSocketName() << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  waydroid session start" << std::endl;
    std::cout << "  waydroid show-full-ui\n" << std::endl;

    // Main event loop
    while (g_running) {
        // Dispatch Wayland events (16ms = ~60 FPS polling timeout)
        compositor.dispatch(16);

        // Check if an active Android surface exists to render
        struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = compositor.getActiveSurface();
        if (activeSurface) {
            renderer.clearLetterboxBars(viewport, currentWinWidth, currentWinHeight);
            if (renderer.renderSurface(activeSurface, viewport, currentWinWidth, currentWinHeight)) {
                renderer.sendFrameDone(activeSurface);
            }
        }

        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
    }

    std::cout << "[Main] Stopping embedded compositor..." << std::endl;
    compositor.shutdown();

    return 0;
}

--- FILE: ./wlroots_engine/src/AspectRatioWindow.cpp ---
#include "AspectRatioWindow.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

AspectRatioWindow::AspectRatioWindow(int targetWidth, int targetHeight) {
    setTargetResolution(targetWidth, targetHeight);
}

AspectRatioWindow::~AspectRatioWindow() = default;

void AspectRatioWindow::setTargetResolution(int width, int height) {
    m_targetWidth = std::max(1, width);
    m_targetHeight = std::max(1, height);
    m_aspectRatio = static_cast<float>(m_targetWidth) / static_cast<float>(m_targetHeight);
}

ViewportRect AspectRatioWindow::computeViewport(int windowWidth, int windowHeight) const {
    if (windowWidth <= 0 || windowHeight <= 0) {
        return ViewportRect{0, 0, m_targetWidth, m_targetHeight};
    }

    int vpW = 0;
    int vpH = 0;

    // Compare aspect ratio of window against target aspect ratio
    if (windowWidth * m_targetHeight > windowHeight * m_targetWidth) {
        // Window is wider than target ratio -> Pillarbox (vertical bars on sides)
        vpH = windowHeight;
        vpW = static_cast<int>(std::round(vpH * (static_cast<float>(m_targetWidth) / m_targetHeight)));
    } else {
        // Window is taller than target ratio -> Letterbox (horizontal bars top & bottom)
        vpW = windowWidth;
        vpH = static_cast<int>(std::round(vpW * (static_cast<float>(m_targetHeight) / m_targetWidth)));
    }

    int vpX = (windowWidth - vpW) / 2;
    int vpY = (windowHeight - vpH) / 2;

    return ViewportRect{vpX, vpY, vpW, vpH};
}

void AspectRatioWindow::snapSizeToAspectRatio(int &inOutWidth, int &inOutHeight, bool anchorWidth) const {
    if (anchorWidth) {
        inOutHeight = static_cast<int>(std::round(inOutWidth / m_aspectRatio));
    } else {
        inOutWidth = static_cast<int>(std::round(inOutHeight * m_aspectRatio));
    }
}

bool wlr_bridge_output_configure(struct wlr_output *output, int width, int height, int refresh_hz) {
    if (!output) return false;
    struct wlr_output_state state;
    wlr_output_state_init(&state);
    wlr_output_state_set_enabled(&state, true);
    int mhz = (refresh_hz > 0 ? refresh_hz : 60) * 1000;
    wlr_output_state_set_custom_mode(&state, width, height, mhz);
    bool ok = wlr_output_commit_state(output, &state);
    wlr_output_state_finish(&state);
    return ok;
}

void wlr_bridge_seat_set_capabilities(struct wlr_seat *seat, uint32_t caps) {
    if (!seat) return;
    uint32_t wl_caps = 0;
    if (caps & WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_POINTER)  wl_caps |= WL_SEAT_CAPABILITY_POINTER;
    if (caps & WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_KEYBOARD) wl_caps |= WL_SEAT_CAPABILITY_KEYBOARD;
    if (caps & WLR_BRIDGE_SEAT_CAP_TOUCH)    wl_caps |= WL_SEAT_CAPABILITY_TOUCH;
    wlr_seat_set_capabilities(seat, wl_caps);
}

struct wlr_keyboard *wlr_bridge_virtual_keyboard_create(struct wlr_seat *seat) {
    if (!seat) return NULL;
    struct wlr_keyboard *kbd = calloc(1, sizeof(*kbd));
    if (!kbd) return NULL;

    static const struct wlr_keyboard_impl virtual_kbd_impl = {
        .name = "linstack-virtual-kbd",
        .led_update = NULL
    };
#if WLR_VERSION_MINOR >= 18
    wlr_keyboard_init(kbd, &virtual_kbd_impl, "linstack-virtual-kbd");
#else
    wlr_keyboard_init(kbd, &virtual_kbd_impl);
#endif

    struct xkb_context *ctx = xkb_context_new(XKB_CONTEXT_NO_FLAGS);
    if (ctx) {
        struct xkb_keymap *keymap = xkb_keymap_new_from_names(ctx, NULL, XKB_KEYMAP_COMPILE_NO_FLAGS);
        if (keymap) {
            wlr_keyboard_set_keymap(kbd, keymap);
            wlr_seat_set_keyboard(seat, kbd);
            xkb_keymap_unref(keymap);
        }
        xkb_context_unref(ctx);
    }
    return kbd;
}

void wlr_bridge_virtual_keyboard_destroy(struct wlr_keyboard *keyboard) {
    if (!keyboard) return;
    wlr_keyboard_finish(keyboard);
    free(keyboard);
}

void wlr_bridge_seat_touch_notify_down(struct wlr_seat *seat, struct wlr_surface *surface,
                                       uint32_t time_ms, int32_t touch_id, double sx, double sy) {

void wlr_bridge_seat_keyboard_enter(struct wlr_seat *seat, struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!seat || !surface) return;
    struct wlr_keyboard *kbd = wlr_seat_get_keyboard(seat);
    if (kbd) {
        wlr_seat_keyboard_notify_enter(seat, surface, kbd->keycodes, kbd->num_keycodes, &kbd->modifiers);
    } else {
        wlr_seat_keyboard_notify_enter(seat, surface, NULL, 0, NULL);
    }
}

        struct wlr_keyboard *kbd = wlr_seat_get_keyboard(seat);
        if (kbd) {
            wlr_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(seat, &kbd->modifiers);
        } else {
            wlr_seat_keyboard_notify_modifiers(seat, NULL);
        }
    }
}

        if (w) *w = 0;
        if (h) *h = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (w) *w = surface->current.width;
    if (h) *h = surface->current.height;
}

void wlr_bridge_surface_send_frame_done(struct wlr_surface *surface) {
    if (!surface) return;
    struct timespec now;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
    wlr_surface_send_frame_done(surface, &now);
}

bool wlr_bridge_surface_get_dmabuf(struct wlr_surface *surface, struct wlr_bridge_dmabuf_attribs *out) {
    if (!surface || !surface->buffer || !out) return false;
    struct wlr_dmabuf_attributes dmabuf = {0};
    if (!wlr_buffer_get_dmabuf(&surface->buffer->base, &dmabuf)) {
        return false;
    }
    out->width = dmabuf.width;
    out->height = dmabuf.height;
    out->format = dmabuf.format;
    out->modifier = dmabuf.modifier;
    out->n_planes = dmabuf.n_planes;
    for (int i = 0; i < dmabuf.n_planes && i < 4; ++i) {
        out->offset[i] = (int)dmabuf.offset[i];
        out->stride[i] = (int)dmabuf.stride[i];
        out->fd[i] = dmabuf.fd[i];
    }
    return true;
}

bool wlr_bridge_texture_is_gles2(struct wlr_texture *texture) {
    if (!texture) return false;
    return wlr_texture_is_gles2(texture);
}

void wlr_bridge_texture_get_size(struct wlr_texture *texture, int *w, int *h) {
    if (!texture) {
        if (w) *w = 0;
        if (h) *h = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (w) *w = (int)texture->width;
    if (h) *h = (int)texture->height;
}

bool wlr_bridge_gles2_texture_get_attribs(struct wlr_texture *texture, uint32_t *target, uint32_t *tex) {
    if (!texture || !wlr_texture_is_gles2(texture)) return false;
    struct wlr_gles2_texture_attribs attribs;
    wlr_gles2_texture_get_attribs(texture, &attribs);
    if (target) *target = attribs.target;
    if (tex) *tex = attribs.tex;
    return true;
}

bool wlr_bridge_texture_read_pixels(struct wlr_texture *texture, uint32_t drm_format, uint32_t stride, void *data) {
    if (!texture || !data) return false;
    struct wlr_texture_read_pixels_options opts = {
        .format = drm_format,
        .stride = stride,
        .data = data
    };
    return wlr_texture_read_pixels(texture, &opts);
}
