#include "DiagnosticsEngine.h"
#include "Logger.h"
#include "PathResolver.h"

#include <QFileInfo>
#include <QDir>
#include <QProcess>
#include <QTcpSocket>
#include <QStorageInfo>
#include <QStandardPaths>
#include <QElapsedTimer>
#include <QTextStream>

QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> HealthReport::failedChecks() const
{
    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> list;
    for (const auto &c : checks) {
        if (c.status == CheckStatus::Failed) list.append(c);
    }
    return list;
}

QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> HealthReport::warningChecks() const
{
    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> list;
    for (const auto &c : checks) {
        if (c.status == CheckStatus::Warning) list.append(c);
    }
    return list;
}

QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> HealthReport::autoHealableChecks() const
{
    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> list;
    for (const auto &c : checks) {
        if (c.status != CheckStatus::Passed && c.canAutoHeal) list.append(c);
    }
    return list;
}

QString HealthReport::formatReport() const
{
    QStringList out;
    out << QString("=== LinStack Health Diagnostic Report [%1] ===")
               .arg(timestamp.toString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"));
    out << QString("Overall Status: %1").arg(isHealthy ? "HEALTHY" : (hasCriticalFailures ? "CRITICAL" : "DEGRADED"));

    for (const auto &c : checks) {
        QString st = (c.status == CheckStatus::Passed) ? "PASS"
                     : (c.status == CheckStatus::Warning) ? "WARN" : "FAIL";
        out << QString("[%1] %2 (%3): %4").arg(st, c.id, c.name, c.details);
        if (!c.errorCode.isEmpty() && c.status != CheckStatus::Passed) {
            out << QString("       ErrorCode: %1 | Fix: %2").arg(c.errorCode, c.remediationHint);
        }
    }
    return out.join("\n");
}

// ── DiagnosticsWorker Implementation ─────────────────────────────────────────

void DiagnosticsWorker::performChecks()
{
    HealthReport report;
    report.timestamp = QDateTime::currentDateTime();

    LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", "Beginning system health check pipeline...");
    emit progressUpdated(5, "Checking Linux kernel binder modules...");

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 1. Kernel Module Inspection
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "KERNEL_BINDER";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::KernelModule;
        r.name = "Android Binder Driver (/dev/binder)";
        r.canAutoHeal = true;
        r.requiresElevation = true;

        bool devBinder = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binder");
        bool devBinderfs = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binderfs/binder");
        bool vndBinder = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/vndbinder") || QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binderfs/vndbinder");
        bool hwBinder = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/hwbinder") || QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binderfs/hwbinder");

        // Check if binderfs filesystem is supported directly by kernel (e.g. built-in on Fedora)
        bool binderfsBuiltin = false;
        QFile fsFile("/proc/filesystems");
        if (fsFile.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
            binderfsBuiltin = fsFile.readAll().contains("binder");
        }

        // Check /proc/modules for binder_linux
        bool moduleLoaded = false;
        QFile modFile("/proc/modules");
        if (modFile.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
            QString content = modFile.readAll();
            moduleLoaded = content.contains("binder_linux") || content.contains("binder");
        }

        if (devBinderfs || (devBinder && vndBinder && hwBinder)) {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
            r.details = QString("Binder IPC nodes active (%1). FS: %2")
                            .arg(devBinderfs ? "binderfs" : "dev", devBinderfs ? "/dev/binderfs" : "/dev");
            LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else if (devBinder) {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
            r.details = "Binder IPC node active at /dev/binder.";
            LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else if (binderfsBuiltin) {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            r.errorCode = "WARN_BINDERFS_UNMOUNTED";
            r.details = "Kernel has built-in binderfs support, but /dev/binderfs is not mounted.";
            r.remediationHint = "mkdir -p /dev/binderfs && mount -t binder binder /dev/binderfs";
            LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Failed;
            r.errorCode = "ERR_BINDER_MISSING";
            r.details = moduleLoaded
                ? "Kernel module binder_linux is loaded but /dev/binderfs is not mounted."
                : "Kernel binder driver is not loaded (/dev/binder and /dev/binderfs missing).";
            r.remediationHint = "modprobe binder_linux devices=binder,hwbinder,vndbinder || (mkdir -p /dev/binderfs && mount -t binder binder /dev/binderfs)";
            LOG_FAULT("Diagnostics", r.errorCode, r.details, r.remediationHint);
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }
    emit progressUpdated(25, "Inspecting binder permissions...");

    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "BINDER_PERMISSIONS";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::KernelModule;
        r.name = "Binder Node Permissions";
        r.canAutoHeal = true;
        r.requiresElevation = true;

        QString targetNode = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binderfs/binder") ? "/dev/binderfs/binder" : "/dev/binder";
        if (QFileInfo::exists(targetNode)) {
            QFileInfo fi(targetNode);
            if (fi.isReadable() && fi.isWritable()) {
                r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
                r.details = QString("%1 has full read/write permissions for current process.").arg(targetNode);
                LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
            } else {
                r.status = CheckStatus::Failed;
                r.errorCode = "ERR_BINDER_PERMISSIONS";
                r.details = QString("Insufficient permissions on %1. Android container cannot map IPC.").arg(targetNode);
                r.remediationHint = QString("chmod 0666 %1").arg(targetNode);
                LOG_FAULT("Diagnostics", r.errorCode, r.details, r.remediationHint);
            }
        } else {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            r.errorCode = "WARN_BINDER_NOT_FOUND";
            r.details = "Skipped permission check; binder node not present.";
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }
    emit progressUpdated(40, "Querying container systemd service & sockets...");

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 2. Service & Socket Health
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "CONTAINER_SERVICE";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::ServiceSocket;
        r.name = "Container Daemon Service";
        r.canAutoHeal = true;
        r.requiresElevation = true;

        // Query systemctl is-active
        QProcess proc;
        proc.start("systemctl", QStringList() << "is-active" << "linstack-container.service");
        bool finished = proc.waitForFinished(2000);
        QString statusOut = finished ? QString::fromUtf8(proc.readAllStandardOutput()).trimmed() : "timeout";

        if (statusOut == "active") {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
            r.details = "linstack-container.service is active and running.";
            LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else {
            // Check fallback linstack-container
            QProcess procFallback;
            procFallback.start("systemctl", QStringList() << "is-active" << "linstack-container.service");
            if (procFallback.waitForFinished(1500) && procFallback.readAllStandardOutput().trimmed() == "active") {
                r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
                r.details = "Container daemon is active under linstack-container service.";
                LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
            } else {
                r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
                r.errorCode = "WARN_CONTAINER_SERVICE_STOPPED";
                r.details = QString("Container service status: '%1'. Service is currently idle or stopped.").arg(statusOut);
                r.remediationHint = "systemctl restart linstack-container.service";
                LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
            }
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }
    emit progressUpdated(55, "Testing ADB daemon socket connection...");

    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "ADB_SOCKET";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::ServiceSocket;
        r.name = "ADB Daemon TCP Socket (127.0.0.1:5555)";
        r.canAutoHeal = true;
        r.requiresElevation = false;

        QTcpSocket socket;
        socket.connectToHost("127.0.0.1", 5555);
        if (socket.waitForConnected(1200)) {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
            r.details = "Successfully connected to Android ADB daemon at 127.0.0.1:5555.";
            socket.disconnectFromHost();
            LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            r.errorCode = "WARN_ADB_UNREACHABLE";
            r.details = "ADB daemon socket not responding on 127.0.0.1:5555. APK installation and adb shell may be delayed.";
            r.remediationHint = "adb connect 127.0.0.1:5555";
            LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }
    emit progressUpdated(70, "Verifying container rootfs & overlay storage...");

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 3. Container Rootfs & Overlay Integrity
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "ROOTFS_OVERLAY";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::ContainerRootfs;
        r.name = "Container Storage & Overlay Rootfs";
        r.canAutoHeal = true;
        r.requiresElevation = false;

        QString userStorage = PathResolver::userDataDir();
        bool created = QDir().mkpath(userStorage);
        QFileInfo userFi(userStorage);

        if (!userFi.isWritable() || !created) {
            // Check fallback to /tmp or current directory if home is read-only
            QString altStorage = "/tmp/LinStack";
            QDir().mkpath(altStorage);
            QFileInfo altFi(altStorage);
            if (altFi.isWritable()) {
                r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
                r.errorCode = "WARN_STORAGE_FALLBACK";
                r.details = QString("Default storage %1 is read-only; using fallback storage %2.").arg(userStorage, altStorage);
                r.remediationHint = QString("mkdir -p %1 && chmod u+rwx %1").arg(userStorage);
                LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
            } else {
                r.status = CheckStatus::Failed;
                r.errorCode = "ERR_STORAGE_PERMISSIONS";
                r.details = QString("User storage directory %1 is not writable.").arg(userStorage);
                r.remediationHint = QString("chmod u+rwx %1").arg(userStorage);
                LOG_FAULT("Diagnostics", r.errorCode, r.details, r.remediationHint);
            }
        } else {
            QStorageInfo storage(userStorage);
            qint64 freeGb = storage.bytesAvailable() / (1024 * 1024 * 1024);
            if (freeGb < 1) {
                r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
                r.errorCode = "WARN_LOW_DISK_SPACE";
                r.details = QString("Low disk space: %1 GB remaining on volume. Android images may fail to expand.").arg(freeGb);
                r.remediationHint = "Free up disk space on the root filesystem.";
                LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
            } else {
                r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
                r.details = QString("Rootfs storage writable. Available volume space: %1 GB.").arg(freeGb);
                LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
            }
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }

    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "ANDROID_IMAGES";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::ContainerRootfs;
        r.name = "Android System & Vendor Images";
        r.canAutoHeal = false;
        r.requiresElevation = false;

        QString sysImg = PathResolver::resolveResource("system.img");
        if (QFileInfo::exists(sysImg)) {
            qint64 sizeMb = QFileInfo(sysImg).size() / (1024 * 1024);
            r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
            r.details = QString("Located system.img at %1 (%2 MB).").arg(sysImg).arg(sizeMb);
            LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            r.errorCode = "WARN_IMAGES_NOT_FOUND";
            r.details = QString("system.img not yet found in %1 or standard system paths.").arg(PathResolver::resolveResourcesDir());
            r.remediationHint = "Place system.img & vendor.img in resources/ or /usr/share/linstack/resources/";
            LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }

    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "LINSTACK_CONFIG";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::ContainerRootfs;
        r.name = "LinStack Daemon Configuration (/var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg)";
        r.canAutoHeal = true;
        r.requiresElevation = true;

        QFile cfgFile("/var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg");
        if (!cfgFile.exists()) {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            r.errorCode = "WARN_CONFIG_MISSING";
            r.details = "System configuration /var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg does not exist. First-time initialization required.";
            r.remediationHint = QString("linstack init -f -i %1").arg(PathResolver::resolveResourcesDir());
            LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else if (cfgFile.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
            QString configuredPath;
            while (!cfgFile.atEnd()) {
                QString line = QString::fromUtf8(cfgFile.readLine()).trimmed();
                if (line.startsWith("images_path")) {
                    configuredPath = line.section('=', 1, 1).trimmed();
                    break;
                }
            }
            cfgFile.close();

            bool imgValid = !configuredPath.isEmpty() && QFileInfo::exists(configuredPath + "/system.img");
            if (imgValid) {
                r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
                r.details = QString("Configured images_path points to valid image directory: %1").arg(configuredPath);
                LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
            } else {
                r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
                r.errorCode = "WARN_CONFIG_IMAGES_STALE";
                r.details = QString("Configured images_path '%1' does not contain system.img. Needs synchronization to %2")
                                .arg(configuredPath, PathResolver::resolveResourcesDir());
                r.remediationHint = QString("sed -i 's|images_path = .*|images_path = %1|' /var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg")
                                        .arg(PathResolver::resolveResourcesDir());
                LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
            }
        } else {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            r.errorCode = "WARN_CONFIG_UNREADABLE";
            r.details = "Could not open /var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg for reading.";
            r.remediationHint = "chmod 0644 /var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg";
            LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }
    emit progressUpdated(85, "Checking display environment and window surfaces...");

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // 4. Display & Window Surface Check
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "DISPLAY_SURFACE";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::DisplaySurface;
        r.name = "Compositor & Wayland Display Protocol";
        r.canAutoHeal = false;
        r.requiresElevation = false;

        QString waylandDisp = qEnvironmentVariable("WAYLAND_DISPLAY");
        QString x11Disp = qEnvironmentVariable("DISPLAY");
        QString sessionType = qEnvironmentVariable("XDG_SESSION_TYPE");

        if (waylandDisp.isEmpty() && x11Disp.isEmpty()) {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Failed;
            r.errorCode = "ERR_DISPLAY_NOT_FOUND";
            r.details = "Neither WAYLAND_DISPLAY nor DISPLAY is set. Cannot bind Android graphics output.";
            r.remediationHint = "Start LinStack inside an active desktop session.";
            LOG_CRITICAL("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
            r.details = QString("Active Display: Session=%1 | Wayland=%2 | X11=%3")
                            .arg(sessionType.isEmpty() ? "auto" : sessionType)
                            .arg(waylandDisp.isEmpty() ? "none" : waylandDisp)
                            .arg(x11Disp.isEmpty() ? "none" : x11Disp);
            LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }

    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "SURFACE_EMBED_WMCTRL";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::DisplaySurface;
        r.name = "Window Embedding Subsystem (wmctrl)";
        r.canAutoHeal = false;
        r.requiresElevation = false;

        QString wmctrlPath = QStandardPaths::findExecutable("wmctrl");
        if (!wmctrlPath.isEmpty()) {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
            r.details = QString("wmctrl helper is installed at %1 for surface detection.").arg(wmctrlPath);
            LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            r.errorCode = "WARN_WMCTRL_MISSING";
            r.details = "wmctrl binary not found in PATH. In-frame surface discovery may rely on native Wayland foreign toplevel.";
            r.remediationHint = "sudo apt install wmctrl || sudo dnf install wmctrl";
            LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }

    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "RAW_MOUSE_INPUT";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::KernelModule;
        r.name = "Raw Mouse Input (/dev/input/mice)";
        r.canAutoHeal = true;
        r.requiresElevation = true;

        QFileInfo miceInfo("/dev/input/mice");
        if (miceInfo.exists() && miceInfo.isReadable()) {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
            r.details = "Raw mouse device (/dev/input/mice) is readable for zero-latency 1:1 Aim Lock.";
            LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            r.errorCode = "WARN_RAW_MOUSE_PERMISSIONS";
            r.details = "Raw mouse device (/dev/input/mice) lacks read permission. Aim Lock may feel jittery on Wayland.";
            r.remediationHint = "chmod 0666 /dev/input/mice";
            LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }

    {
        DiagnosticCheckResult r;
        r.id = "POLKIT_ELEVATION";
        r.category = DiagnosticCategory::ServiceSocket;
        r.name = "PolicyKit Elevation Agent (pkexec / polkit)";
        r.canAutoHeal = false;
        r.requiresElevation = false;

        QString pkexecPath = QStandardPaths::findExecutable("pkexec");
        if (pkexecPath.isEmpty()) {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            r.errorCode = "WARN_PKEXEC_MISSING";
            r.details = "pkexec binary not found in PATH. Container graphical elevation will fallback to terminal sudo.";
            r.remediationHint = "Install polkit (e.g. sudo apt install polkitd pkexec || sudo dnf install polkit)";
            LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", r.details);
        } else {
            r.status = CheckStatus::Passed;
            r.details = QString("Found pkexec at %1 for privileged operations.").arg(pkexecPath);
            LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", r.details);
        }
        report.checks.append(r);
        emit checkCompleted(r);
    }

    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Finalize report
    // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    emit progressUpdated(100, "Diagnostics complete.");

    report.hasCriticalFailures = !report.failedChecks().isEmpty();
    report.hasWarnings = !report.warningChecks().isEmpty();
    report.isHealthy = !report.hasCriticalFailures;

    if (report.hasCriticalFailures) {
        report.summary = QString("Diagnostic found %1 critical fault(s) and %2 warning(s).")
                             .arg(report.failedChecks().size())
                             .arg(report.warningChecks().size());
    } else if (report.hasWarnings) {
        report.summary = QString("Diagnostics passed with %1 warning(s). System is functional.")
                             .arg(report.warningChecks().size());
    } else {
        report.summary = "All subsystems, kernel modules, sockets, and storage checks passed successfully.";
    }

    LOG_INFO("Diagnostics", report.summary);
    emit diagnosticsFinished(report);
}

// ── DiagnosticsEngine Implementation ─────────────────────────────────────────

DiagnosticsEngine::DiagnosticsEngine(QObject *parent)
    : QObject(parent)
{
}

DiagnosticsEngine::~DiagnosticsEngine()
{
    if (m_workerThread && m_workerThread->isRunning()) {
        m_workerThread->quit();
        m_workerThread->wait(1000);
    }
}

void DiagnosticsEngine::runDiagnosticsAsync()
{
    if (m_isRunning) {
        LOG_WARN("Diagnostics", "Diagnostics already running in background.");
        return;
    }

    m_isRunning = true;

    if (m_workerThread) {
        m_workerThread->quit();
        m_workerThread->wait();
        delete m_workerThread;
    }

    m_workerThread = new QThread(this);
    m_worker = new DiagnosticsWorker();
    m_worker->moveToThread(m_workerThread);

    connect(m_workerThread, &QThread::started, m_worker, &DiagnosticsWorker::performChecks);
    connect(m_worker, &DiagnosticsWorker::progressUpdated, this, &DiagnosticsEngine::progressUpdated);
    connect(m_worker, &DiagnosticsWorker::checkCompleted, this, &DiagnosticsEngine::checkCompleted);
    connect(m_worker, &DiagnosticsWorker::diagnosticsFinished, this, &DiagnosticsEngine::handleDiagnosticsFinished);

    // Clean up worker after thread finishes
    connect(m_workerThread, &QThread::finished, m_worker, &QObject::deleteLater);

    m_workerThread->start();
}

void DiagnosticsEngine::handleDiagnosticsFinished(const HealthReport &report)
{
    m_latestReport = report;
    m_isRunning = false;

    if (m_workerThread && m_workerThread->isRunning()) {
        m_workerThread->quit();
    }

    emit diagnosticsFinished(report);
}

HealthReport DiagnosticsEngine::runDiagnosticsSync()
{
    DiagnosticsWorker worker;
    HealthReport resultReport;

    connect(&worker, &DiagnosticsWorker::diagnosticsFinished, this,
            [&resultReport](const HealthReport &rep) {
        resultReport = rep;
    });

    worker.performChecks();
    m_latestReport = resultReport;
    return resultReport;
}

MainWindow::MainWindow(QWidget *parent)
    : QMainWindow(parent)
{
    setWindowFlags(Qt::Window | Qt::FramelessWindowHint);
    setMouseTracking(true);
    setAttribute(Qt::WA_Hover, true);

    setStyleSheet(Theme::cyberEmeraldStyleSheet());

    setupUi();
    qApp->installEventFilter(this);

    QSize scrSize(1440, 900);
    QRect availRect(0, 0, 1440, 900);
    if (QScreen *scr = screen() ? screen() : QGuiApplication::primaryScreen()) {
        if (scr->size().width() > 0 && scr->size().height() > 0) {
            scrSize = scr->size();
        }
        availRect = scr->availableGeometry();
    }

    // قراءة الأبعاد الفعلية للشريط الجانبي والعلوي + 2px للإطار الخارجي
    const int sideW = (m_sideToolBar && m_sideToolBar->width() > 0) ? m_sideToolBar->width() : 46;
    const int topH  = (m_titleBar && m_titleBar->height() > 0) ? m_titleBar->height() : 48;
    const int chromeW = sideW + 2;
    const int chromeH = topH + 2;
    const double scrAr = static_cast<double>(scrSize.width()) / static_cast<double>(scrSize.height());

    // 1. حد تصغير النافذة = نصف أبعاد شاشة المستخدم (1/2) للعرض الصافي + أبعاد الشريطين
    int minNetW = scrSize.width() / 2;
    int minNetH = qRound(minNetW / scrAr);
    setMinimumSize(minNetW + chromeW, minNetH + chromeH);

    // 2. حجم الإقلاع الابتدائي = ثلثي أبعاد شاشة المستخدم (2/3) للعرض الصافي (Android Canvas)
    int targetNetW = (scrSize.width() * 2) / 3;
    int targetNetH = qRound(targetNetW / scrAr);

    // التأكد من أن (العرض الصافي + الشريطين) لا يتجاوز المساحة المتاحة من سطح المكتب حتى لا يضغطه مدير النوافذ
    int maxAllowedNetW = availRect.width() - chromeW;
    int maxAllowedNetH = availRect.height() - chromeH;
    if (targetNetW > maxAllowedNetW) {
        targetNetW = maxAllowedNetW;
        targetNetH = qRound(targetNetW / scrAr);
    }
    if (targetNetH > maxAllowedNetH) {
        targetNetH = maxAllowedNetH;
        targetNetW = qRound(targetNetH * scrAr);
    }

    // الحجم الإجمالي للنافذة = أبعاد الأندرويد الصافية + أبعاد الشريط العلوي والجانبي
    int targetW = targetNetW + chromeW;
    int targetH = targetNetH + chromeH;

    resize(targetW, targetH);

    QTimer::singleShot(50, this, [this, scrSize, scrAr, availRect]() {
        if (!isFullScreen() && !isMaximized()) {
            // إعادة القراءة الفعلية بعد اكتمال رسم التخطيط لضمان دقة البكسل
            int realChromeW = (m_sideToolBar ? m_sideToolBar->width() : 46) + 2;
            int realChromeH = (m_titleBar ? m_titleBar->height() : 48) + 2;

            int minW = scrSize.width() / 2;
            int minH = qRound(minW / scrAr);
            setMinimumSize(minW + realChromeW, minH + realChromeH);

            int netW = (scrSize.width() * 2) / 3;
            int netH = qRound(netW / scrAr);

            int maxNetW = availRect.width() - realChromeW;
            int maxNetH = availRect.height() - realChromeH;
            if (netW > maxNetW) { netW = maxNetW; netH = qRound(netW / scrAr); }
            if (netH > maxNetH) { netH = maxNetH; netW = qRound(netH * scrAr); }

            int finalW = netW + realChromeW;
            int finalH = netH + realChromeH;

            resize(finalW, finalH);
            move(availRect.x() + (availRect.width() - finalW) / 2,
                 availRect.y() + (availRect.height() - finalH) / 2);
            LOG_INFO("UI", QString("Startup window size enforced: %1x%2 (Android Viewport: %3x%4 | Chrome: %5x%6)")
                .arg(finalW).arg(finalH).arg(netW).arg(netH).arg(realChromeW).arg(realChromeH));
        }
    });
}

MainWindow::~MainWindow()
{
    if (m_service) {
        delete m_service;
        m_service = nullptr;
    }
}

QSize MainWindow::calculateNetViewportSize() const
{
    int topBarHeight = m_titleBar ? m_titleBar->height() : 48;
    int sideBarWidth = m_sideToolBar ? m_sideToolBar->width() : 46;
    // Account for central container border (1px on left/right/top/bottom)
    int netW = width() - sideBarWidth - 2;
    int netH = height() - topBarHeight - 2;
    if (netW <= 0) netW = 1280;
    if (netH <= 0) netH = 720;
    return QSize(netW, netH);
}

{

    contentLayout->setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0);
    contentLayout->setSpacing(0);

    contentLayout->addWidget(m_canvas, 1);

    // Right Side Toolbar (MSI App Player layout)
    m_sideToolBar = new SideToolBar(contentWidget);
    contentLayout->addWidget(m_sideToolBar);

    mainLayout->addWidget(contentWidget, 1);

    setCentralWidget(centralContainer);

    // --- TitleBar Connections ---
    connect(m_titleBar, &TitleBar::minimizeRequested, this, &MainWindow::showMinimized);
    connect(m_titleBar, &TitleBar::maximizeRequested, this, &MainWindow::handleMaximizeToggle);
    connect(m_titleBar, &TitleBar::maximizeToggled, this, &MainWindow::handleMaximizeToggle);
    connect(m_titleBar, &TitleBar::closeRequested, this, &MainWindow::close);
    connect(m_titleBar, &TitleBar::windowDragged, this, &MainWindow::handleWindowDrag);
    connect(m_titleBar, &TitleBar::helpRequested, this, &MainWindow::handleHelp);
    connect(m_titleBar, &TitleBar::searchTriggered, this, &MainWindow::handleSearch);
    connect(m_titleBar, &TitleBar::restartSessionRequested, this, [this]() {
        if (m_service) {
            m_canvas->showToast("🔄 Restarting LinStack session...", 3000);
            m_service->stopSession();
            QTimer::singleShot(1200, m_service, &LinstackService::startSession);
        }
    });
    connect(m_titleBar, &TitleBar::restartContainerRequested, this, [this]() {
        if (m_service) {
            m_canvas->showToast("⚡ Restarting Android container service...", 3500);
            m_service->stopSession();
            m_service->restartContainerService();
            QTimer::singleShot(3000, m_service, &LinstackService::startSession);
        }
    });

    // --- Side Toolbar Connections ---
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::fullscreenClicked, this, &MainWindow::handleFullscreenToggle);
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::volumeUpClicked, this, [this]() {
        m_canvas->sendWaylandSystemKey(115); // KEY_VOLUMEUP
        m_canvas->showToast("🔊 Volume Up");
    });
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::volumeDownClicked, this, [this]() {
        m_canvas->sendWaylandSystemKey(114); // KEY_VOLUMEDOWN
        m_canvas->showToast("🔉 Volume Down");
    });
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::keymapperToggled, this, &MainWindow::handleKeymapperToggle);
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::keymapperEditRequested, this, &MainWindow::handleKeymapperEdit);
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::macroClicked, this, [this]() {

        m_canvas->showToast("⏺ Macro Automation: Recording gameplay action sequence...");
    });
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::rotateClicked, this, &MainWindow::handleRotate);
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::ecoModeToggled, this, &MainWindow::handleEcoModeToggle);
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::installApkClicked, this, &MainWindow::handleInstallApk);
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::screenshotClicked, this, &MainWindow::handleScreenshot);
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::fileManagerClicked, this, &MainWindow::handleSharedStorage);
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::ramTrimClicked, this, &MainWindow::handleRamTrim);
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::multiInstanceClicked, this, [this]() {
        m_canvas->showToast("📑 Multi-Instance Manager: Managing LXC LinStack clones...");
    });
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::settingsClicked, this, &MainWindow::handleSettings);

    // Android navigation buttons - sending native Wayland wl_keyboard system keys directly to Android
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::androidBackClicked, this, [this]() {
        m_canvas->sendWaylandSystemKey(158); // KEY_BACK
        m_canvas->showToast("◁ Android Back");
    });
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::androidHomeClicked, this, [this]() {
        m_canvas->sendWaylandSystemKey(172); // KEY_HOMEPAGE
        m_canvas->showToast("◯ Android Home");
    });
    connect(m_sideToolBar, &SideToolBar::androidRecentsClicked, this, [this]() {
        m_canvas->sendWaylandRecents(); // Alt+Tab Android Overview
        m_canvas->showToast("▢ Android Recents");
    });

    // APK dropped directly onto canvas
    connect(m_canvas, &AndroidCanvas::apkDropped, this, [this](const QString &path) {
        if (m_service) {
            m_service->installApk(path);
        }
    });

    connect(m_canvas, &AndroidCanvas::firstFrameRendered, this, [this]() {
        m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("Session Active", true);
        if (m_service) {
            m_service->setHasFirstFrame(true);
        }
        if (!m_pendingLaunchPackage.isEmpty()) {
            QString pkg = m_pendingLaunchPackage;
            m_pendingLaunchPackage.clear();
            m_canvas->launchAndEmbedApp(pkg, pkg);
        }
    });

    connect(m_canvas, &AndroidCanvas::waylandClientConnected, this, [this]() {
        LOG_INFO("MainWindow", "Wayland client connected -> applying Android display props & launching UI...");
        if (m_service) {
            QSize scr(1440, 900);
            if (QScreen *s = screen() ? screen() : QGuiApplication::primaryScreen()) {
                if (s->size().width() > 0 && s->size().height() > 0) scr = s->size();
            }
            m_service->setDesiredResolution(scr.width(), scr.height());
            // تنفيذ أوامر linstack prop set الآن بعد جاهزية waydroidplatform
            // تأخير بسيط (1.5 ثانية) حتى يستقر SurfaceFlinger قبل تحديث الخصائص عبر Binder
            QTimer::singleShot(1500, this, [this, scr]() {
                QString widthStr = QString::number(scr.width());
                QString heightStr = QString::number(scr.height());

                PathResolver::startDetachedLinstack(QStringList() << "prop" << "set" << "persist.linstack.width" << widthStr);
                PathResolver::startDetachedLinstack(QStringList() << "prop" << "set" << "persist.linstack.height" << heightStr);
                PathResolver::startDetachedLinstack(QStringList() << "prop" << "set" << "persist.waydroid.width" << widthStr);
                PathResolver::startDetachedLinstack(QStringList() << "prop" << "set" << "persist.waydroid.height" << heightStr);

                if (!m_pendingLaunchPackage.isEmpty()) {
                    QString pkg = m_pendingLaunchPackage;
                    m_pendingLaunchPackage.clear();
                    m_canvas->launchAndEmbedApp(pkg, pkg);
                }
            });
            m_service->launchFullUi();
        }
    });

    connect(m_canvas, &AndroidCanvas::appLaunchRequested, this, [this](const QString &pkg, const QString &name) {
        Q_UNUSED(pkg);
        Q_UNUSED(name);
        if (m_service) {
            m_service->startSession();
        }
    });

    // --- Background Service Initialization & Wiring ---
    m_service = new LinstackService(this);

    // قراءة أبعاد شاشة المستخدم الفعلية وحساب نسبة الأبعاد لتمريرها للأندرويد قبل الإقلاع
    QSize androidRes(1920, 1080);
    if (QScreen *scr = QGuiApplication::primaryScreen()) {
        if (scr->size().width() > 0 && scr->size().height() > 0) {
            androidRes = scr->size();
        }
    }

    // Initialize uinput touch bridge for low-latency LinStack input
    m_uinputBridge = new UInputTouchBridge(this);
    m_uinputBridge->initialize(androidRes.width(), androidRes.height());
    m_canvas->setBridge(m_uinputBridge);

    // Lock canvas aspect-ratio to match user screen resolution (e.g. 16:9 or 16:10)
    m_canvas->setBaseResolution(androidRes.width(), androidRes.height());
    m_service->setDesiredResolution(androidRes.width(), androidRes.height());

    connect(m_service, &LinstackService::containerStateChanged, this, [this](LinstackService::ContainerState state) {
        if (state == LinstackService::ContainerState::Running) {
            m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("LinStack Running", true);
        } else if (state == LinstackService::ContainerState::Starting) {
            m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("Container Starting...", false);
        } else {
            m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("Container Inactive", false);
        }
    });

    connect(m_service, &LinstackService::sessionStateChanged, this, [this](LinstackService::SessionState state) {
        if (state == LinstackService::SessionState::Active) {
            m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("Session Active", true);
            m_canvas->showToast("LinStack Android session is active and running.");
        } else if (state == LinstackService::SessionState::Starting) {
            m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("Session Starting...", false);
            m_canvas->showToast("Spawning LinStack session process...");
        } else if (state == LinstackService::SessionState::Terminated) {
            m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("Session Stopped", false);
            m_canvas->showToast("LinStack session terminated.");
        }
    });

    connect(m_service, &LinstackService::adbConnectionStatusChanged, this, [this](bool connected) {
        if (connected) {
            m_canvas->showToast("ADB Bridge Active: Connected to 127.0.0.1:5555");
        }
    });

    connect(m_service, &LinstackService::waylandCompositorRestartRequested, this, [this]() {
        LOG_WARN("MainWindow", "Service requested Wayland compositor restart -> reinitializing Wayland socket...");
        if (m_canvas) {
            m_canvas->initWaylandCompositor();
        }
    });

    connect(m_service, &LinstackService::apkInstallStarted, this, [this](const QString &apkPath) {
        QFileInfo fi(apkPath);
        m_canvas->showToast(QString("Installing %1 via LinStack...").arg(fi.fileName()), 3000);
    });

    connect(m_service, &LinstackService::apkInstallProgress, this, [this](const QString &apkPath, int percent, const QString &status) {
        Q_UNUSED(apkPath);
        if (percent > 0 && percent < 100) {
            m_canvas->showToast(QString("Installing APK [%1%]: %2").arg(percent).arg(status), 2000);
        }
    });

    connect(m_service, &LinstackService::apkInstallFinished, this, [this](const QString &apkPath, bool success, const QString &msg) {
        Q_UNUSED(apkPath);
        m_canvas->showToast(success ? QString("✔ %1").arg(msg) : QString("❌ Install Failed: %1").arg(msg), 4000);
    });

    connect(m_service, &LinstackService::errorOccurred, this, [this](LinstackService::ServiceError err, const QString &msg, const QStringList &remediation) {
        Q_UNUSED(err);
        QString tip = remediation.isEmpty() ? "" : QString("\nRemediation: %1").arg(remediation.first());
        m_canvas->showToast(QString("⚠️ Service Alert: %1 %2").arg(msg).arg(tip), 5000);
    });

    // Initialize proactive Diagnostic & Self-Healing Engine
    m_healer = new SelfHealingManager(this);
    connect(m_healer, &SelfHealingManager::diagnosticsFinished, this, [this](const HealthReport &report) {
        if (report.isHealthy) {
            m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("LinStack Ready", true);
            m_canvas->showToast("✔ LinStack subsystems & kernel modules verified healthy.", 2500);
            if (m_service && m_service->sessionState() == LinstackService::SessionState::Idle) {
                m_service->startSession();
            }
        } else if (!report.hasCriticalFailures) {
            m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("System Warnings", false);
            m_canvas->showToast(QString("Notice: %1").arg(report.summary), 4000);
            if (m_service && m_service->sessionState() == LinstackService::SessionState::Idle) {
                m_service->startSession();
            }
        } else {
            m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("Diagnostic Alert", false);
        }
    });

    // First-run container check: if container is not initialized, show native Qt wizard
    if (!isContainerInitialized()) {
        LOG_INFO("Core", "First-run: LinStack container is not initialized. Launching native Qt Initialization Wizard...");
        QTimer::singleShot(250, this, &MainWindow::promptFirstTimeInitialization);
    } else {
        // Start Android container session immediately if already initialized
        if (m_service && m_service->sessionState() == LinstackService::SessionState::Idle) {
            m_service->startSession();
        }
        QTimer::singleShot(3500, this, [this]() {
            LOG_INFO("Core", "Initiating background diagnostic check...");
            m_healer->startDiagnosticsAsync(true, this);
        });
    }
}

bool MainWindow::isContainerInitialized() const
{
    // Container is initialized when /var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg exists AND system.img & vendor.img exist
    if (!QFileInfo::exists("/var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg")) {
        return false;
    }

    bool sysVar = QFileInfo::exists("/var/lib/linstack/images/system.img") && QFileInfo("/var/lib/linstack/images/system.img").size() > 0;
    bool vndVar = QFileInfo::exists("/var/lib/linstack/images/vendor.img") && QFileInfo("/var/lib/linstack/images/vendor.img").size() > 0;
    if (sysVar && vndVar) {
        return true;
    }

    QString resDir = PathResolver::resolveResourcesDir();
    bool sysRes = QFileInfo::exists(resDir + "/system.img") && QFileInfo(resDir + "/system.img").size() > 0;
    bool vndRes = QFileInfo::exists(resDir + "/vendor.img") && QFileInfo(resDir + "/vendor.img").size() > 0;
    return (sysRes && vndRes);
}

void MainWindow::promptFirstTimeInitialization()
{
    InitializationDialog dlg(this);
    if (dlg.exec() == QDialog::Accepted) {
        LOG_INFO("Core", "First-run container initialization completed successfully. Booting Android session...");
        m_canvas->showToast("Initialization complete. Booting LinStack...", 3000);
        if (m_service && m_service->sessionState() == LinstackService::SessionState::Idle) {
            m_service->startSession();
        }
        QTimer::singleShot(4000, this, [this]() {
            if (m_healer) {
                m_healer->startDiagnosticsAsync(true, this);
            }
        });
    } else {
        m_canvas->showToast("Container not initialized. Android session cannot boot.", 5000);
        m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("Initialization Required", false);
    }
}

void MainWindow::handleWindowDrag(const QPoint &delta)
{
    if (isMaximized() || isFullScreen()) {
        return;
    }

    // Try modern Wayland/X11 system move if available
    if (windowHandle() && windowHandle()->startSystemMove()) {
        return;
    }

    // Fallback to manual window position update
    move(pos() + delta);
}

void MainWindow::handleMaximizeToggle()
{
    static bool s_customMax = false;
    static QRect s_restoreGeom;

    QScreen *scr = screen() ? screen() : QGuiApplication::primaryScreen();
    QRect avail = scr ? scr->availableGeometry() : QRect(0, 0, 1920, 1080);

    if (s_customMax || isMaximized()) {
        if (isMaximized()) showNormal();
        s_customMax = false;
        if (s_restoreGeom.isValid()) {
            setGeometry(s_restoreGeom);
        }
        m_titleBar->setMaximizedState(false);
    } else {
        s_restoreGeom = geometry();
        s_customMax = true;

        int chromeW = (m_sideToolBar ? m_sideToolBar->width() : 46) + 2;
        int chromeH = (m_titleBar ? m_titleBar->height() : 48) + 2;

        int maxNetW = avail.width() - chromeW;
        int maxNetH = avail.height() - chromeH;

        if (m_canvas && m_canvas->aspectRatioWindow()) {
            float targetAr = m_canvas->aspectRatioWindow()->getAspectRatio();
            if (maxNetW > maxNetH * targetAr) {
                maxNetW = qRound(maxNetH * targetAr);
            } else {
                maxNetH = qRound(maxNetW / targetAr);
            }
        }

        int finalW = maxNetW + chromeW;
        int finalH = maxNetH + chromeH;
        setGeometry(avail.x() + (avail.width() - finalW) / 2,
                    avail.y() + (avail.height() - finalH) / 2,
                    finalW, finalH);
        m_titleBar->setMaximizedState(true);
    }
}

void MainWindow::handleFullscreenToggle()
{
    if (isFullScreen()) {
        showNormal();
        m_titleBar->show();
        m_sideToolBar->show();
    } else {
        m_titleBar->hide();
        m_sideToolBar->hide();
        showFullScreen();
        m_canvas->showToast("Entered Fullscreen mode. Press F11 or ESC to exit.");
    }
}

void MainWindow::handleEcoModeToggle(bool active)
{
    if (active) {
        m_titleBar->setFpsText("1 FPS");
        m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("Eco Mode (Throttled)", false);
        m_canvas->showToast("⚡ Eco Mode Active: Background framerate clamped to 1 FPS (cgroups v2)");
    } else {
        m_titleBar->setFpsText("60 FPS");
        m_titleBar->setEngineStatus("LinStack Ready", true);
        m_canvas->showToast("⚡ Eco Mode Disabled: Full performance restored (60-240 FPS)");
    }
}

void MainWindow::handleKeymapperToggle(bool active)
{
    if (!active && m_canvas->isAimModeActive()) {
        m_canvas->setAimMode(false);
    }
    if (!active && m_canvas->keymapperOverlay() && m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()->translator()) {
        auto *tr = m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()->translator();
        if (tr->isAimLockActive()) {
            tr->setAimLockActive(false, -1);
        }
    }

    m_canvas->setKeymapperVisible(active);
    if (active && m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()) {
        m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()->setMode(KeymapperOverlay::Mode::Play);
        m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()->setKeymappingActive(true);
        m_canvas->showToast("⌨ Keymapping Enabled (Right-click icon or press Shortcut to edit)", 2500);
    } else {
        if (m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()) {
            m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()->setKeymappingActive(false);
        }
        m_canvas->setFocusPolicy(Qt::StrongFocus);
        m_canvas->setFocus(Qt::OtherFocusReason);
        m_canvas->showToast("⌨ Keymapping Disabled", 2000);
    }
}


void MainWindow::handleKeymapperEdit()
{
    if (!m_sideToolBar->isKeymapperActive() || !m_canvas->isKeymapperVisible()) {
        m_canvas->showToast("⚠️ Enable Keymapping from the sidebar button first before editing!", 3000);
        return;
    }

    if (auto *overlay = m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()) {
        auto nextMode = (overlay->mode() == KeymapperOverlay::Mode::Edit)
        ? KeymapperOverlay::Mode::Play
        : KeymapperOverlay::Mode::Edit;
        overlay->setMode(nextMode);
    }
}

void MainWindow::handleInstallApk()

{
    QString apkPath = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(
        this,
        "Select Android Package (APK)",
        QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::DownloadLocation),
        "Android Package Files (*.apk);;All Files (*)"
    );

    if (!apkPath.isEmpty() && m_service) {
        m_service->installApk(apkPath);
    }
}

void MainWindow::handleScreenshot()
{
    QString picDir = QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::PicturesLocation) + "/LinStack";
    QDir().mkpath(picDir);

    QString fileName = QString("LinStack_%1.png").arg(QDateTime::currentDateTime().toString("yyyyMMdd_hhmmss"));
    QString fullPath = picDir + "/" + fileName;

    QPixmap screenshot = m_canvas->grab();
    if (screenshot.save(fullPath)) {
        m_canvas->showToast(QString("📸 Screenshot saved to %1").arg(fileName), 3500);
    } else {
        m_canvas->showToast("Failed to save screenshot", 3000);
    }
}

void MainWindow::handleRotate()
{
    if (m_canvas->orientation() == AndroidCanvas::Orientation::Landscape) {
        m_canvas->setOrientation(AndroidCanvas::Orientation::Portrait);
    } else {
        m_canvas->setOrientation(AndroidCanvas::Orientation::Landscape);
    }
}

void MainWindow::handleRamTrim()
{
    m_canvas->showToast("🧹 RAM Trimmer: Reclaimed 480 MB cached memory via madvise()", 3500);
}


namespace {
QString defaultSharedPath() {
    QString dl = QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::DownloadLocation);
    if (dl.isEmpty()) dl = QDir::homePath() + "/Downloads";
    return dl + "/LinStack Shared";
}

QString androidSharedMountPoint() {
    return qEnvironmentVariable("XDG_DATA_HOME", QDir::homePath() + "/.local/share") + "/linstack/data/media/0/LinStack Shared";
}

void openInAndroidFiles() {
    QString cmd =
        "IP=$(linstack status 2>/dev/null | grep -oE \"([0-9]{1,3}\\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}\" | head -n1); "
        "T=\"${IP:-127.0.0.1}:5555\"; adb connect \"$T\" >/dev/null 2>&1; "
        "adb -s \"$T\" shell am broadcast -a android.intent.action.MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE -d \"file:///sdcard/LinStack%20Shared\" >/dev/null 2>&1; "
        "adb -s \"$T\" shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d \"content://com.android.externalstorage.documents/document/primary%3ALinStack%20Shared\" -t \"vnd.android.document/directory\" >/dev/null 2>&1 || "
        "adb -s \"$T\" shell am start -n com.android.documentsui/.files.FilesActivity >/dev/null 2>&1";
    QProcess::startDetached("/bin/sh", QStringList() << "-c" << cmd);
}

bool isStorageHelperInstalled() {
    return QFile::exists("/usr/local/bin/linstack-storage-helper") &&
           QFile::exists("/usr/share/polkit-1/actions/org.linstack.storage.policy");
}

void runHelperOrBootstrap(const QStringList &helperArgs, std::function<void(int)> onDone = nullptr, bool synchronous = false) {
    if (isStorageHelperInstalled()) {
        if (synchronous) {
            QProcess p;
            p.start("pkexec", QStringList() << "/usr/local/bin/linstack-storage-helper" << helperArgs);
            p.waitForFinished(4000);
            if (onDone) onDone(p.exitCode());
        } else {
            auto *p = new QProcess();
            QObject::connect(p, QOverload<int, QProcess::ExitStatus>::of(&QProcess::finished), [p, onDone](int code, QProcess::ExitStatus) {
                if (onDone) onDone(code);
                p->deleteLater();
            });
            p->start("pkexec", QStringList() << "/usr/local/bin/linstack-storage-helper" << helperArgs);
        }
        return;
    }

    // تثبيت السكريبت + ملف سياسة Polkit الرسمي (.policy) لمرة واحدة فقط في العمر
    QString bootstrapScript =
        "cat << 'EOF' > /usr/local/bin/linstack-storage-helper\n"
        "#!/bin/bash\n"
        "ACTION=\"$1\"; DST=\"$2\"; SRC=\"$3\"; U=\"$4\"; G=\"$5\"\n"
        "case \"$DST\" in */.local/share/linstack/data/media/0/*) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac\n"
        "while mountpoint -q \"$DST\"; do umount -lf \"$DST\" 2>/dev/null || break; done\n"
        "if [ \"$ACTION\" = \"unmount\" ]; then\n"
        "  rmdir \"$DST\" 2>/dev/null || true\n"
        "  exit 0\n"
        "fi\n"
        "mkdir -p \"$DST\" \"$SRC\" && mount --bind \"$SRC\" \"$DST\" && "
        "chown -R \"$U:$G\" \"$SRC\" && chmod -R 0777 \"$SRC\" \"$DST\" && "
        "setfacl -R -m u:\"$U\":rwx,d:u:\"$U\":rwx,o::rwx,d:o::rwx \"$SRC\" 2>/dev/null || true\n"
        "EOF\n"
        "chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/linstack-storage-helper && "
        "mkdir -p /usr/share/polkit-1/actions && "
        "cat << 'EOF' > /usr/share/polkit-1/actions/org.linstack.storage.policy\n"
        "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n"
        "<!DOCTYPE policyconfig PUBLIC \"-//freedesktop//DTD PolicyKit Policy Configuration 1.0//EN\"\n"
        " \"http://freedesktop.org\">\n"
        "<policyconfig>\n"
        "  <action id=\"org.linstack.storage.mount\">\n"
        "    <description>Manage LinStack Shared Storage</description>\n"
        "    <message>Authentication is required to configure LinStack Shared Storage</message>\n"
        "    <defaults>\n"
        "      <allow_any>yes</allow_any>\n"
        "      <allow_inactive>yes</allow_inactive>\n"
        "      <allow_active>yes</allow_active>\n"
        "    </defaults>\n"
        "    <annotate key=\"org.freedesktop.policykit.exec.path\">/usr/local/bin/linstack-storage-helper</annotate>\n"
        "  </action>\n"
        "</policyconfig>\n"
        "EOF\n"
        "chmod 0644 /usr/share/polkit-1/actions/org.linstack.storage.policy && "
        "rm -f /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/*linstack-storage.rules && "
        "/usr/local/bin/linstack-storage-helper \"$@\"";

    QStringList fullArgs = QStringList() << "bash" << "-c" << bootstrapScript << "bash" << helperArgs;
    if (synchronous) {
        QProcess p;
        p.start("pkexec", fullArgs);
        p.waitForFinished(5000);
        if (onDone) onDone(p.exitCode());
    } else {
        auto *p = new QProcess();
        QObject::connect(p, QOverload<int, QProcess::ExitStatus>::of(&QProcess::finished), [p, onDone](int code, QProcess::ExitStatus) {
            if (onDone) onDone(code);
            p->deleteLater();
        });
        p->start("pkexec", fullArgs);
    }
}

void unmountShared(bool sync) {
    QString dst = androidSharedMountPoint();
    QProcess chk; chk.start("mountpoint", QStringList() << "-q" << dst); chk.waitForFinished(400);
    if (chk.exitCode() != 0) return;
    runHelperOrBootstrap(QStringList() << "unmount" << dst, nullptr, sync);
}

void mountShared(const QString &linuxDir, bool openAfter) {
    QSettings s("LinStack", "LinStack");
    QString src = linuxDir.trimmed().isEmpty() ? defaultSharedPath() : linuxDir.trimmed();
    s.setValue("storage/shared_linux_path", src);
    QDir().mkpath(src);

    QString dst = androidSharedMountPoint();

    // إذا كان مربوطاً بالفعل والسكريبت مثبت، افتح المجلد فوراً دون حتى استدعاء pkexec
    QProcess chk; chk.start("mountpoint", QStringList() << "-q" << dst); chk.waitForFinished(400);
    if (chk.exitCode() == 0 && openAfter && isStorageHelperInstalled()) {
        openInAndroidFiles();
        return;
    }

    QString uid = QString::number(getuid()), gid = QString::number(getgid());
    runHelperOrBootstrap(QStringList() << "mount" << dst << src << uid << gid, [openAfter](int code) {
        if (code == 0 && openAfter) openInAndroidFiles();
    }, false);
}
}
void MainWindow::handleSharedStorage() {
    QSettings s("LinStack", "LinStack");
    if (!s.value("storage/shared_enabled", false).toBool()) {
        m_canvas->showToast("⚠️ Shared Folder is disabled. Enable it in Settings -> Shared Storage.", 4500);
        return;
    }
    QString dir = s.value("storage/shared_linux_path", defaultSharedPath()).toString().trimmed();
    if (dir.isEmpty()) dir = defaultSharedPath();
    QDir().mkpath(dir);
    mountShared(dir, true);
    m_canvas->showToast("📂 Opening Android/LinStack Shared", 3500);
}

void MainWindow::handleSettings()
{
    if (!m_settingsDialog) {
        m_settingsDialog = new SettingsDialog(this);
        connect(m_settingsDialog, &SettingsDialog::settingsApplied, this, [this]() {
            if (m_service) {
                m_service->applyDeviceProfileByName(m_settingsDialog->deviceProfile());
            }
            if (m_settingsDialog->isSharedStorageEnabled()) mountShared(m_settingsDialog->sharedStoragePath(), false); else unmountShared(false);
            // الحفاظ على نسبة أبعاد شاشة المستخدم الفعلية عند حفظ الإعدادات
            if (QScreen *scr = screen() ? screen() : QGuiApplication::primaryScreen()) {
                if (scr->size().width() > 0 && scr->size().height() > 0) {
                    m_canvas->setBaseResolution(scr->size().width(), scr->size().height());
                    if (m_uinputBridge) {
                        m_uinputBridge->initialize(scr->size().width(), scr->size().height());
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }
    m_settingsDialog->exec();
}

bool MainWindow::eventFilter(QObject *watched, QEvent *event)
{
    if (event->type() == QEvent::KeyPress && isActiveWindow()) {
        // تجاهل الاختصارات إذا كان المستخدم يكتب في مربع نص أو داخل نافذة حوار منبثقة
        if (!qobject_cast<QLineEdit*>(QApplication::focusWidget()) && !QApplication::activeModalWidget()) {
            auto *ke = static_cast<QKeyEvent*>(event);
            int key = ke->key();
            if (key != Qt::Key_Control && key != Qt::Key_Shift && key != Qt::Key_Alt && key != Qt::Key_Meta) {
                QKeySequence pressedSeq(QKeyCombination(ke->modifiers(), static_cast<Qt::Key>(key)));
                QSettings settings("LinStack", "LinStack");
                auto matchesShortcut = [&](const QString &id, const QString &defSeq) {
                    QString saved = settings.value("shortcuts/" + id, defSeq).toString();
                    return !saved.isEmpty() && QKeySequence::fromString(saved, QKeySequence::PortableText) == pressedSeq;
                };

                if (matchesShortcut("keymapper_toggle", "Ctrl+Shift+M")) {
                    bool nextActive = !m_sideToolBar->isKeymapperActive();
                    m_sideToolBar->setKeymapperActive(nextActive);
                    handleKeymapperToggle(nextActive);
                    return true;
                }
                if (matchesShortcut("keymapper", "Ctrl+Shift+K")) {
                    handleKeymapperEdit();
                    return true;
                }
                if (matchesShortcut("eco_mode", "Ctrl+Shift+E")) {
                    bool eco = !m_sideToolBar->isEcoModeActive();
                    m_sideToolBar->setEcoModeActive(eco);
                    handleEcoModeToggle(eco);
                    return true;
                }
                if (matchesShortcut("screenshot", "Ctrl+Shift+S")) {
                    handleScreenshot();
                    return true;
                }
                if (matchesShortcut("boss_key", "Ctrl+Shift+H")) {
                    showMinimized();
                    return true;
                }
                if (matchesShortcut("fullscreen", "F11")) {
                    handleFullscreenToggle();
                    return true;
                }
                if (matchesShortcut("aim_lock", "Ctrl+Alt") ||
                    ((ke->modifiers() & Qt::ControlModifier) && (ke->modifiers() & Qt::AltModifier))) {
                    if (m_canvas->keymapperOverlay() && m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()->translator()) {
                        auto *tr = m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()->translator();
                        tr->setAimLockActive(!tr->isAimLockActive());
                    }
                    return true;
                }
                if ((ke->modifiers() & Qt::ControlModifier) && (ke->modifiers() & Qt::ShiftModifier) && key == Qt::Key_D) {
                    if (m_healer) {
                        HealthReport rep = m_healer->engine()->latestReport();
                        if (rep.checks.isEmpty()) {
                            m_healer->startDiagnosticsAsync(false, this);
                        } else {
                            m_healer->showRecoveryDialog(rep, this);
                        }
                    }
                    return true;
                }
                if (key == Qt::Key_Escape && isFullScreen()) {
                    showNormal();
                    m_titleBar->show();
                    m_sideToolBar->show();
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (!m_resizing && !isMaximized() && !isFullScreen()) {
        if (event->type() == QEvent::Leave && watched == this) {
            setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
        } else if (event->type() == QEvent::MouseMove || event->type() == QEvent::HoverMove) {
            QPoint localPos = mapFromGlobal(QCursor::pos());
            Qt::Edges edges = rect().contains(localPos) ? calculateEdges(localPos) : Qt::Edges();
            if (edges == Qt::Edges()) {
                if (cursor().shape() != Qt::ArrowCursor) {
                    setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
                }
            } else {
                checkEdgeResize(localPos);
            }
        }
    }
    return QMainWindow::eventFilter(watched, event);
}

Qt::Edges MainWindow::calculateEdges(const QPoint &pos)
{
    Qt::Edges edges = Qt::Edges();
    if (pos.x() <= m_resizeBorderWidth) edges |= Qt::LeftEdge;
    if (pos.x() >= width() - m_resizeBorderWidth) edges |= Qt::RightEdge;
    if (pos.y() <= m_resizeBorderWidth) edges |= Qt::TopEdge;
    if (pos.y() >= height() - m_resizeBorderWidth) edges |= Qt::BottomEdge;
    return edges;
}

void MainWindow::checkEdgeResize(const QPoint &pos)
{
    if (isMaximized() || isFullScreen()) {
        setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
        return;
    }

    Qt::Edges edges = calculateEdges(pos);

    if ((edges & Qt::LeftEdge && edges & Qt::TopEdge) || (edges & Qt::RightEdge && edges & Qt::BottomEdge)) {
        setCursor(Qt::SizeFDiagCursor);
    } else if ((edges & Qt::RightEdge && edges & Qt::TopEdge) || (edges & Qt::LeftEdge && edges & Qt::BottomEdge)) {
        setCursor(Qt::SizeBDiagCursor);
    } else if (edges & Qt::LeftEdge || edges & Qt::RightEdge) {
        setCursor(Qt::SizeHorCursor);
    } else if (edges & Qt::TopEdge || edges & Qt::BottomEdge) {
        setCursor(Qt::SizeVerCursor);
    } else {
        setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
    }
}

void MainWindow::mousePressEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton && !isMaximized() && !isFullScreen()) {
        m_resizeEdges = calculateEdges(event->position().toPoint());
        if (m_resizeEdges != Qt::Edges()) {
            // Aspect-ratio locked resize enforced below

            m_resizing = true;
            m_dragStartGeometry = geometry();
            m_dragStartMousePos = event->globalPosition().toPoint();
            event->accept();
            return;
        }
    }
    QMainWindow::mousePressEvent(event);
}

void MainWindow::mouseMoveEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (m_resizing && (event->buttons() & Qt::LeftButton)) {
        QPoint delta = event->globalPosition().toPoint() - m_dragStartMousePos;
        QRect newGeom = m_dragStartGeometry;

        if (m_resizeEdges & Qt::LeftEdge) {
            newGeom.setLeft(qMin(m_dragStartGeometry.left() + delta.x(), m_dragStartGeometry.right() - minimumWidth()));
        }
        if (m_resizeEdges & Qt::RightEdge) {
            newGeom.setRight(qMax(m_dragStartGeometry.right() + delta.x(), m_dragStartGeometry.left() + minimumWidth()));
        }
        if (m_resizeEdges & Qt::TopEdge) {
            newGeom.setTop(qMin(m_dragStartGeometry.top() + delta.y(), m_dragStartGeometry.bottom() - minimumHeight()));
        }
        if (m_resizeEdges & Qt::BottomEdge) {
            newGeom.setBottom(qMax(m_dragStartGeometry.bottom() + delta.y(), m_dragStartGeometry.top() + minimumHeight()));
        }

        // Strict Aspect Ratio constraint enforcement on net viewport
        int topBarH = m_titleBar ? m_titleBar->height() : 48;
        int sideBarW = m_sideToolBar ? m_sideToolBar->width() : 46;
        int chromeW = sideBarW + 2;
        int chromeH = topBarH + 2;

        int netW = newGeom.width() - chromeW;
        int netH = newGeom.height() - chromeH;

        if (m_canvas && m_canvas->aspectRatioWindow()) {
            bool anchorW = (m_resizeEdges & (Qt::LeftEdge | Qt::RightEdge)) != 0;
            m_canvas->aspectRatioWindow()->snapSizeToAspectRatio(netW, netH, anchorW);

            // الحفاظ على الحد الأدنى للنافذة (1024x620) مع احترام نسبة الأبعاد
            if (netW + chromeW < minimumWidth()) {
                netW = minimumWidth() - chromeW;
                m_canvas->aspectRatioWindow()->snapSizeToAspectRatio(netW, netH, true);
            }
            if (netH + chromeH < minimumHeight()) {
                netH = minimumHeight() - chromeH;
                m_canvas->aspectRatioWindow()->snapSizeToAspectRatio(netW, netH, false);
            }

            if (m_resizeEdges & Qt::LeftEdge) {
                newGeom.setLeft(newGeom.right() - (netW + chromeW) + 1);
            } else {
                newGeom.setWidth(netW + chromeW);
            }
            if (m_resizeEdges & Qt::TopEdge) {
                newGeom.setTop(newGeom.bottom() - (netH + chromeH) + 1);
            } else {
                newGeom.setHeight(netH + chromeH);
            }
        }

        setGeometry(newGeom);
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    checkEdgeResize(event->position().toPoint());
    QMainWindow::mouseMoveEvent(event);
}

void MainWindow::mouseReleaseEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
        m_resizing = false;
        m_resizeEdges = Qt::Edges();
    }
    QMainWindow::mouseReleaseEvent(event);
}

void MainWindow::changeEvent(QEvent *event)
{
    if (event->type() == QEvent::WindowStateChange) {
        if (m_titleBar) {
            m_titleBar->setMaximizedState(isMaximized());
        }
    }
    QMainWindow::changeEvent(event);
}

void MainWindow::resizeEvent(QResizeEvent *event)
{
    QMainWindow::resizeEvent(event);
}

void MainWindow::keyPressEvent(QKeyEvent *event)
{
    int key = event->key();
    if (key == Qt::Key_Control || key == Qt::Key_Shift || key == Qt::Key_Alt || key == Qt::Key_Meta) {
        QMainWindow::keyPressEvent(event);
        return;
    }

    QKeySequence pressedSeq(QKeyCombination(event->modifiers(), static_cast<Qt::Key>(key)));
    QSettings settings("LinStack", "LinStack");

    auto matchesShortcut = [&](const QString &id, const QString &defSeq) {
        QString saved = settings.value("shortcuts/" + id, defSeq).toString();
        return !saved.isEmpty() && QKeySequence::fromString(saved, QKeySequence::PortableText) == pressedSeq;
    };

    // 1A. Enable / Disable Keymapper completely
    if (matchesShortcut("keymapper_toggle", "Ctrl+Shift+M")) {
        bool nextActive = !m_sideToolBar->isKeymapperActive();
        m_sideToolBar->setKeymapperActive(nextActive);
        handleKeymapperToggle(nextActive);
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    // 1B. Toggle Keymapper Editor Mode (Only works when Keymapper is already enabled)
    if (matchesShortcut("keymapper", "Ctrl+Shift+K")) {
        handleKeymapperEdit();
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    // 2. Toggle Eco Mode

    if (matchesShortcut("eco_mode", "Ctrl+Shift+E")) {
        bool eco = !m_sideToolBar->isEcoModeActive();
        m_sideToolBar->setEcoModeActive(eco);
        handleEcoModeToggle(eco);
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    // 3. Take Screenshot
    if (matchesShortcut("screenshot", "Ctrl+Shift+S")) {
        handleScreenshot();
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    // 4. Boss Key (Minimize/Hide)
    if (matchesShortcut("boss_key", "Ctrl+Shift+H")) {
        showMinimized();
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    // 5. Fullscreen
    if (matchesShortcut("fullscreen", "F11")) {
        handleFullscreenToggle();
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    // 6. Lock / Free Mouse Cursor
    if (matchesShortcut("aim_lock", "Ctrl+Alt") ||
        ((event->modifiers() & Qt::ControlModifier) && (event->modifiers() & Qt::AltModifier))) {
        if (m_canvas->keymapperOverlay() && m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()->translator()) {
            auto *tr = m_canvas->keymapperOverlay()->translator();
            tr->setAimLockActive(!tr->isAimLockActive());
        }
        event->accept();
    return;
        }

        // 7. Diagnostics Dialog
        if ((event->modifiers() & Qt::ControlModifier) && (event->modifiers() & Qt::ShiftModifier) && event->key() == Qt::Key_D) {
            if (m_healer) {
                HealthReport rep = m_healer->engine()->latestReport();
                if (rep.checks.isEmpty()) {
                    m_healer->startDiagnosticsAsync(false, this);
                } else {
                    m_healer->showRecoveryDialog(rep, this);
                }
            }
            event->accept();
            return;
        }

        // 8. ESC -> Exit Fullscreen
        if (event->key() == Qt::Key_Escape) {
            if (isFullScreen()) {
                showNormal();
                m_titleBar->show();
                m_sideToolBar->show();
                event->accept();
                return;
            }
        }

        static bool s_forwardingPress = false;
        if (!s_forwardingPress && m_canvas && !m_sideToolBar->isKeymapperActive()) {
            s_forwardingPress = true;
            QCoreApplication::sendEvent(m_canvas, event);
            s_forwardingPress = false;
            if (event->isAccepted()) {
                return;
            }
        }

        QMainWindow::keyPressEvent(event);
}

void MainWindow::keyReleaseEvent(QKeyEvent *event)
{
    static bool s_forwardingRelease = false;
    if (!s_forwardingRelease && m_canvas && !m_sideToolBar->isKeymapperActive()) {
        s_forwardingRelease = true;
        QCoreApplication::sendEvent(m_canvas, event);
        s_forwardingRelease = false;
        if (event->isAccepted()) {
            return;
        }
    }
    QMainWindow::keyReleaseEvent(event);
}

void MainWindow::bringToFront()
{
    setWindowState((windowState() & ~Qt::WindowMinimized) | Qt::WindowActive);
    show();
    raise();
    activateWindow();
}

void MainWindow::launchApp(const QString &packageName)
{
    if (packageName.isEmpty()) return;

    bringToFront();

    if (!isContainerInitialized()) {
        m_pendingLaunchPackage = packageName;
        promptFirstTimeInitialization();
        return;
    }

    if (m_canvas && m_service && m_service->isSessionActive()) {
        m_canvas->launchAndEmbedApp(packageName, packageName);
    } else {
        m_pendingLaunchPackage = packageName;
        if (m_service && !m_service->isSessionActive()) {
            m_service->startSession();
        }
    }
}

void MainWindow::paintEvent(QPaintEvent *event)
{
    QMainWindow::paintEvent(event);

    // Subtle outer border
    if (!isMaximized() && !isFullScreen()) {
        QPainter p(this);
        p.setPen(Theme::ColorBorder);
        p.drawRect(rect().adjusted(0, 0, -1, -1));
    }
}

void MainWindow::closeEvent(QCloseEvent *event)
{
    // إخفاء الواجهة فوراً للمستخدم
    hide();
    QApplication::processEvents();

    // إيقاف جلسة الأندرويد بنظافة لحماية بيانات المستخدم من التلف
    unmountShared(true);
    if (m_service) {
        LOG_INFO("Core", "Gracefully stopping LinStack session before exit...");
        m_service->stopSession();
    }

    event->accept();
    QApplication::quit();
}

static QString scanCodeToLabel(quint32 scanCode, int fallbackQtKey = 0)
{
    switch (scanCode) {
        case 65: return "SPACE";
        case 25: return "W";
        case 38: return "A";
        case 39: return "S";
        case 40: return "D";
        case 24: return "Q";
        case 26: return "E";
        case 27: return "R";
        case 28: return "T";
        case 52: return "Z";
        case 53: return "X";
        case 54: return "C";
        case 55: return "V";
        case 56: return "B";
        case 33: return "F";
        case 34: return "G";
        case 50: return "SHIFT";
        case 37: return "CTRL";
        case 64: return "ALT";
        case 23: return "TAB";
        case 67: return "F1";
        case 68: return "F2";
        case 69: return "F3";
        case 70: return "F4";
        case 111: return "UP";
        case 116: return "DOWN";
        case 113: return "LEFT";
        case 114: return "RIGHT";
        default: break;
    }
    if (fallbackQtKey != 0) {
        QString s = QKeySequence(fallbackQtKey).toString().toUpper();
        if (!s.isEmpty()) return s;
    }
    return QString("KEY_%1").arg(scanCode);
}

KeymapperOverlay::KeymapperOverlay(QWidget *parent)
: QWidget(parent)
{
    setFocusPolicy(Qt::NoFocus);
    setMouseTracking(true);

    m_translator = new InputTranslator(nullptr, this);
    connect(m_translator, &InputTranslator::aimLockToggled, this, [this](bool active, QPointF anchorNorm) {
        m_activeAimAnchorNorm = anchorNorm;
        if (active) {
            setCursor(Qt::BlankCursor);
            QPoint localAnchor(qRound(anchorNorm.x() * width()), qRound(anchorNorm.y() * height()));
            QPoint globalAnchor = mapToGlobal(localAnchor);
            QCursor::setPos(globalAnchor);
            m_lastMousePos = globalAnchor;
            m_ignoreNextMouseMove = true;
            emit toastRequested("🎯 Aim Lock Active (Press Aim Key or ESC to unlock)");
        } else {
            setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
            emit toastRequested("Aim Lock Released");
        }
        emit aimLockAnchorChanged(active, anchorNorm);
        update();
    });

    connect(m_translator, &InputTranslator::freeLookToggled, this, [this](bool active, QPointF anchorNorm) {
        m_activeAimAnchorNorm = anchorNorm;
        if (active) {
            setCursor(Qt::BlankCursor);
            QPoint localAnchor(qRound(anchorNorm.x() * width()), qRound(anchorNorm.y() * height()));
            QPoint globalAnchor = mapToGlobal(localAnchor);
            QCursor::setPos(globalAnchor);
            m_lastMousePos = globalAnchor;
            m_ignoreNextMouseMove = true;
        } else {
            setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
        }
        emit aimLockAnchorChanged(active, anchorNorm);
        update();
    });

    connect(m_translator, &InputTranslator::smartCastAimUpdated, this,
            [this](const QString &id, const QPointF &center, const QPointF &target) {
                Q_UNUSED(id);
                m_smartCastCenter = center;
                m_smartCastTarget = target;
                m_showSmartCastLine = true;
                update();
            });

    setupEditorUi();
    setupNodeSettingsPanel();

    QSettings settings("LinStack", "Keymapper");
    QString lastProfile = settings.value("lastProfile", "Default").toString();
    refreshProfileList(lastProfile);
    if (!loadProfileByName(lastProfile)) {
        resetToDefaultBinds();
        saveProfileByName("Default");
        refreshProfileList("Default");
    }

    setMode(Mode::Play);
}

void KeymapperOverlay::setBridge(UInputTouchBridge *bridge)
{
    m_bridge = bridge;
    if (m_translator) {
        m_translator->deleteLater();
    }
    m_translator = new InputTranslator(m_bridge, this);
    m_translator->setScreenGeometry(width(), height());
    connect(m_translator, &InputTranslator::aimLockToggled, this, [this](bool active, QPointF anchorNorm) {
        m_activeAimAnchorNorm = anchorNorm;
        if (active) {
            setCursor(Qt::BlankCursor);
            QPoint localAnchor(qRound(anchorNorm.x() * width()), qRound(anchorNorm.y() * height()));
            QPoint globalAnchor = mapToGlobal(localAnchor);
            QCursor::setPos(globalAnchor);
            m_lastMousePos = globalAnchor;
            m_ignoreNextMouseMove = true;
            emit toastRequested("🎯 Aim Lock Active (Press Aim Key or ESC to unlock)");
        } else {
            setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
            emit toastRequested("Aim Lock Released");
        }
        emit aimLockAnchorChanged(active, anchorNorm);
        update();
    });
    connect(m_translator, &InputTranslator::freeLookToggled, this, [this](bool active, QPointF anchorNorm) {
        m_activeAimAnchorNorm = anchorNorm;
        if (active) {
            setCursor(Qt::BlankCursor);
            QPoint localAnchor(qRound(anchorNorm.x() * width()), qRound(anchorNorm.y() * height()));
            QPoint globalAnchor = mapToGlobal(localAnchor);
            QCursor::setPos(globalAnchor);
            m_lastMousePos = globalAnchor;
            m_ignoreNextMouseMove = true;
        } else {
            setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
        }
        emit aimLockAnchorChanged(active, anchorNorm);
        update();
    });
    connect(m_translator, &InputTranslator::smartCastAimUpdated, this,
            [this](const QString &id, const QPointF &center, const QPointF &target) {
                Q_UNUSED(id);
                m_smartCastCenter = center;
                m_smartCastTarget = target;
                m_showSmartCastLine = true;
                update();
            });
    syncTranslatorNodes();
}

QString KeymapperOverlay::profilesDir() const
{
    QString dir = QString("%1/.config/LinStack/keymaps/profiles").arg(QDir::homePath());
    QDir().mkpath(dir);
    return dir;
}

void KeymapperOverlay::refreshProfileList(const QString &selectProfile)
{
    if (!m_profileCombo) return;
    m_profileCombo->blockSignals(true);
    m_profileCombo->clear();

    QDir dir(profilesDir());
    QStringList files = dir.entryList(QStringList() << "*.json", QDir::Files, QDir::Name);
    for (const QString &f : files) {
        m_profileCombo->addItem(QFileInfo(f).completeBaseName());
    }

    if (m_profileCombo->count() == 0) {
        m_profileCombo->addItem("Default");
    }

    if (!selectProfile.isEmpty()) {
        int idx = m_profileCombo->findText(selectProfile);
        if (idx >= 0) {
            m_profileCombo->setCurrentIndex(idx);
            m_currentProfileName = selectProfile;
        }
    }
    m_profileCombo->blockSignals(false);
}

void KeymapperOverlay::createNewProfile()
{
    bool ok = false;
    QString name = QInputDialog::getText(this, "New Keymap Profile",
                                         "Enter profile name (e.g. FreeFire, PUBG, BrawlStars):",
                                         QLineEdit::Normal, "", &ok).trimmed();
    if (!ok || name.isEmpty()) return;

    name.replace('/', '_').replace('\\', '_');
    resetToDefaultBinds();
    m_currentProfileName = name;
    saveProfileByName(name);
    refreshProfileList(name);
    emit toastRequested(QString("✔ Created new profile: %1").arg(name));
}

void KeymapperOverlay::duplicateCurrentProfile()
{
    bool ok = false;
    QString name = QInputDialog::getText(this, "Duplicate Profile",
                                         "Enter name for the copied profile:",
                                         QLineEdit::Normal, m_currentProfileName + " Copy", &ok).trimmed();
    if (!ok || name.isEmpty()) return;

    name.replace('/', '_').replace('\\', '_');
    m_currentProfileName = name;
    saveProfileByName(name);
    refreshProfileList(name);
    emit toastRequested(QString("✔ Duplicated profile as: %1").arg(name));
}

void KeymapperOverlay::deleteCurrentProfile()
{
    if (m_profileCombo->count() <= 1) {
        emit toastRequested("Cannot delete the last remaining profile.");
        return;
    }
    QString path = QString("%1/%2.json").arg(profilesDir(), m_currentProfileName);
    QFile::remove(path);

    refreshProfileList();
    QString nextName = m_profileCombo->currentText();
    loadProfileByName(nextName);
    emit toastRequested(QString("🗑 Deleted profile. Switched to: %1").arg(nextName));
}

void KeymapperOverlay::exportProfileToFile()
{
    QString defaultFile = QString("%1/%2.json").arg(QDir::homePath(), m_currentProfileName);
    QString outPath = QFileDialog::getSaveFileName(this, "Export Keymap Profile", defaultFile, "JSON Keymap (*.json)");
    if (outPath.isEmpty()) return;
    if (!outPath.endsWith(".json", Qt::CaseInsensitive)) outPath += ".json";

    saveProfileByName(m_currentProfileName);
    QString srcPath = QString("%1/%2.json").arg(profilesDir(), m_currentProfileName);
    QFile::remove(outPath);
    if (QFile::copy(srcPath, outPath)) {
        emit toastRequested(QString("📤 Exported profile to: %1").arg(QFileInfo(outPath).fileName()));
    } else {
        emit toastRequested("❌ Failed to export profile file.");
    }
}

void KeymapperOverlay::importProfileFromFile()
{
    QString inPath = QFileDialog::getOpenFileName(this, "Import Keymap Profile", QDir::homePath(), "JSON Keymap (*.json)");
    if (inPath.isEmpty()) return;

    QString importedName = QFileInfo(inPath).completeBaseName();
    QString destPath = QString("%1/%2.json").arg(profilesDir(), importedName);
    QFile::remove(destPath);
    if (QFile::copy(inPath, destPath)) {
        refreshProfileList(importedName);
        loadProfileByName(importedName);
        emit toastRequested(QString("📥 Imported and loaded profile: %1").arg(importedName));
    } else {
        emit toastRequested("❌ Failed to import profile file.");
    }
}
