        "QPushButton:hover { background: #1E293B; border-color: #10B981; color: #00FF66; }"
    );
    connect(btnRefresh, &QPushButton::clicked, this, &AndroidCanvas::refreshInstalledApps);
    headerRow->addWidget(btnRefresh);

    mainLayout->addLayout(headerRow);

    // 3. Grid Area for Dynamically Fetched Apps
    auto *scrollArea = new QScrollArea(home);
    scrollArea->setWidgetResizable(true);
    scrollArea->setStyleSheet("QScrollArea { border: none; background: transparent; }");

    m_appsGridContainer = new QWidget(scrollArea);
    m_appsGridContainer->setStyleSheet("background: transparent;");
    scrollArea->setWidget(m_appsGridContainer);

    mainLayout->addWidget(scrollArea, 1);

    return home;
}

void AndroidCanvas::refreshInstalledApps()
{
    m_installedApps.clear();

    QString appDir = QDir::homePath() + "/.local/share/applications";
    QDir dir(appDir);
    QStringList filters;
    filters << "linstack.*.desktop" << "waydroid.*.desktop";
    dir.setNameFilters(filters);

    QFileInfoList list = dir.entryInfoList(QDir::Files | QDir::NoDotAndDotDot);
    for (const auto &fileInfo : list) {
        QFile file(fileInfo.absoluteFilePath());
        if (file.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
            QTextStream in(&file);
            QString name;
            QString exec;
            QString pkg;

            while (!in.atEnd()) {
                QString line = in.readLine().trimmed();
                if (line.startsWith("Name=")) {
                    name = line.mid(5).trimmed();
                } else if (line.startsWith("Exec=")) {
                    exec = line.mid(5).trimmed();
                    if (exec.contains("app launch ")) {
                        QString p = exec.section("app launch ", 1, 1).section(" ", 0, 0);
                        if (!p.isEmpty()) pkg = p;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (name.isEmpty()) {
                name = fileInfo.baseName();
            }
            if (pkg.isEmpty()) {
                pkg = fileInfo.baseName().remove("linstack.").remove("waydroid.");
            }

            AndroidAppEntry entry;
            entry.displayName = name;
            entry.packageName = pkg;
            entry.iconType = Theme::IconType::AndroidRecent;
            entry.accentColor = Theme::ColorNeon;
            entry.isGame = true;
            m_installedApps.append(entry);
        }
    }

    if (m_installedApps.isEmpty()) {
        AndroidAppEntry defaultBrowser;
        defaultBrowser.displayName = "Chromium Browser";
        defaultBrowser.packageName = "org.chromium.webview_shell";
        defaultBrowser.iconType = Theme::IconType::AndroidHome;
        defaultBrowser.accentColor = Theme::ColorMint;
        defaultBrowser.isGame = false;
        m_installedApps.append(defaultBrowser);

        AndroidAppEntry defaultSettings;
        defaultSettings.displayName = "Android Settings";
        defaultSettings.packageName = "com.android.settings";
        defaultSettings.iconType = Theme::IconType::Settings;
        defaultSettings.accentColor = Theme::ColorEmerald;
        defaultSettings.isGame = false;
        m_installedApps.append(defaultSettings);
    }

    rebuildAppsGrid();
}

void AndroidCanvas::rebuildAppsGrid()
{
    if (!m_appsGridContainer) return;

    if (m_appsGridContainer->layout()) {
        QLayoutItem *child;
        while ((child = m_appsGridContainer->layout()->takeAt(0)) != nullptr) {
            delete child->widget();
            delete child;
        }
        delete m_appsGridContainer->layout();
    }

    auto *grid = new QGridLayout(m_appsGridContainer);
    grid->setContentsMargins(12, 12, 12, 12);
    grid->setHorizontalSpacing(18);
    grid->setVerticalSpacing(20);

    const int cols = 5;
    for (int i = 0; i < m_installedApps.size(); ++i) {
        QWidget *card = createAppCard(m_installedApps[i]);
        grid->addWidget(card, i / cols, i % cols);
    }

    for (int col = 0; col < cols; ++col) {
        grid->setColumnStretch(col, 1);
    }
}

QWidget *AndroidCanvas::createAppCard(const AndroidAppEntry &app)
{
    auto *card = new QWidget(m_appsGridContainer);
    card->setFixedSize(140, 150);
    card->setCursor(Qt::PointingHandCursor);
    card->setStyleSheet(
        "QWidget {"
        "  background-color: #111827;"
        "  border: 1px solid #1F2937;"
        "  border-radius: 12px;"
        "}"
        "QWidget:hover {"
        "  background-color: #161F30;"
        "  border-color: #10B981;"
        "}"
    );

    auto *cardLayout = new QVBoxLayout(card);
    cardLayout->setContentsMargins(12, 16, 12, 12);
    cardLayout->setSpacing(8);
    cardLayout->setAlignment(Qt::AlignCenter);

    auto *iconLabel = new QLabel(card);
    iconLabel->setFixedSize(54, 54);
    iconLabel->setAlignment(Qt::AlignCenter);
    iconLabel->setPixmap(Theme::renderIconPixmap(app.iconType, app.accentColor, 36));
    iconLabel->setStyleSheet(
        QString("background-color: rgba(%1, %2, %3, 0.12); border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(%1, %2, %3, 0.3);")
            .arg(app.accentColor.red())
            .arg(app.accentColor.green())
            .arg(app.accentColor.blue())
    );
    cardLayout->addWidget(iconLabel, 0, Qt::AlignCenter);

    auto *nameLabel = new QLabel(app.displayName, card);
    nameLabel->setAlignment(Qt::AlignCenter);
    nameLabel->setWordWrap(true);
    nameLabel->setStyleSheet("color: #F9FAFB; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; background: transparent; border: none;");
    cardLayout->addWidget(nameLabel);

    auto *pkgLabel = new QLabel(app.packageName.section('.', -1), card);
    pkgLabel->setAlignment(Qt::AlignCenter);
    pkgLabel->setStyleSheet("color: #6B7280; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; font-family: monospace; background: transparent; border: none;");
    cardLayout->addWidget(pkgLabel);

    auto *btnClick = new QPushButton(card);
    btnClick->setGeometry(0, 0, 140, 150);
    btnClick->setStyleSheet("background: transparent; border: none;");
    btnClick->setCursor(Qt::PointingHandCursor);
    connect(btnClick, &QPushButton::clicked, this, [this, app]() {
        handleAppCardClicked(app.packageName, app.displayName);
    });

    return card;
}

void AndroidCanvas::handleAppCardClicked(const QString &packageName, const QString &displayName)
{
    launchAndEmbedApp(packageName, displayName);
}

void AndroidCanvas::launchAndEmbedApp(const QString &packageName, const QString &displayName)
{
    m_activePackage = packageName;

    if (m_keymapperOverlay) {
        m_keymapperOverlay->setCurrentAppId(packageName);
    }

    emit appLaunchRequested(packageName, displayName);


    m_simulatedActive = true;
    if (m_stack) {
        m_stack->hide();
    }

    showToast(QString("Launching %1 inside LinStack native viewport (zero-copy DMA-BUF)...").arg(displayName), 3500);
    PathResolver::startDetachedLinstack(QStringList() << "app" << "launch" << packageName);
    update();
}

bool AndroidCanvas::embedWindow(WId winId)
{
    Q_UNUSED(winId);
    m_simulatedActive = true;
    if (m_stack) m_stack->hide();
    update();
    return true;
}

bool AndroidCanvas::embedWindow(QWindow *foreignWindow)
{
    Q_UNUSED(foreignWindow);
    m_simulatedActive = true;
    if (m_stack) m_stack->hide();
    update();
    return true;
}

void AndroidCanvas::releaseEmbeddedWindow()
{
    if (m_aimModeActive) {
        setAimMode(false);
    }

    m_simulatedActive = true;
    if (m_stack) {
        m_stack->hide();
    }
    setKeymapperVisible(false);
    emit windowReleased();
    update();
}

void AndroidCanvas::setOrientation(Orientation orientation)
{
    m_orientation = orientation;
    updateCanvasGeometry();
    showToast(orientation == Orientation::Landscape ? "Screen rotated to Landscape (16:9)"
                                                    : "Screen rotated to Portrait (9:16)");
}

void AndroidCanvas::setBaseResolution(int baseWidth, int baseHeight)
{
    m_baseWidth  = qMax(1, baseWidth);
    m_baseHeight = qMax(1, baseHeight);
    if (m_aspectRatio) {
        m_aspectRatio->setTargetResolution(m_baseWidth, m_baseHeight);
    }
    updateCanvasGeometry();
}

void AndroidCanvas::updateCanvasGeometry()
{
    int arW = (m_orientation == Orientation::Landscape) ? m_baseWidth  : m_baseHeight;
    int arH = (m_orientation == Orientation::Landscape) ? m_baseHeight : m_baseWidth;

    if (m_aspectRatio) {
        m_aspectRatio->setTargetResolution(arW, arH);
        ViewportRect vp = m_aspectRatio->computeViewport(width(), height());
        m_viewportRect = QRect(vp.x, vp.y, vp.width, vp.height);
        if (m_inputMapper) {
            m_inputMapper->setGeometry(vp, arW, arH);
        }
    }

    if (m_stack) {
        m_stack->setGeometry(m_viewportRect);
    }

    if (m_keymapperOverlay) {
        m_keymapperOverlay->setGeometry(m_viewportRect);
        if (m_keymapperOverlay->translator()) {
            m_keymapperOverlay->translator()->setScreenGeometry(m_baseWidth, m_baseHeight);
        }
    }

    if (m_toastLabel) {
        m_toastLabel->adjustSize();
        m_toastLabel->move(
            m_viewportRect.x() + (m_viewportRect.width()  - m_toastLabel->width())  / 2,
            m_viewportRect.y() +  m_viewportRect.height() - m_toastLabel->height() - 28
        );
    }
}

void AndroidCanvas::initializeGL()
{
    LOG_INFO("AndroidCanvas", "Initializing OpenGL ES 2.0 / DMA-BUF Surface Renderer...");
    m_surfaceRenderer = std::make_unique<WaylandSurfaceRenderer>();
    if (!m_surfaceRenderer->initialize()) {
        LOG_CRITICAL("AndroidCanvas", "Failed to compile zero-copy GLES2 shader program");
    } else {
        LOG_INFO("AndroidCanvas", "Zero-copy Wayland Surface GLES2 Renderer initialized successfully.");
    }
}

void AndroidCanvas::paintGL()
{
    int w = width();
    int h = height();
    if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return;

    glClearColor(0.05f, 0.05f, 0.07f, 1.0f);
    glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT);

    ViewportRect vp;
    if (m_aspectRatio) {
        vp = m_aspectRatio->computeViewport(w, h);
        m_viewportRect = QRect(vp.x, vp.y, vp.width, vp.height);
    } else {
        vp = ViewportRect{0, 0, w, h};
    }

    if (!m_surfaceRenderer) return;
    if (vp.x > 0 || vp.y > 0) {
        m_surfaceRenderer->clearLetterboxBars(vp, w, h);
    }

    struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = m_compositor ? m_compositor->getRenderableSurface() : nullptr;
    if (!activeSurface) return;

    int surfW = 0, surfH = 0;
    wlr_bridge_surface_get_size(activeSurface, &surfW, &surfH);
    if (surfW > 0 && surfH > 0 && (surfW != m_baseWidth || surfH != m_baseHeight)) {
        m_baseWidth = surfW;
        m_baseHeight = surfH;
        if (m_aspectRatio) {
            m_aspectRatio->setTargetResolution(m_baseWidth, m_baseHeight);
            vp = m_aspectRatio->computeViewport(w, h);
            m_viewportRect = QRect(vp.x, vp.y, vp.width, vp.height);
        }
    }

    EGLDisplay qtDpy  = eglGetCurrentDisplay();
    EGLContext qtCtx  = eglGetCurrentContext();
    EGLSurface qtDraw = eglGetCurrentSurface(EGL_DRAW);
    EGLSurface qtRead = eglGetCurrentSurface(EGL_READ);

    bool rendered = false;

    // 1. المسار السريع Zero-Copy الحقيقي (يدعم تعدد المستويات لبطاقات Intel HD 530)
    struct wlr_bridge_dmabuf_attribs dmabuf = {};
    if (wlr_bridge_surface_get_dmabuf(activeSurface, &dmabuf)) {
        static auto s_eglCreateImageKHR = reinterpret_cast<PFNEGLCREATEIMAGEKHRPROC>(
            eglGetProcAddress("eglCreateImageKHR"));
        static auto s_eglDestroyImageKHR = reinterpret_cast<PFNEGLDESTROYIMAGEKHRPROC>(
            eglGetProcAddress("eglDestroyImageKHR"));

        if (s_eglCreateImageKHR && s_eglDestroyImageKHR && dmabuf.n_planes > 0) {
            std::vector<EGLint> attribs = {
                EGL_WIDTH, static_cast<EGLint>(dmabuf.width),
                EGL_HEIGHT, static_cast<EGLint>(dmabuf.height),
                EGL_LINUX_DRM_FOURCC_EXT, static_cast<EGLint>(dmabuf.format)
            };

            const EGLint planeFdKeys[]    = { EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE0_FD_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE1_FD_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE2_FD_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE3_FD_EXT };
            const EGLint planeOffKeys[]   = { EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE0_OFFSET_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE1_OFFSET_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE2_OFFSET_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE3_OFFSET_EXT };
            const EGLint planePitchKeys[] = { EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE0_PITCH_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE1_PITCH_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE2_PITCH_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE3_PITCH_EXT };
            const EGLint planeModLoKeys[] = { EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE0_MODIFIER_LO_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE1_MODIFIER_LO_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE2_MODIFIER_LO_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE3_MODIFIER_LO_EXT };
            const EGLint planeModHiKeys[] = { EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE0_MODIFIER_HI_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE1_MODIFIER_HI_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE2_MODIFIER_HI_EXT, EGL_DMA_BUF_PLANE3_MODIFIER_HI_EXT };

            for (int i = 0; i < dmabuf.n_planes && i < 4; ++i) {
                attribs.push_back(planeFdKeys[i]);
                attribs.push_back(dmabuf.fd[i]);
                attribs.push_back(planeOffKeys[i]);
                attribs.push_back(static_cast<EGLint>(dmabuf.offset[i]));
                attribs.push_back(planePitchKeys[i]);
                attribs.push_back(static_cast<EGLint>(dmabuf.stride[i]));

                if (dmabuf.modifier != DRM_FORMAT_MOD_INVALID) {
                    attribs.push_back(planeModLoKeys[i]);
                    attribs.push_back(static_cast<EGLint>(dmabuf.modifier & 0xFFFFFFFF));
                    attribs.push_back(planeModHiKeys[i]);
                    attribs.push_back(static_cast<EGLint>(dmabuf.modifier >> 32));
                }
            }
            attribs.push_back(EGL_NONE);

            EGLImageKHR eglImg = s_eglCreateImageKHR(
                qtDpy, EGL_NO_CONTEXT, EGL_LINUX_DMA_BUF_EXT, nullptr, attribs.data());

            if (eglImg != EGL_NO_IMAGE_KHR) {
                rendered = m_surfaceRenderer->renderEglImage(
                    eglImg, true, dmabuf.width, dmabuf.height, vp, w, h);
                s_eglDestroyImageKHR(qtDpy, eglImg);
            } else {
                static bool loggedOnce = false;
                if (!loggedOnce) {
                    loggedOnce = true;
                    LOG_WARN("AndroidCanvas", QString("DMA-BUF EGLImage creation failed (err: 0x%1, planes: %2) - falling back to CPU!")
                    .arg(eglGetError(), 0, 16).arg(dmabuf.n_planes));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // 2. المسار الاحتياطي (CPU Readback) فقط إذا فشل DMA-BUF أو كان التطبيق يستخدم wl_shm
    if (!rendered && m_compositor->makeCurrent()) {
        struct wlr_texture *wlrTex = wlr_bridge_surface_get_texture(activeSurface);
        int texW = 0, texH = 0;
        wlr_bridge_texture_get_size(wlrTex, &texW, &texH);
        if (wlrTex && texW > 0 && texH > 0) {
            uint32_t stride = static_cast<uint32_t>(texW) * 4u;
            m_cpuReadbackBuffer.resize(stride * texH);

            bool readOk = wlr_bridge_texture_read_pixels(wlrTex, DRM_FORMAT_ABGR8888, stride, m_cpuReadbackBuffer.data());
            eglMakeCurrent(qtDpy, qtDraw, qtRead, qtCtx);

            if (readOk) {
                rendered = m_surfaceRenderer->renderCpuPixels(
                    m_cpuReadbackBuffer.data(),
                    texW,
                    texH,
                    vp, w, h);
            }
        } else {
            eglMakeCurrent(qtDpy, qtDraw, qtRead, qtCtx);
        }
    }

    if (rendered && m_compositor->makeCurrent()) {
        m_surfaceRenderer->sendFrameDone(activeSurface);
        eglMakeCurrent(qtDpy, qtDraw, qtRead, qtCtx);
    }
}



void AndroidCanvas::resizeGL(int w, int h)
{
    Q_UNUSED(w);
    Q_UNUSED(h);
    updateCanvasGeometry();
}

void AndroidCanvas::resizeEvent(QResizeEvent *event)
{
    QOpenGLWidget::resizeEvent(event);
    updateCanvasGeometry();
}

void AndroidCanvas::paintEvent(QPaintEvent *event)
{
    QOpenGLWidget::paintEvent(event);

    if (m_hasFirstFrame && !m_isDragOver) return;

    if (!isValid()) return;


    QPainter p(this);
    if (!p.isActive()) return;
    p.setRenderHint(QPainter::Antialiasing, true);

    // If first Android frame has not arrived yet, display a clean "Booting Android..." splash screen
    if (!m_hasFirstFrame) {
        const qreal cx = width() / 2.0;
        const qreal cy = height() / 2.0;

        p.setPen(Theme::ColorNeon);
        QFont fTitle = p.font();
        fTitle.setPointSize(18);
        fTitle.setBold(true);
        p.setFont(fTitle);
        p.drawText(QRectF(cx - 250, cy - 45, 500, 36), Qt::AlignCenter, "⚡ Booting Android...");

        p.setPen(Theme::ColorMint);
        QFont fSub = p.font();
        fSub.setPointSize(11);
        fSub.setBold(false);
        p.setFont(fSub);
        p.drawText(QRectF(cx - 250, cy, 500, 24), Qt::AlignCenter, "Initializing Wayland DMA-BUF hardware session...");

        p.setPen(Theme::ColorTextDim);
        QFont fDetail = p.font();
        fDetail.setPointSize(9);
        fDetail.setFamily("monospace");
        p.setFont(fDetail);
        p.drawText(QRectF(cx - 250, cy + 30, 500, 20), Qt::AlignCenter, "Direct OpenGL ES 2.0 / Mesa DRI3 Viewport Active");
    }

    if (m_isDragOver) {
        p.fillRect(rect(), QColor(11, 15, 25, 230));

        QPen pen(Theme::ColorNeon, 3.0, Qt::DashLine);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.drawRoundedRect(rect().adjusted(16, 16, -16, -16), 16, 16);

        const qreal cx = width() / 2.0;
        const qreal cy = height() / 2.0;

        p.setPen(Theme::ColorTextPrimary);
        QFont f = p.font();
        f.setPointSize(16);
        f.setBold(true);
        p.setFont(f);
        p.drawText(QRectF(cx - 200, cy - 30, 400, 30), Qt::AlignCenter, "📦 Drop APK to Install");

        p.setPen(Theme::ColorMint);
        f.setPointSize(11);
        f.setBold(false);
        p.setFont(f);
        p.drawText(QRectF(cx - 200, cy + 5, 400, 24), Qt::AlignCenter, "Direct injection into LinStack container environment");
    }
}

void AndroidCanvas::initWaylandCompositor()
{
    m_waylandSocketName = "wayland-linstack-0";
    qputenv("WAYLAND_DISPLAY", m_waylandSocketName.toUtf8());
    qputenv("LINSTACK_WAYLAND_DISPLAY", m_waylandSocketName.toUtf8());

    // قراءة معدل تحديث شاشة المستخدم تلقائياً (75Hz, 60Hz, 120Hz, 144Hz, إلخ)
    int screenHz = 60;
    if (QScreen *scr = this->screen() ? this->screen() : QGuiApplication::primaryScreen()) {
        if (scr->refreshRate() > 1.0) {
            screenHz = qRound(scr->refreshRate());
        }
    }

    EmbeddedCompositorConfig config;
    config.socketName = m_waylandSocketName.toStdString();
    config.defaultWidth = m_baseWidth;
    config.defaultHeight = m_baseHeight;
    config.refreshRate = screenHz;

    m_compositor = std::make_unique<EmbeddedCompositor>(config);

    if (!m_compositor->initialize()) {
        LOG_CRITICAL("AndroidCanvas", "Failed to initialize embedded wlroots compositor.");
        return;
    }

    if (!m_compositor->start()) {
        LOG_CRITICAL("AndroidCanvas", "Failed to start wlroots headless backend.");
        return;
    }

    m_inputMapper = std::make_unique<InputMapper>(m_compositor->getSeat(), m_compositor->getRelativePointerManager());
    if (m_keymapperOverlay) {
        m_keymapperOverlay->setInputMapper(m_inputMapper.get());
    }

    // ربط حلقة أحداث Wayland بحلقة Qt عبر QSocketNotifier
    int wlFd = m_compositor->getEventLoopFd();
    if (wlFd >= 0) {
        m_waylandNotifier = new QSocketNotifier(wlFd, QSocketNotifier::Read, this);
        connect(m_waylandNotifier, &QSocketNotifier::activated, this, [this]() {
            if (m_compositor) {
                m_compositor->dispatch(0);
            }
        });
    }

    // ضبط مؤقت الإرسال ليتناسب مع تردد شاشة المستخدم دون إرهاق المعالج    // ضبط مؤقت الإرسال كاحتياطي خفيف (50ms) لأن QSocketNotifier يتولى الاستجابة الفورية
    m_waylandDispatchTimer = new QTimer(this);
    connect(m_waylandDispatchTimer, &QTimer::timeout, this, [this]() {
        if (m_compositor) {
            m_compositor->dispatch(0);
        }
    });
    m_waylandDispatchTimer->start(50);

    auto *inputTickTimer = new QTimer(this);
    connect(inputTickTimer, &QTimer::timeout, this, [this]() {
        struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = m_compositor ? m_compositor->getRenderableSurface() : nullptr;
        if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface) {
            m_inputMapper->tick(activeSurface);
            if (m_compositor) {
                m_compositor->flush();
            }
        }
    });
    inputTickTimer->start(10);


    // ربط دوال دورة حياة السطح
    m_compositor->onClientConnected = [this](struct wl_client *client) {
        Q_UNUSED(client);
        QMetaObject::invokeMethod(this, [this]() {
            LOG_INFO("AndroidCanvas", "Wayland client connected to embedded compositor!");
            emit waylandClientConnected();
        }, Qt::QueuedConnection);
    };

    m_compositor->onSurfaceMapped = [this](struct wlr_surface *surface) {
        Q_UNUSED(surface);
        QMetaObject::invokeMethod(this, [this]() {
            LOG_INFO("AndroidCanvas", ">>> Android Container surface mapped (waiting for first buffer) <<<");
            m_simulatedActive = true;
            update();
        }, Qt::QueuedConnection);
    };

    m_compositor->onSurfaceUnmapped = [this](struct wlr_surface *surface) {
        Q_UNUSED(surface);
        QMetaObject::invokeMethod(this, [this]() {
            LOG_INFO("AndroidCanvas", "Android Surface unmapped");
            m_simulatedActive = true;
            m_hasFirstFrame = false;
            update();
        }, Qt::QueuedConnection);
    };

    m_compositor->onSurfaceCommit = [this](struct wlr_surface *surface) {
        if (m_compositor && surface != m_compositor->getRenderableSurface()) {
            return;
        }
        if (!m_hasFirstFrame && wlr_bridge_surface_has_buffer(surface)) {
            m_hasFirstFrame = true;
            QMetaObject::invokeMethod(this, [this]() {
                LOG_INFO("AndroidCanvas", ">>> First Android surface buffer committed — signalling firstFrameRendered <<<");
                emit firstFrameRendered();
                if (m_stack) m_stack->hide();
                showToast("LinStack Android 13 — First Frame Received!", 3000);
            }, Qt::QueuedConnection);
        }
        QMetaObject::invokeMethod(this, "update", Qt::QueuedConnection);
    };


    LOG_INFO("AndroidCanvas", QString("Embedded wlroots Compositor running on socket: %1 @ %2Hz")
    .arg(m_waylandSocketName)
    .arg(screenHz));
}


void AndroidCanvas::sendWaylandRecents()

    struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = m_compositor ? m_compositor->getRenderableSurface() : nullptr;
    if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface) {
        m_inputMapper->sendRecentsCombo(activeSurface);
        if (m_compositor) {
            m_compositor->flush();
        }
    }
}

        }
    }

void AndroidCanvas::showToast(const QString &message, int durationMs)
{
    m_toastLabel->setText(message);
    m_toastLabel->adjustSize();

    const QRect &vp = m_viewportRect.isValid() ? m_viewportRect : rect();
    m_toastLabel->move(
        vp.x() + (vp.width()  - m_toastLabel->width())  / 2,
        vp.y() +  vp.height() - m_toastLabel->height() - 28
    );
    m_toastLabel->show();
    m_toastLabel->raise();
    m_toastTimer->start(durationMs);
}

void AndroidCanvas::setAimMode(bool active, QPointF anchorNorm)
{
    m_aimModeActive = active;
    m_aimAnchorNorm = anchorNorm;

    auto *wlApp = qGuiApp->nativeInterface<QNativeInterface::QWaylandApplication>();

    if (m_aimModeActive) {
        setCursor(Qt::BlankCursor);
        if (window()) window()->setCursor(Qt::BlankCursor);
        if (m_keymapperOverlay) m_keymapperOverlay->setCursor(Qt::BlankCursor);
        QGuiApplication::setOverrideCursor(Qt::BlankCursor);

        // 1. قفل مؤشر النظام الحقيقي على مستوى Wayland
        auto *pni = QGuiApplication::platformNativeInterface();
        struct wl_surface *surf = (pni && window() && window()->windowHandle())
        ? static_cast<struct wl_surface *>(pni->nativeResourceForWindow("surface", window()->windowHandle()))
        : nullptr;

        if (wlApp && surf && !m_wlLockedPointer) {


            struct wl_display *dpy = wlApp->display();
            struct wl_pointer *ptr = wlApp->pointer();

            if (dpy && ptr && surf) {


                if (!m_wlPointerConstraints) {
                    struct wl_registry *reg = wl_display_get_registry(dpy);
                    static struct wl_registry_listener regListener = {
                        [](void *data, struct wl_registry *r, uint32_t id, const char *iface, uint32_t ver) {
                            if (std::string(iface) == zwp_pointer_constraints_v1_interface.name) {
                                *static_cast<void **>(data) = wl_registry_bind(
                                    r, id, &zwp_pointer_constraints_v1_interface, std::min(ver, 1u));
                            }
                        },
                        [](void *, struct wl_registry *, uint32_t) {}
                    };
                    wl_registry_add_listener(reg, &regListener, &m_wlPointerConstraints);
                    wl_display_roundtrip(dpy);
                    wl_registry_destroy(reg);
                }

                if (m_wlPointerConstraints) {
                    m_wlLockedPointer = zwp_pointer_constraints_v1_lock_pointer(
                        static_cast<struct zwp_pointer_constraints_v1 *>(m_wlPointerConstraints),
                                                                                surf, ptr, nullptr, ZWP_POINTER_CONSTRAINTS_V1_LIFETIME_PERSISTENT);
                    wl_display_flush(dpy);
                }
            }
        }

        // 2. قراءة حركة الماوس الخام مباشرة من /dev/input/mice
        if (m_rawMouseFd < 0) {
            m_rawMouseFd = ::open("/dev/input/mice", O_RDONLY | O_NONBLOCK);
            if (m_rawMouseFd >= 0) {
                m_rawMouseNotifier = new QSocketNotifier(m_rawMouseFd, QSocketNotifier::Read, this);
                connect(m_rawMouseNotifier, &QSocketNotifier::activated, this, [this]() {
                    if (!m_aimModeActive || m_rawMouseFd < 0) return;
                    signed char packet[3];
                    int totalDx = 0, totalDy = 0;
                    while (::read(m_rawMouseFd, packet, sizeof(packet)) == 3) {
                        totalDx += static_cast<int>(packet[1]);
                        totalDy -= static_cast<int>(packet[2]);
                    }
                    struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = m_compositor ? m_compositor->getRenderableSurface() : nullptr;
                    if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface && (totalDx != 0 || totalDy != 0)) {
                        m_inputMapper->handleMouseMove(0, 0, totalDx, totalDy, activeSurface);
                        if (m_compositor) m_compositor->flush();
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        showToast("🎯 Aim Lock Active (Press Aim Key or ESC to unlock)", 2000);
    } else {
        if (m_wlLockedPointer) {
            zwp_locked_pointer_v1_destroy(static_cast<struct zwp_locked_pointer_v1 *>(m_wlLockedPointer));
            m_wlLockedPointer = nullptr;
            if (wlApp && wlApp->display()) wl_display_flush(wlApp->display());
        }

        while (QGuiApplication::overrideCursor()) {
            QGuiApplication::restoreOverrideCursor();
        }
        if (m_rawMouseNotifier) {
            delete m_rawMouseNotifier;
            m_rawMouseNotifier = nullptr;
        }
        if (m_rawMouseFd >= 0) {
            ::close(m_rawMouseFd);
            m_rawMouseFd = -1;
        }
        setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
        if (window()) window()->setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
        if (m_keymapperOverlay) m_keymapperOverlay->setCursor(Qt::ArrowCursor);
        showToast("Aim Lock Released", 1500);
    }

    emit aimModeChanged(m_aimModeActive);
}

void AndroidCanvas::mousePressEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = m_compositor ? m_compositor->getRenderableSurface() : nullptr;
    int button = (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton) ? 1 : ((event->button() == Qt::RightButton) ? 3 : 2);

    if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface) {
        int surfW = m_baseWidth;
        int surfH = m_baseHeight;
        wlr_bridge_surface_get_size(activeSurface, &surfW, &surfH);
        if (surfW <= 0) surfW = m_baseWidth;
        if (surfH <= 0) surfH = m_baseHeight;
        ViewportRect vp{m_viewportRect.x(), m_viewportRect.y(), m_viewportRect.width(), m_viewportRect.height()};
        m_inputMapper->setGeometry(vp, surfW, surfH);

        if (!isKeymapperVisible() && m_inputMapper->isAimLockActive()) {
            m_inputMapper->setAimLockActive(false, -1);
        }

        if (m_inputMapper->handleMouseDown(button, qRound(event->position().x()), qRound(event->position().y()), activeSurface)) {
            if (m_compositor) m_compositor->flush();
            event->accept();
            return;
        }
    }
    QOpenGLWidget::mousePressEvent(event);
}

void AndroidCanvas::mouseMoveEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = m_compositor ? m_compositor->getRenderableSurface() : nullptr;

    if (isKeymapperVisible() && m_aimModeActive) {
        // تجاهل أحداث Qt إذا كان قارئ الماوس الخام يعمل لمنع تضاعف الحركة
        if (m_rawMouseFd >= 0) {
            event->accept();
            return;
        }

        QPoint currentGlobal = event->globalPosition().toPoint();
        if (m_ignoreNextMouseMove) {
            m_ignoreNextMouseMove = false;
            m_lastMousePos = currentGlobal;
            event->accept();
            return;
        }

        int dx = currentGlobal.x() - m_lastMousePos.x();
        int dy = currentGlobal.y() - m_lastMousePos.y();
        m_lastMousePos = currentGlobal;

        // تجاهل الارتداد العكسي المفاجئ الناتج عن قفزة المؤشر على Wayland
        if (std::abs(dx) > 250 || std::abs(dy) > 250) {
            event->accept();
            return;
        }

        if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface && (dx != 0 || dy != 0)) {
            m_inputMapper->handleMouseMove(qRound(event->position().x()), qRound(event->position().y()), dx, dy, activeSurface);
            if (m_compositor) m_compositor->flush();
        }

        // إعادة المؤشر للمنتصف فقط عند الاقتراب من الحواف لمنع التردد
        QPoint localPos = event->position().toPoint();
        const int margin = 90;
        if (localPos.x() < margin || localPos.x() > width() - margin ||
            localPos.y() < margin || localPos.y() > height() - margin) {
            QPoint localAnchor(
                m_viewportRect.x() + qRound(m_aimAnchorNorm.x() * m_viewportRect.width()),
                               m_viewportRect.y() + qRound(m_aimAnchorNorm.y() * m_viewportRect.height())
            );
        QPoint globalAnchor = mapToGlobal(localAnchor);
        m_ignoreNextMouseMove = true;
        QCursor::setPos(globalAnchor);
            }

            event->accept();
            return;
    }

    if (isKeymapperVisible() && m_inputMapper && activeSurface && m_inputMapper->isSmartCasting()) {
        m_inputMapper->handleMouseMove(qRound(event->position().x()), qRound(event->position().y()), 0, 0, activeSurface);
        if (m_compositor) m_compositor->flush();
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface && (event->buttons() & Qt::LeftButton)) {
        m_inputMapper->handleMouseMove(qRound(event->position().x()), qRound(event->position().y()), 0, 0, activeSurface);
        if (m_compositor) m_compositor->flush();
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    QOpenGLWidget::mouseMoveEvent(event);
}

void AndroidCanvas::mouseReleaseEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = m_compositor ? m_compositor->getRenderableSurface() : nullptr;
    int button = (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton) ? 1 : ((event->button() == Qt::RightButton) ? 3 : 2);

    if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface) {
        if (m_inputMapper->handleMouseUp(button, qRound(event->position().x()), qRound(event->position().y()), activeSurface)) {
            if (m_compositor) m_compositor->flush();
            event->accept();
            return;
        }
    }
    QOpenGLWidget::mouseReleaseEvent(event);
}

void AndroidCanvas::wheelEvent(QWheelEvent *event)

{
    QOpenGLWidget::wheelEvent(event);
}

void AndroidCanvas::keyPressEvent(QKeyEvent *event)
{
    if (event->isAutoRepeat()) {
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = m_compositor ? m_compositor->getRenderableSurface() : nullptr;
    if (isKeymapperVisible()) {
        if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface) {
            quint32 scanCode = event->nativeScanCode();
            if (m_inputMapper->handleScanCodeDown(scanCode, activeSurface)) {
                if (m_compositor) m_compositor->flush();
                bool nowLocked = m_inputMapper->isAimLockActive() || m_inputMapper->isFreeLookActive();
                if (nowLocked != m_aimModeActive) {
                    QPointF anchor(0.5, 0.5);
                    if (const auto *aim = m_inputMapper->activeAimNode()) {
                        anchor = QPointF(aim->centerX, aim->centerY);
                    } else if (const auto *fl = m_inputMapper->activeFreeLookNode()) {
                        anchor = QPointF(fl->centerX, fl->centerY);
                    }
                    setAimMode(nowLocked, anchor);
                }
                event->accept();
                return;
            }
        }
    } else {
        if ((event->modifiers() & (Qt::ControlModifier | Qt::AltModifier | Qt::MetaModifier)) ||
            event->key() == Qt::Key_F11) {
            event->ignore();
            return;
        }
        // When Keymapping is OFF, forward 100% of native keyPressEvent to Wayland wl_keyboard
        if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface) {
            quint32 scanCode = event->nativeScanCode();
            m_inputMapper->forwardNativeKey(scanCode, true, activeSurface);
            if (m_compositor) m_compositor->flush();
            event->accept();
            return;
        }
    }
    QOpenGLWidget::keyPressEvent(event);
}

void AndroidCanvas::keyReleaseEvent(QKeyEvent *event)
{
    if (event->isAutoRepeat()) {
        event->accept();
        return;
    }

    struct wlr_surface *activeSurface = m_compositor ? m_compositor->getRenderableSurface() : nullptr;
    if (isKeymapperVisible()) {
        if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface) {
            quint32 scanCode = event->nativeScanCode();
            if (m_inputMapper->handleScanCodeUp(scanCode, activeSurface)) {
                if (m_compositor) m_compositor->flush();
                bool nowLocked = m_inputMapper->isAimLockActive() || m_inputMapper->isFreeLookActive();
                if (nowLocked != m_aimModeActive) {
                    QPointF anchor(0.5, 0.5);
                    if (const auto *aim = m_inputMapper->activeAimNode()) {
                        anchor = QPointF(aim->centerX, aim->centerY);
                    } else if (const auto *fl = m_inputMapper->activeFreeLookNode()) {
                        anchor = QPointF(fl->centerX, fl->centerY);
                    }
                    setAimMode(nowLocked, anchor);
                }
                event->accept();
                return;
            }
        }
    } else {
        if ((event->modifiers() & (Qt::ControlModifier | Qt::AltModifier | Qt::MetaModifier)) ||
            event->key() == Qt::Key_F11) {
            event->ignore();
            return;
        }
        // When Keymapping is OFF, forward 100% of native keyReleaseEvent to Wayland wl_keyboard
        if (m_inputMapper && activeSurface) {
            quint32 scanCode = event->nativeScanCode();
            m_inputMapper->forwardNativeKey(scanCode, false, activeSurface);
            if (m_compositor) m_compositor->flush();
            event->accept();
            return;
        }
    }
    QOpenGLWidget::keyReleaseEvent(event);
}

void AndroidCanvas::dragEnterEvent(QDragEnterEvent *event)

{
    if (event->mimeData()->hasUrls()) {
        const auto urls = event->mimeData()->urls();
        for (const auto &url : urls) {
            if (url.toLocalFile().endsWith(".apk", Qt::CaseInsensitive)) {
                event->acceptProposedAction();
                m_isDragOver = true;
                update();
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    event->ignore();
}

void AndroidCanvas::dragLeaveEvent(QDragLeaveEvent *event)
{
    Q_UNUSED(event);
    m_isDragOver = false;
    update();
}

void AndroidCanvas::dropEvent(QDropEvent *event)
{
    m_isDragOver = false;
    update();

    if (event->mimeData()->hasUrls()) {
        for (const auto &url : event->mimeData()->urls()) {
            QString path = url.toLocalFile();
            if (path.endsWith(".apk", Qt::CaseInsensitive)) {
                event->acceptProposedAction();
                QFileInfo fi(path);
                emit apkDropped(path);

                AndroidAppEntry newApp;
                newApp.packageName = "com.custom." + fi.baseName().toLower();
                newApp.displayName = fi.baseName();
                newApp.iconType = Theme::IconType::InstallApk;
                newApp.accentColor = Theme::ColorNeon;
                newApp.isGame = true;
                addInstalledApp(newApp);

                showToast(QString("Installing APK: %1 via ADB / container...").arg(fi.fileName()), 4000);
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}

void AndroidCanvas::setInstalledApps(const QList<AndroidAppEntry> &apps)
{
    m_installedApps = apps;
    rebuildAppsGrid();
}

void AndroidCanvas::addInstalledApp(const AndroidAppEntry &app)
{
    m_installedApps.append(app);
    rebuildAppsGrid();
}

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/UInputTouchBridge.cpp ---
#include "UInputTouchBridge.h"

#include <libevdev/libevdev.h>
#include <libevdev/libevdev-uinput.h>
#include <linux/uinput.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstring>
#include <QDebug>

UInputTouchBridge::UInputTouchBridge(QObject *parent)
    : QObject(parent)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SLOTS; ++i) {
        m_slots[i] = SlotState{};
    }
}

UInputTouchBridge::~UInputTouchBridge()
{
    closeDevice();
}

void UInputTouchBridge::closeDevice()
{
    if (m_uinputDev) {
        libevdev_uinput_destroy(m_uinputDev);
        m_uinputDev = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_dev) {
        libevdev_free(m_dev);
        m_dev = nullptr;
    }
    if (m_fd >= 0) {
        close(m_fd);
        m_fd = -1;
    }
    m_isReady = false;
}

bool UInputTouchBridge::initialize(int screenWidth, int screenHeight)
{
    closeDevice();

    m_screenWidth = screenWidth;
    m_screenHeight = screenHeight;

    // Check if /dev/uinput can be opened
    m_fd = open("/dev/uinput", O_RDWR | O_NONBLOCK);
    if (m_fd < 0) {
        int err = errno;
        m_mockMode = true;
        m_lastError = QString("Cannot open /dev/uinput (%1): %2. Running in dry-run simulation mode.\n"
                              "To grant permissions, execute:\n"
                              "sudo usermod -aG input $USER && sudo chmod 666 /dev/uinput")
                          .arg(err)
                          .arg(strerror(err));
        emit errorOccurred(m_lastError);
        return false;
    }

    m_dev = libevdev_new();
    if (!m_dev) {
        m_lastError = "Failed to allocate libevdev structure.";
        emit errorOccurred(m_lastError);
        closeDevice();
        m_mockMode = true;
        return false;
    }

    libevdev_set_name(m_dev, "LinStack Virtual Multi-Touch (Linstack)");
    libevdev_set_id_bustype(m_dev, BUS_VIRTUAL);
    libevdev_set_id_vendor(m_dev, 0x18D1); // Google
    libevdev_set_id_product(m_dev, 0x0001);
    libevdev_set_id_version(m_dev, 1);

    // Synchronizations & Touch keys
    libevdev_enable_event_type(m_dev, EV_SYN);
    libevdev_enable_event_type(m_dev, EV_KEY);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_KEY, BTN_TOUCH, nullptr);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_KEY, KEY_BACK, nullptr);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_KEY, KEY_HOMEPAGE, nullptr);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_KEY, KEY_APPSELECT, nullptr);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_KEY, KEY_VOLUMEUP, nullptr);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_KEY, KEY_VOLUMEDOWN, nullptr);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_KEY, BTN_TOOL_FINGER, nullptr);

    // Absolute axis configuration for multi-touch
    libevdev_enable_event_type(m_dev, EV_ABS);

    struct input_absinfo abs_x = { 0, 0, m_screenWidth, 0, 0, 0 };
    struct input_absinfo abs_y = { 0, 0, m_screenHeight, 0, 0, 0 };
    struct input_absinfo abs_slot = { 0, 0, MAX_SLOTS - 1, 0, 0, 0 };
    struct input_absinfo abs_tracking = { 0, 0, 65535, 0, 0, 0 };
    struct input_absinfo abs_pressure = { 0, 0, 255, 0, 0, 0 };

    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_ABS, ABS_X, &abs_x);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_ABS, ABS_Y, &abs_y);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_ABS, ABS_MT_SLOT, &abs_slot);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_ABS, ABS_MT_TRACKING_ID, &abs_tracking);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_ABS, ABS_MT_POSITION_X, &abs_x);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_ABS, ABS_MT_POSITION_Y, &abs_y);
    libevdev_enable_event_code(m_dev, EV_ABS, ABS_MT_PRESSURE, &abs_pressure);

    int rc = libevdev_uinput_create_from_device(m_dev, m_fd, &m_uinputDev);
    if (rc < 0) {
        m_mockMode = true;
        m_lastError = QString("Failed to create uinput device via libevdev (code %1): %2")
                          .arg(rc).arg(strerror(-rc));
        emit errorOccurred(m_lastError);
        closeDevice();
        return false;
    }

    const char *devNode = libevdev_uinput_get_devnode(m_uinputDev);
    m_devicePath = devNode ? QString::fromUtf8(devNode) : "/dev/uinput";
    m_isReady = true;
    m_mockMode = false;

    emit deviceCreated(m_devicePath);
    return true;
}

void UInputTouchBridge::emitEvent(unsigned int type, unsigned int code, int value)
{
    if (m_uinputDev && m_isReady) {
        libevdev_uinput_write_event(m_uinputDev, type, code, value);
    }
}

void UInputTouchBridge::touchDown(int slot, int x, int y)
{
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= MAX_SLOTS) return;

    m_slots[slot].active = true;
    m_slots[slot].x = x;
    m_slots[slot].y = y;
    m_slots[slot].trackingId = m_nextTrackingId++;
    if (m_nextTrackingId > 65530) m_nextTrackingId = 1;

    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_MT_SLOT, slot);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_MT_TRACKING_ID, m_slots[slot].trackingId);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_MT_POSITION_X, x);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_MT_POSITION_Y, y);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_MT_PRESSURE, 180);
    emitEvent(EV_KEY, BTN_TOUCH, 1);
    emitEvent(EV_KEY, BTN_TOOL_FINGER, 1);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_X, x);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_Y, y);
    sync();

    emit touchEventInjected(slot, x, y, true);
}

void UInputTouchBridge::touchMove(int slot, int x, int y)
{
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= MAX_SLOTS) return;
    if (!m_slots[slot].active) {
        touchDown(slot, x, y);
        return;
    }

    m_slots[slot].x = x;
    m_slots[slot].y = y;

    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_MT_SLOT, slot);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_MT_POSITION_X, x);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_MT_POSITION_Y, y);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_X, x);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_Y, y);
    sync();

    emit touchEventInjected(slot, x, y, true);
}

void UInputTouchBridge::touchUp(int slot)
{
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= MAX_SLOTS) return;
    if (!m_slots[slot].active) return;

    m_slots[slot].active = false;

    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_MT_SLOT, slot);
    emitEvent(EV_ABS, ABS_MT_TRACKING_ID, -1);

    // Check if any other slot remains active
    bool anyActive = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SLOTS; ++i) {
        if (m_slots[i].active) {
            anyActive = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!anyActive) {
        emitEvent(EV_KEY, BTN_TOUCH, 0);
        emitEvent(EV_KEY, BTN_TOOL_FINGER, 0);
    }

    sync();
    emit touchEventInjected(slot, m_slots[slot].x, m_slots[slot].y, false);
}

void UInputTouchBridge::sendKeyEvent(unsigned int keyCode)
{
    if (!m_isReady) return;
    emitEvent(EV_KEY, keyCode, 1);
    sync();
    emitEvent(EV_KEY, keyCode, 0);
    sync();
}

void UInputTouchBridge::sync()
{
    emitEvent(EV_SYN, SYN_REPORT, 0);
}

#include "PathResolver.h"
#include <QCoreApplication>
#include <QDir>
#include <QFileInfo>
#include <QStandardPaths>
#include <QProcessEnvironment>

#ifndef LIN_STACK_INSTALL_PREFIX
#define LIN_STACK_INSTALL_PREFIX "/usr"
#endif

#ifndef LIN_STACK_DATADIR
#define LIN_STACK_DATADIR LIN_STACK_INSTALL_PREFIX "/share/linstack"
#endif

QString PathResolver::resolveResourcesDir()
{
    QString appDir = QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath();
    QStringList candidates = {
        // 1. Relative to executable / project root (local development & portable builds)
        appDir + "/resources",
        appDir + "/../resources",
        appDir + "/../../resources",
        appDir + "/../LinStack/resources",
        appDir + "/../../LinStack/resources",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/resources",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/../resources",
        // 2. Standard system installation directories
        "/opt/linstack/resources",
        QString(LIN_STACK_DATADIR) + "/resources",
        "/usr/share/linstack/resources",
        "/usr/local/share/linstack/resources",
        "/var/lib/linstack/images",
        "/usr/share/linstack-extra/images",
        "/etc/linstack-extra/images"
    };

    for (const QString &dir : candidates) {
        QFileInfo fi(dir);
        if (fi.exists() && fi.isDir()) {
            // Prefer directory that actually contains system.img if present
            if (QFileInfo::exists(dir + "/system.img")) {
                return QDir::cleanPath(dir);
            }
        }
    }

    // Fallback: return the first existing candidate directory
    for (const QString &dir : candidates) {
        if (QFileInfo::exists(dir) && QFileInfo(dir).isDir()) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(dir);
        }
    }
    return QDir::cleanPath(appDir + "/resources");
}

QString PathResolver::resolveResource(const QString &fileName)
{
    if (QFileInfo::exists(fileName) && QFileInfo(fileName).isAbsolute()) {
        return QDir::cleanPath(fileName);
    }

    QString cleanName = fileName;
    if (cleanName.startsWith("resources/")) {
        cleanName = cleanName.mid(10);
    }

    QString dir = resolveResourcesDir();
    QString fullPath = dir + "/" + cleanName;
    if (QFileInfo::exists(fullPath)) {
        return QDir::cleanPath(fullPath);
    }

    // Also check direct candidates relative to app and cwd
    QString appDir = QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath();
    QStringList directCandidates = {
        appDir + "/" + fileName,
        appDir + "/../" + fileName,
        appDir + "/resources/" + cleanName,
        appDir + "/../resources/" + cleanName,
        QDir::currentPath() + "/" + fileName,
        QDir::currentPath() + "/resources/" + cleanName,
        QString(LIN_STACK_DATADIR) + "/resources/" + cleanName,
        "/usr/share/linstack/resources/" + cleanName,
        "/usr/local/share/linstack/resources/" + cleanName
    };

    for (const QString &path : directCandidates) {
        if (QFileInfo::exists(path)) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(path);
        }
    }

    return fullPath;
}

QString PathResolver::resolvePython3()
{
    QString py = QStandardPaths::findExecutable("python3");
    if (!py.isEmpty()) {
        return py;
    }
    return "python3";
}

QString PathResolver::resolveLinstackExecutable()
{
    QString appDir = QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath();
    QStringList candidatePaths = {
        // 1. Local project / portable builds (LinStack_core/linstack.py or wrapper)
        appDir + "/linstack",
        appDir + "/../linstack",
        appDir + "/LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        appDir + "/../LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        appDir + "/../../LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        appDir + "/../linstack.py",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/linstack",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/../LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        // 2. Standard system installation directories
        "/opt/linstack/LinStack_core/linstack.py",
        "/usr/local/bin/linstack",
        QString(LIN_STACK_INSTALL_PREFIX) + "/bin/linstack",
        "/usr/bin/linstack"
    };

    for (const QString &p : candidatePaths) {
        if (QFileInfo::exists(p)) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(p);
        }
    }

    QString systemExe = QStandardPaths::findExecutable("linstack");
    if (!systemExe.isEmpty()) {
        return systemExe;
    }

    return "linstack";
}

QString PathResolver::resolveToolsDir()
{
    QString appDir = QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath();
    QStringList candidates = {
        appDir + "/tools",
        appDir + "/../tools",
        appDir + "/LinStack_core/tools",
        appDir + "/../LinStack_core/tools",
        appDir + "/../../LinStack_core/tools",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/tools",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/LinStack_core/tools",
        QString(LIN_STACK_DATADIR) + "/tools",
        "/opt/linstack/LinStack_core/tools",
        "/opt/linstack/tools",
        "/usr/lib/linstack/tools",
        "/usr/share/linstack/tools"
    };

    for (const QString &d : candidates) {
        if (QFileInfo::exists(d) && QFileInfo(d).isDir()) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(d);
        }
    }
    return QString();
}

QString PathResolver::resolveCoreDir()
{
    QString appDir = QCoreApplication::applicationDirPath();
    QStringList candidates = {
        appDir + "/LinStack_core",
        appDir + "/../LinStack_core",
        appDir + "/../../LinStack_core",
        "/opt/linstack/LinStack_core",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/LinStack_core",
        QDir::currentPath() + "/../LinStack_core",
    };
    for (const QString &d : candidates) {
        if (QFileInfo::exists(d + "/Makefile") || QFileInfo::exists(d + "/linstack.py")) {
            return QDir::cleanPath(d);
        }
    }
    return QString();
}

QString PathResolver::resolveLinstackCommand(QStringList &args)
{
    QString exe = resolveLinstackExecutable();
    if (exe.endsWith(".py")) {
        args.prepend(exe);
        return resolvePython3();
    }
    return exe;
}

void PathResolver::configureProcess(QProcess *proc, const QStringList &args)
{
    if (!proc) return;

    QStringList effectiveArgs = args;
    QString prog = resolveLinstackCommand(effectiveArgs);
    proc->setProgram(prog);
    proc->setArguments(effectiveArgs);

    // Setup process environment with PYTHONPATH and dynamic LINSTACK_IMAGES_PATH
    QProcessEnvironment env = proc->processEnvironment();
    if (env.isEmpty()) {
        env = QProcessEnvironment::systemEnvironment();
    }

    QString resDir = resolveResourcesDir();
    if (!resDir.isEmpty()) {
        env.insert("LINSTACK_IMAGES_PATH", resDir);
    }

    QString exe = resolveLinstackExecutable();
    QString toolsParent;
    if (exe.endsWith(".py")) {
        toolsParent = QFileInfo(exe).absolutePath();
        proc->setWorkingDirectory(toolsParent);
    } else {
        QString toolsDir = resolveToolsDir();
        if (!toolsDir.isEmpty()) {
            toolsParent = QFileInfo(toolsDir).absolutePath();
        }
    }

    if (!toolsParent.isEmpty()) {
        QString cur = env.value("PYTHONPATH");
        if (!cur.isEmpty()) {
            env.insert("PYTHONPATH", toolsParent + ":" + cur);
        } else {
            env.insert("PYTHONPATH", toolsParent);
        }
    }
    proc->setProcessEnvironment(env);
}

int PathResolver::executeLinstack(const QStringList &args, int timeoutMs)
{
    QProcess proc;
    configureProcess(&proc, args);
    proc.start();
    if (!proc.waitForFinished(timeoutMs)) {
        proc.kill();
        proc.waitForFinished(200);
        return -1;
    }
    return proc.exitCode();
}

bool PathResolver::startDetachedLinstack(const QStringList &args)
{
    QProcess proc;
    configureProcess(&proc, args);
    return proc.startDetached();
}

QString PathResolver::userDataDir()
{
    QString dir = QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::AppLocalDataLocation);
    if (dir.isEmpty()) {
        dir = QDir::homePath() + "/.local/share/linStack";
    }
    QDir().mkpath(dir);
    return dir;
}

QString PathResolver::userStateDir()
{
    QString stateDir = QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::GenericDataLocation)
                           .replace("/share", "/state") + "/linStack";
    if (!QDir().mkpath(stateDir)) {
        stateDir = QDir::homePath() + "/.local/state/linStack";
        QDir().mkpath(stateDir);
    }
    return stateDir;
}

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/ScriptEngine.cpp ---
#include "ScriptEngine.h"
#include "UInputTouchBridge.h"

#include <QFile>
#include <QTextStream>
#include <QKeySequence>
#include <cmath>

// Swipe steps per 100ms budget (each step ~25ms)
static constexpr int kSwipeStepIntervalMs = 25;

ScriptEngine::ScriptEngine(UInputTouchBridge *bridge, QObject *parent)
    : QObject(parent)
    , m_bridge(bridge)
{
    m_stepTimer = new QTimer(this);
    m_stepTimer->setSingleShot(false);
    m_stepTimer->setInterval(kSwipeStepIntervalMs);
    connect(m_stepTimer, &QTimer::timeout, this, &ScriptEngine::onStepTimer);
}

ScriptEngine::~ScriptEngine()
{
    stop();
}

void ScriptEngine::setBridge(UInputTouchBridge *bridge)
{
    m_bridge = bridge;
}

bool ScriptEngine::loadScript(const QString &scriptText, QString *errorOut)
{
    stop();
    m_program.clear();
    m_loopStack.clear();
    m_ip = 0;

    QStringList lines = scriptText.split('\n', Qt::SkipEmptyParts);
    return compile(lines, errorOut);
}

bool ScriptEngine::loadScriptFile(const QString &filePath, QString *errorOut)
{
    QFile f(filePath);
    if (!f.open(QIODevice::ReadOnly | QIODevice::Text)) {
        if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Cannot open script file: %1").arg(filePath);
        return false;
    }
    return loadScript(QTextStream(&f).readAll(), errorOut);
}

bool ScriptEngine::compile(const QStringList &lines, QString *errorOut)
{
    // Stack of (loopBeginIndex, loopCount) for matching loopEnd
    QList<int> openLoopIndices;

    for (int lineNum = 0; lineNum < lines.size(); ++lineNum) {
        QString raw = lines[lineNum].trimmed();
        if (raw.isEmpty() || raw.startsWith('#') || raw.startsWith("//")) {
            continue; // skip comments / blank lines
        }

        QStringList parts = raw.split(' ', Qt::SkipEmptyParts);
        QString cmd = parts[0].toLower();
        Instruction instr;

        if (cmd == "tap") {
            if (parts.size() < 3) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: tap requires X Y").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            instr.op = OpCode::Tap;
            instr.x1 = parts[1].toInt();
            instr.y1 = parts[2].toInt();

        } else if (cmd == "swipe") {
            if (parts.size() < 6) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: swipe requires X1 Y1 X2 Y2 DurationMs").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            instr.op = OpCode::Swipe;
            instr.x1 = parts[1].toInt();
            instr.y1 = parts[2].toInt();
            instr.x2 = parts[3].toInt();
            instr.y2 = parts[4].toInt();
            instr.duration = qMax(50, parts[5].toInt());

        } else if (cmd == "wait") {
            if (parts.size() < 2) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: wait requires DelayMs").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            instr.op = OpCode::Wait;
            instr.duration = qMax(1, parts[1].toInt());

        } else if (cmd == "keydown") {
            if (parts.size() < 2) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: keyDown requires Key").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            instr.op = OpCode::KeyDown;
            instr.keyName = parts[1];

        } else if (cmd == "keyup") {
            if (parts.size() < 2) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: keyUp requires Key").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            instr.op = OpCode::KeyUp;
            instr.keyName = parts[1];

        } else if (cmd == "entershoot") {
            instr.op = OpCode::EnterShoot;

        } else if (cmd == "exitshoot") {
            instr.op = OpCode::ExitShoot;

        } else if (cmd == "loop") {
            instr.op = OpCode::LoopBegin;
            instr.loopCount = (parts.size() >= 2) ? parts[1].toInt() : 1;
            openLoopIndices.append(m_program.size());
            m_program.append(instr);
            continue; // don't re-append below

        } else if (cmd == "loopend") {
            if (openLoopIndices.isEmpty()) {
                if (errorOut) *errorOut = QString("Line %1: loopEnd without matching loop").arg(lineNum + 1);
                return false;
            }
            int beginIdx = openLoopIndices.takeLast();
            instr.op = OpCode::LoopEnd;
            instr.loopTarget = beginIdx;
            m_program.append(instr);
            continue;

        } else {
            // Unknown command — emit warning but continue (NOP)
            instr.op = OpCode::Nop;
        }

        m_program.append(instr);
    }

    if (!openLoopIndices.isEmpty()) {
        if (errorOut) *errorOut = "Unclosed loop block (missing loopEnd)";
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

void ScriptEngine::execute()
{
    if (m_program.isEmpty()) return;

    m_ip = 0;
    m_running = true;
    m_loopStack.clear();
    m_swipeInProgress = false;
    emit scriptStarted();

    // Kick off first instruction via timer to avoid blocking the event loop
    m_stepTimer->setInterval(1);
    m_stepTimer->start();
}

void ScriptEngine::stop()
{
    m_running = false;
    m_swipeInProgress = false;
    m_stepTimer->stop();
    m_loopStack.clear();
    m_ip = 0;
}

void ScriptEngine::onStepTimer()
{
    if (!m_running) {
        m_stepTimer->stop();
        return;
    }

    // Swipe sub-stepping
    if (m_swipeInProgress) {
        m_swipeStep++;
        qreal t = static_cast<qreal>(m_swipeStep) / m_swipeTotalSteps;
        int cx = m_swipeX1 + static_cast<int>((m_swipeX2 - m_swipeX1) * t);
        int cy = m_swipeY1 + static_cast<int>((m_swipeY2 - m_swipeY1) * t);

        if (m_swipeStep >= m_swipeTotalSteps) {
            if (m_bridge) {
                m_bridge->touchMove(8, cx, cy);
                m_bridge->touchUp(8);
            }
            m_swipeInProgress = false;
            finishCurrentInstruction();
        } else {
            if (m_bridge) {
                m_bridge->touchMove(8, cx, cy);
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    if (m_ip >= m_program.size()) {
        m_running = false;
        m_stepTimer->stop();
        emit scriptFinished();
        return;
    }

    executeInstruction(m_program[m_ip]);
}

void ScriptEngine::executeInstruction(const Instruction &instr)
{
    emit commandExecuted(QString("ip=%1 op=%2").arg(m_ip).arg(static_cast<int>(instr.op)));
    emit progressChanged(m_ip, m_program.size());

    switch (instr.op) {

    case OpCode::Tap:
        if (m_bridge) {
            m_bridge->touchDown(7, instr.x1, instr.y1);
            m_bridge->touchUp(7);
        }
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;

    case OpCode::Swipe: {
        m_swipeTotalSteps = qMax(1, instr.duration / kSwipeStepIntervalMs);
        m_swipeStep = 0;
        m_swipeX1 = instr.x1; m_swipeY1 = instr.y1;
        m_swipeX2 = instr.x2; m_swipeY2 = instr.y2;
        if (m_bridge) {
            m_bridge->touchDown(8, instr.x1, instr.y1);
        }
        m_swipeInProgress = true;
        m_stepTimer->setInterval(kSwipeStepIntervalMs);
        // Don't advance IP — onStepTimer will call finishCurrentInstruction() when done
        break;
    }

    case OpCode::Wait:
        m_stepTimer->stop();
        // Schedule resume after delay
        QTimer::singleShot(instr.duration, this, [this]() {
            if (m_running) {
                finishCurrentInstruction();
                m_stepTimer->setInterval(1);
                m_stepTimer->start();
            }
        });
        break;

    case OpCode::KeyDown:
        // Emit as text — InputTranslator is hooked up by MainWindow via signals
        // For now, emit commandExecuted which MainWindow can intercept
        emit commandExecuted(QString("keyDown:%1").arg(instr.keyName));
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;

    case OpCode::KeyUp:
        emit commandExecuted(QString("keyUp:%1").arg(instr.keyName));
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;

    case OpCode::EnterShoot:
        emit commandExecuted("enterShoot");
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;

    case OpCode::ExitShoot:
        emit commandExecuted("exitShoot");
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;

    case OpCode::LoopBegin: {
        // Push loop state: (beginIdx, remaining iterations)
        int remaining = (instr.loopCount < 0) ? -1 : instr.loopCount;
        m_loopStack.append(qMakePair(m_ip, remaining));
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;
    }

    case OpCode::LoopEnd: {
        if (m_loopStack.isEmpty()) {
            emit scriptError("loopEnd without matching loop state");
            stop();
            return;
        }
        auto &top = m_loopStack.last();
        if (top.second < 0) {
            // Infinite loop — jump back to begin+1
            m_ip = top.first + 1;
            m_stepTimer->setInterval(1);
            m_stepTimer->start();
        } else {
            top.second--;
            if (top.second > 0) {
                m_ip = top.first + 1;
                m_stepTimer->setInterval(1);
                m_stepTimer->start();
            } else {
                m_loopStack.removeLast();
                finishCurrentInstruction();
            }
        }
        break;
    }

    case OpCode::Nop:
    default:
        finishCurrentInstruction();
        break;
    }
}

void ScriptEngine::finishCurrentInstruction()
{
    m_ip++;
    if (m_ip >= m_program.size()) {
        m_running = false;
        m_stepTimer->stop();
        emit scriptFinished();
        return;
    }
    // Next instruction on next timer tick
    m_stepTimer->setInterval(1);
    if (!m_stepTimer->isActive()) {
        m_stepTimer->start();
    }
}

// ── Hotkey binding ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

void ScriptEngine::bindToHotkey(int qtKey, const QString &scriptText)
{
    m_hotkeys.insert(qtKey, scriptText);
}

void ScriptEngine::unbindHotkey(int qtKey)
{
    m_hotkeys.remove(qtKey);
}

bool ScriptEngine::triggerHotkey(int qtKey)
{
    if (!m_hotkeys.contains(qtKey)) return false;

    // Stop any currently running script before starting the new one
    stop();
    QString err;
    if (!loadScript(m_hotkeys[qtKey], &err)) {
        emit scriptError(err);
        return true;
    }
    execute();
    return true;
}

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/ScriptEngine.h ---
#ifndef SCRIPTENGINE_H
#define SCRIPTENGINE_H

#include <QObject>
#include <QString>
#include <QStringList>
#include <QList>
#include <QMap>
#include <QTimer>
#include <QQueue>

class UInputTouchBridge;

/**
 * @brief ScriptEngine — parse and execute LinStack macro script language.
 *
 * Supported commands:
 *   tap X Y                     — single touch down+up at pixel coords
 *   swipe X1 Y1 X2 Y2 DurMs    — linear multi-step swipe
 *   wait DelayMs                — pause execution for N milliseconds
 *   keyDown Key                 — simulate key press (Qt key name or code)
 *   keyUp Key                   — simulate key release
 *   enterShoot                  — activate aim-lock (FPS mode)
 *   exitShoot                   — deactivate aim-lock
 *   loop Count ... loopEnd      — repeat block Count times (-1 for infinite)
 *
 * Example script:
 *   tap 540 960
 *   wait 200
 *   swipe 200 800 200 400 300
 *   loop 3
 *     tap 900 600
 *     wait 100
 *   loopEnd
 */
class ScriptEngine : public QObject
{
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    explicit ScriptEngine(UInputTouchBridge *bridge, QObject *parent = nullptr);
    ~ScriptEngine() override;

    void setBridge(UInputTouchBridge *bridge);

    // Load script source text; compiles into instruction list
    bool loadScript(const QString &scriptText, QString *errorOut = nullptr);

    // Load from file path
    bool loadScriptFile(const QString &filePath, QString *errorOut = nullptr);

    // Start executing the loaded script from the beginning
    void execute();

    // Stop any running script immediately
    void stop();

    bool isRunning() const { return m_running; }

    // Bind a Qt key code to a script (scriptText stored directly)
    void bindToHotkey(int qtKey, const QString &scriptText);
    void unbindHotkey(int qtKey);

    // Returns true if the key was bound and a script was started
    bool triggerHotkey(int qtKey);

    // Current bound hotkeys
    QMap<int, QString> hotkeys() const { return m_hotkeys; }

signals:
    void scriptStarted();
    void scriptFinished();
    void scriptError(const QString &message);
    void commandExecuted(const QString &command);
    void progressChanged(int current, int total);

private slots:
    void onStepTimer();

private:
    enum class OpCode {
        Tap,
        Swipe,
        Wait,
        KeyDown,
        KeyUp,
        EnterShoot,
        ExitShoot,
        LoopBegin,
        LoopEnd,
        Nop
    };

    struct Instruction {
        OpCode op = OpCode::Nop;
        int x1 = 0, y1 = 0;
        int x2 = 0, y2 = 0;
        int duration = 0;     // ms for Wait / Swipe
        int loopCount = 0;    // -1 for infinite (LoopBegin)
        int loopTarget = -1;  // index of matching LoopBegin (for LoopEnd)
        QString keyName;
    };

    bool compile(const QStringList &lines, QString *errorOut);
    void executeInstruction(const Instruction &instr);
    void startSwipeExecution(const Instruction &instr);
    void finishCurrentInstruction();

    UInputTouchBridge   *m_bridge   = nullptr;
    QList<Instruction>   m_program;
    int                  m_ip       = 0;    // instruction pointer
    bool                 m_running  = false;

    // Loop stack: (loopBeginIndex, remainingIterations)
    QList<QPair<int,int>> m_loopStack;

    // Step timer for non-blocking execution
    QTimer *m_stepTimer = nullptr;

    // Swipe sub-state
    bool   m_swipeInProgress = false;
    int    m_swipeStep       = 0;
    int    m_swipeTotalSteps = 0;
    int    m_swipeX1 = 0, m_swipeY1 = 0;
    int    m_swipeX2 = 0, m_swipeY2 = 0;

    // Hotkey map: Qt key code → script text
    QMap<int, QString> m_hotkeys;
};

#endif // SCRIPTENGINE_H

void TitleBar::setMaximizedState(bool maximized)
{
    m_isMaximized = maximized;
    updateButtonIcons();
}

void TitleBar::updateButtonIcons()
{
    if (m_isMaximized) {
        m_maxBtn->setIcon(Theme::createIcon(Theme::IconType::WindowRestore, Theme::ColorTextMuted, 14));
        m_maxBtn->setToolTip("Restore");
    } else {
        m_maxBtn->setIcon(Theme::createIcon(Theme::IconType::WindowMaximize, Theme::ColorTextMuted, 14));
        m_maxBtn->setToolTip("Maximize");
    }
}

void TitleBar::setEngineStatus(const QString &text, bool active)
{
    m_statusText->setText(text);
    if (active) {
        m_statusDot->setStyleSheet("background-color: #00FF66; border-radius: 4px;");
    } else {
        m_statusDot->setStyleSheet("background-color: #F59E0B; border-radius: 4px;");
    }
}

void TitleBar::setFpsText(const QString &fps)
{
    m_fpsBadge->setText(fps);
}

void TitleBar::paintEvent(QPaintEvent *event)
{
    Q_UNUSED(event);
    QPainter p(this);

    // Cyber Titlebar Background
    p.fillRect(rect(), Theme::ColorBgPanel);

    // Bottom border separator
    p.setPen(Theme::ColorBorder);
    p.drawLine(0, height() - 1, width(), height() - 1);

    // Subtle emerald glow trace on the bottom border
    QLinearGradient glow(0, 0, width(), 0);
    glow.setColorAt(0.0, QColor(16, 185, 129, 0));
    glow.setColorAt(0.2, QColor(16, 185, 129, 80));
    glow.setColorAt(0.5, QColor(0, 255, 102, 140));
    glow.setColorAt(0.8, QColor(16, 185, 129, 80));
    glow.setColorAt(1.0, QColor(16, 185, 129, 0));
    p.setPen(QPen(QBrush(glow), 1.0));
    p.drawLine(0, height() - 1, width(), height() - 1);
}

void TitleBar::mousePressEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
        QWidget *child = childAt(event->position().toPoint());
        if (child == m_statusText || child == m_statusDot) {
            QMenu menu(this);
            menu.setStyleSheet(
                "QMenu { background-color: #0D121D; color: #F9FAFB; border: 1px solid #10B981; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px; }"
                "QMenu::item { padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; }"
                "QMenu::item:selected { background-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #00FF66; }"
            );
            QAction *actRestartSession = menu.addAction("🔄 Restart Session");
            QAction *actRestartContainer = menu.addAction("⚡ Restart Container");

            QAction *chosen = menu.exec(m_statusText->mapToGlobal(QPoint(0, m_statusText->height() + 4)));
            if (chosen == actRestartSession) {
                emit restartSessionRequested();
            } else if (chosen == actRestartContainer) {
                emit restartContainerRequested();
            }
            event->accept();
            return;
        }

        if (child == nullptr || child == this || child == m_titleLabel || child == m_logoIconLabel) {
            m_isDragging = true;
            m_dragStartPos = event->globalPosition().toPoint();
            event->accept();
            return;
        }
    }
    QWidget::mousePressEvent(event);
}


void TitleBar::mouseMoveEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (m_isDragging && (event->buttons() & Qt::LeftButton)) {
        QPoint globalPos = event->globalPosition().toPoint();
        QPoint delta = globalPos - m_dragStartPos;
        m_dragStartPos = globalPos;
        emit windowDragged(delta);
        event->accept();
        return;
    }
    QWidget::mouseMoveEvent(event);
}

void TitleBar::mouseReleaseEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
        m_isDragging = false;
    }
    QWidget::mouseReleaseEvent(event);
}

void TitleBar::mouseDoubleClickEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
        QWidget *child = childAt(event->position().toPoint());
        if (child == nullptr || child == this || child == m_titleLabel || child == m_logoIconLabel) {
            emit maximizeToggled();
            event->accept();
            return;
        }
    }
    QWidget::mouseDoubleClickEvent(event);
}

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/DiagnosticsEngine.h ---
#ifndef DIAGNOSTICSENGINE_H
#define DIAGNOSTICSENGINE_H

#include <QObject>
#include <QString>
#include <QStringList>
#include <QList>
#include <QDateTime>
#include <QThread>

enum class CheckStatus {
    Passed,
    Warning,
    Failed
};

enum class DiagnosticCategory {
    KernelModule,
    ServiceSocket,
    ContainerRootfs,
    DisplaySurface
};

struct DiagnosticCheckResult {
    QString id;
    DiagnosticCategory category;
    QString name;
    CheckStatus status = CheckStatus::Passed;
    QString details;
    QString errorCode;
    QString remediationHint;
    bool canAutoHeal = false;
    bool requiresElevation = false;
};

struct HealthReport {
    QDateTime timestamp;
    bool isHealthy = true;
    bool hasWarnings = false;
    bool hasCriticalFailures = false;
    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> checks;
    QString summary;

    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> failedChecks() const;
    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> warningChecks() const;
    QList<DiagnosticCheckResult> autoHealableChecks() const;
    QString formatReport() const;
};

class DiagnosticsWorker : public QObject
{
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    explicit DiagnosticsWorker(QObject *parent = nullptr) : QObject(parent) {}

public slots:
    void performChecks();

signals:
    void progressUpdated(int percent, const QString &checkName);
    void checkCompleted(const DiagnosticCheckResult &result);
    void diagnosticsFinished(const HealthReport &report);
};

class DiagnosticsEngine : public QObject
{
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    explicit DiagnosticsEngine(QObject *parent = nullptr);
    ~DiagnosticsEngine() override;

    // Asynchronous diagnostic execution (runs in background QThread)
    void runDiagnosticsAsync();
    bool isRunning() const { return m_isRunning; }

    // Synchronous diagnostic execution (blocking, for CLI or pre-flight)
    HealthReport runDiagnosticsSync();

    // Cache of the latest report
    HealthReport latestReport() const { return m_latestReport; }

signals:
    void progressUpdated(int percent, const QString &checkName);
    void checkCompleted(const DiagnosticCheckResult &result);
    void diagnosticsFinished(const HealthReport &report);

private slots:
    void handleDiagnosticsFinished(const HealthReport &report);

private:
    bool m_isRunning = false;
    HealthReport m_latestReport;
    QThread *m_workerThread = nullptr;
    DiagnosticsWorker *m_worker = nullptr;
};

#endif // DIAGNOSTICSENGINE_H

#include "Theme.h"

#include <QPainter>
#include <QPainterPath>
#include <QPen>
#include <QFontDatabase>

namespace Theme {

QPixmap renderIconPixmap(IconType type, const QColor &color, int size)
{
    // Render at 2x scale for crisp HiDPI
    const int scale = 2;
    QPixmap pixmap(size * scale, size * scale);
    pixmap.fill(Qt::transparent);

    QPainter p(&pixmap);
    p.setRenderHint(QPainter::Antialiasing, true);
    p.setRenderHint(QPainter::SmoothPixmapTransform, true);
    p.scale(scale, scale);

    QPen pen(color);
    pen.setCapStyle(Qt::RoundCap);
    pen.setJoinStyle(Qt::RoundJoin);
    pen.setWidthF(1.75);
    p.setPen(pen);

    const qreal w = size;
    const qreal h = size;

    switch (type) {
    case IconType::WindowMinimize: {
        pen.setWidthF(2.0);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.25, h * 0.55), QPointF(w * 0.75, h * 0.55));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::WindowMaximize: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.8);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        QRectF rect(w * 0.26, h * 0.26, w * 0.48, h * 0.48);
        p.drawRoundedRect(rect, 1.5, 1.5);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::WindowRestore: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.6);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        // Back square
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(w * 0.35, h * 0.22, w * 0.42, h * 0.42), 1.5, 1.5);
        // Front square with dark fill
        p.setBrush(ColorBgPanel);
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(w * 0.22, h * 0.35, w * 0.42, h * 0.42), 1.5, 1.5);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::WindowClose: {
        pen.setWidthF(2.0);
        p.setPen(pen);
        qreal cPad = w * 0.30;
        p.drawLine(QPointF(cPad, cPad), QPointF(w - cPad, h - cPad));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w - cPad, cPad), QPointF(cPad, h - cPad));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::Search: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.8);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        qreal r = w * 0.22;
        QPointF center(w * 0.42, h * 0.42);
        p.drawEllipse(center, r, r);
        p.drawLine(QPointF(center.x() + r * 0.707, center.y() + r * 0.707),
                   QPointF(w * 0.78, h * 0.78));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::ClearText: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.6);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(ColorBgSurface);
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w * 0.5, h * 0.5), w * 0.35, h * 0.35);
        qreal c = w * 0.16;
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.5 - c, h * 0.5 - c), QPointF(w * 0.5 + c, h * 0.5 + c));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.5 + c, h * 0.5 - c), QPointF(w * 0.5 - c, h * 0.5 + c));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::Help: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.6);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w * 0.5, h * 0.5), w * 0.36, h * 0.36);
        QPainterPath path;
        path.moveTo(w * 0.40, h * 0.38);
        path.cubicTo(w * 0.40, h * 0.28, w * 0.60, h * 0.28, w * 0.60, h * 0.40);
        path.cubicTo(w * 0.60, h * 0.48, w * 0.50, h * 0.50, w * 0.50, h * 0.58);
        p.drawPath(path);
        p.setBrush(color);
        p.drawEllipse(QPointF(w * 0.5, h * 0.68), 1.2, 1.2);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::Fullscreen: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.8);
        p.setPen(pen);
        qreal s = w * 0.22;
        qreal l = w * 0.18;
        // Top-left
        p.drawLine(QPointF(s, s + l), QPointF(s, s));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(s, s), QPointF(s + l, s));
        // Top-right
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w - s - l, s), QPointF(w - s, s));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w - s, s), QPointF(w - s, s + l));
        // Bottom-left
        p.drawLine(QPointF(s, h - s - l), QPointF(s, h - s));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(s, h - s), QPointF(s + l, h - s));
        // Bottom-right
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w - s - l, h - s), QPointF(w - s, h - s));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w - s, h - s), QPointF(w - s, h - s - l));
        break;
    }
    case IconType::VolumeUp: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.7);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(color);
        QPainterPath cone;
        cone.moveTo(w * 0.22, h * 0.42);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.34, h * 0.42);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.50, h * 0.26);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.50, h * 0.74);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.34, h * 0.58);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.22, h * 0.58);
        cone.closeSubpath();
        p.drawPath(cone);

        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        QRectF arc1(w * 0.36, h * 0.32, w * 0.32, h * 0.36);
        p.drawArc(arc1, -55 * 16, 110 * 16);
        QRectF arc2(w * 0.28, h * 0.20, w * 0.54, h * 0.60);
        p.drawArc(arc2, -55 * 16, 110 * 16);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::VolumeDown: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.7);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(color);
        QPainterPath cone;
        cone.moveTo(w * 0.22, h * 0.42);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.34, h * 0.42);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.50, h * 0.26);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.50, h * 0.74);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.34, h * 0.58);
        cone.lineTo(w * 0.22, h * 0.58);
        cone.closeSubpath();
        p.drawPath(cone);

        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        QRectF arc1(w * 0.36, h * 0.32, w * 0.32, h * 0.36);
        p.drawArc(arc1, -55 * 16, 110 * 16);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::Keymapper: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.7);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        p.drawRoundedRect(QRectF(w * 0.18, h * 0.25, w * 0.64, h * 0.50), 3.0, 3.0);
        // Key grid
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.30, h * 0.38), QPointF(w * 0.36, h * 0.38));
        p.drawLine(QPointF(w * 0.44, h * 0.38), QPointF(w * 0.50, h * 0.38));
