    }
    case IconType::Settings: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.8);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(Qt::NoBrush);
        // 8-tooth gear
        QPainterPath gear;
        const int teeth = 8;
        const qreal rInner = w * 0.24;
        const qreal rOuter = w * 0.36;
        const QPointF c(w * 0.5, h * 0.5);

        for (int i = 0; i < teeth; ++i) {
            qreal a1 = (i * 360.0 / teeth) * M_PI / 180.0;
            qreal a2 = ((i * 360.0 / teeth) + 14.0) * M_PI / 180.0;
            qreal a3 = ((i * 360.0 / teeth) + 24.0) * M_PI / 180.0;
            qreal a4 = (((i + 1) * 360.0 / teeth)) * M_PI / 180.0;

            QPointF p1(c.x() + rInner * std::cos(a1), c.y() + rInner * std::sin(a1));
            QPointF p2(c.x() + rOuter * std::cos(a2), c.y() + rOuter * std::sin(a2));
            QPointF p3(c.x() + rOuter * std::cos(a3), c.y() + rOuter * std::sin(a3));
            QPointF p4(c.x() + rInner * std::cos(a4), c.y() + rInner * std::sin(a4));

            if (i == 0) gear.moveTo(p1);
            else gear.lineTo(p1);
            gear.lineTo(p2);
            gear.lineTo(p3);
            gear.lineTo(p4);
        }
        gear.closeSubpath();
        p.drawPath(gear);
        p.drawEllipse(c, w * 0.12, w * 0.12);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::AndroidBack: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.8);
        p.setPen(pen);
        p.setBrush(color);
        QPainterPath triangle;
        triangle.moveTo(w * 0.34, h * 0.50);
        triangle.lineTo(w * 0.64, h * 0.28);
        triangle.lineTo(w * 0.64, h * 0.72);
        triangle.closeSubpath();
        p.drawPath(triangle);
        break;
    }
    case IconType::AndroidHome: {
        pen.setWidthF(1.8);

        house.moveTo(w * 0.50, h * 0.26);

    return pixmap;

QIcon createIcon(IconType type, const QColor &color, int size)
{
    return QIcon(renderIconPixmap(type, color, size));
}

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/main.cpp ---
#include <QApplication>
#include <QStyleFactory>
#include <QPalette>
#include <QSurfaceFormat>
#include <QLocalServer>
#include <QLocalSocket>
#include <QTimer>
#include "MainWindow.h"
#include "SettingsDialog.h"
#include "InitializationDialog.h"
#include "AndroidCanvas.h"
#include "KeymapperOverlay.h"
#include "Theme.h"

#include "SelfHealingManager.h"
#include "Logger.h"
#include "PathResolver.h"
#include <QProcess>

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
    // Install centralized thread-safe logger and Qt message handler
    Logger::installQtMessageHandler();
    LOG_INFO("Core", "=== LinStack 1.0 (Cyber Emerald Edition) initializing ===");

    // Configure hardware integration for embedded Wayland compositor & Mesa DRI3 DMA-BUF buffer sharing
    qputenv("QSG_RHI_BACKEND", "opengl");
    qputenv("QT_WAYLAND_HARDWARE_INTEGRATION", "wayland-egl");
    qputenv("QT_WAYLAND_SERVER_BUFFER_INTEGRATION", "dmabuf-server");
    qputenv("QT_WAYLAND_CLIENT_BUFFER_INTEGRATION", "wayland-egl");

    // Qt 6 High-DPI and GLES2 configuration
    QGuiApplication::setHighDpiScaleFactorRoundingPolicy(Qt::HighDpiScaleFactorRoundingPolicy::PassThrough);

    QSurfaceFormat glFormat;
    glFormat.setRenderableType(QSurfaceFormat::OpenGLES);
    glFormat.setVersion(2, 0);
    glFormat.setSwapInterval(1);
    QSurfaceFormat::setDefaultFormat(glFormat);

    QApplication app(argc, argv);
    app.setApplicationName("LinStack");
    app.setApplicationDisplayName("LinStack 1.0");
    app.setApplicationVersion("1.0.0");
    app.setOrganizationName("LinStack Project");

    bool isScreenshotMode = false;
    QString launchPackage;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        QString arg = argv[i];
        if (arg.startsWith("--screenshot")) {
            isScreenshotMode = true;
        } else if (arg == "--launch" && i + 1 < argc) {
            launchPackage = argv[i + 1];
        }
    }

    if (!isScreenshotMode) {
        QString serverName = "LinStack_IPC_" + QString::fromLocal8Bit(qgetenv("USER"));
        if (serverName == "LinStack_IPC_") {
            serverName = "LinStack_IPC_default";
        }

        QLocalSocket clientSocket;
        clientSocket.connectToServer(serverName);
        if (clientSocket.waitForConnected(400)) {
            LOG_INFO("Core", "LinStack is already running. Forwarding launch command via IPC...");
            QString msg = launchPackage.isEmpty() ? "ACTIVATE" : ("LAUNCH:" + launchPackage);
            clientSocket.write(msg.toUtf8() + "\n");
            clientSocket.waitForBytesWritten(1000);
            clientSocket.disconnectFromServer();
            return 0;
        }

        QLocalServer::removeServer(serverName);
    }

    // Fast non-session pre-flight diagnostic check (kernel binder / modules)
    // Note: session is NOT started here; MainWindow initializes the embedded compositor first
    // الفحص التشخيصي يعمل في الخلفية من MainWindow لفتح الواجهة فوراً دون تأخير

    // Apply dark cyber palette
    QPalette cyberPalette;
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::Window, Theme::ColorBgDark);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::WindowText, Theme::ColorTextPrimary);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::Base, Theme::ColorBgDarkAlt);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::AlternateBase, Theme::ColorBgSurface);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::ToolTipBase, Theme::ColorBgPanel);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::ToolTipText, Theme::ColorTextPrimary);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::Text, Theme::ColorTextPrimary);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::Button, Theme::ColorBgSurface);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::ButtonText, Theme::ColorTextPrimary);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::Highlight, Theme::ColorEmerald);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::HighlightedText, Theme::ColorBgDark);
    cyberPalette.setColor(QPalette::PlaceholderText, Theme::ColorTextDim);
    app.setPalette(cyberPalette);

    // Apply global stylesheet
    app.setStyleSheet(Theme::cyberEmeraldStyleSheet());

    // Support CLI screenshot flags for headless validation and standalone dialog preview
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-init" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            InitializationDialog dlg;
            dlg.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = dlg.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-settings" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            SettingsDialog dlg;
            dlg.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = dlg.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    MainWindow window;

    if (!isScreenshotMode) {
        QString serverName = "LinStack_IPC_" + QString::fromLocal8Bit(qgetenv("USER"));
        if (serverName == "LinStack_IPC_") {
            serverName = "LinStack_IPC_default";
        }
        auto *ipcServer = new QLocalServer(&app);
        if (ipcServer->listen(serverName)) {
            QObject::connect(ipcServer, &QLocalServer::newConnection, [ipcServer, &window]() {
                while (QLocalSocket *client = ipcServer->nextPendingConnection()) {
                    QObject::connect(client, &QLocalSocket::readyRead, [client, &window]() {
                        QByteArray data = client->readAll();
                        QString msg = QString::fromUtf8(data).trimmed();
                        if (msg.startsWith("LAUNCH:")) {
                            QString pkg = msg.mid(7).trimmed();
                            LOG_INFO("Core", "IPC launch requested for package: " + pkg);
                            window.bringToFront();
                            window.launchApp(pkg);
                        } else if (msg == "ACTIVATE") {
                            window.bringToFront();
                        }
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    }

    window.show();

    if (!launchPackage.isEmpty()) {
        QTimer::singleShot(400, [&window, launchPackage]() {
            window.launchApp(launchPackage);
        });
    }

    // Support CLI screenshot flags for headless validation and UI preview
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            app.processEvents();
            window.resize(1280, 768);
            window.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = window.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-keymapper" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            window.resize(1280, 768);
            window.show();
            // trigger keymapper overlay
            QMetaObject::invokeMethod(&window, "handleKeymapperToggle", Q_ARG(bool, true));
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = window.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-keymapper-edit" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            window.resize(1280, 768);
            window.show();
            // trigger keymapper overlay in Edit Mode
            QMetaObject::invokeMethod(&window, "handleKeymapperToggle", Q_ARG(bool, true));
            auto *canvas = window.findChild<AndroidCanvas*>();
            if (canvas && canvas->keymapperOverlay()) {
                canvas->keymapperOverlay()->setMode(KeymapperOverlay::Mode::Edit);
            }
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = window.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-init" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            InitializationDialog dlg;
            dlg.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = dlg.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-settings" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            SettingsDialog dlg;
            dlg.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = dlg.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
        if (QString(argv[i]) == "--screenshot-diagnostics" && i + 1 < argc) {
            QString path = argv[i + 1];
            RecoveryDialog dlg;
            HealthReport report;
            report.isHealthy = false;
            report.hasCriticalFailures = true;
            report.summary = "Subsystem fault detected: Binder IPC interface missing / unreachable.";

            DiagnosticCheckResult binderCheck;
            binderCheck.id = "kernel_binder";
            binderCheck.category = DiagnosticCategory::KernelModule;
            binderCheck.name = "Kernel Binder Interface";
            binderCheck.status = CheckStatus::Failed;
            binderCheck.errorCode = "E_BINDER_MISSING";
            binderCheck.details = "Neither /dev/binder nor /dev/binderfs/binder were found with valid rw permissions.";
            binderCheck.remediationHint = "Run 'modprobe binder_linux' or allow linStack elevated repair to mount binderfs.";
            report.checks.append(binderCheck);

            DiagnosticCheckResult serviceCheck;
            serviceCheck.id = "systemd_service";
            serviceCheck.category = DiagnosticCategory::ServiceSocket;
            serviceCheck.name = "LinStack Systemd Container Service";
            serviceCheck.status = CheckStatus::Warning;
            serviceCheck.errorCode = "W_SERVICE_INACTIVE";
            serviceCheck.details = "linstack-container.service unit is currently inactive.";
            serviceCheck.remediationHint = "Attempt automated service restart via systemctl.";
            report.checks.append(serviceCheck);

            dlg.setReport(report);
            dlg.show();
            app.processEvents();
            QPixmap pix = dlg.grab();
            pix.save(path);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    return app.exec();
}

SelfHealingManager::SelfHealingManager(QObject *parent)
    : QObject(parent)
{
    connect(&m_engine, &DiagnosticsEngine::progressUpdated, this, &SelfHealingManager::diagnosticsProgress);
    connect(&m_engine, &DiagnosticsEngine::diagnosticsFinished, this, &SelfHealingManager::handleDiagnosticsFinished);
}

SelfHealingManager::~SelfHealingManager() = default;

void SelfHealingManager::startDiagnosticsAsync(bool autoHeal, QWidget *parentUi)
{
    m_autoHeal = autoHeal;
    m_parentUi = parentUi;
    LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "Initiating asynchronous diagnostic pipeline...");
    m_engine.runDiagnosticsAsync();
}

void SelfHealingManager::handleDiagnosticsFinished(const HealthReport &report)
{
    emit diagnosticsFinished(report);

    const auto warns = report.warningChecks();
    const auto fails = report.failedChecks();

    bool hasBlockingIssue = !fails.isEmpty();
    if (!hasBlockingIssue) {
        for (const auto &c : warns) {
            if (c.requiresElevation || c.id == "KERNEL_BINDER" || c.id == "RAW_MOUSE_INPUT") {
                hasBlockingIssue = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    if (!hasBlockingIssue) {
        LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "Diagnostics verified all critical subsystems healthy.");
        if (m_recoveryDialog && m_recoveryDialog->isVisible()) {
            m_recoveryDialog->setStatus("All critical subsystems healthy! Ready.", false);
            m_recoveryDialog->accept();
        }
        return;
    }


    LOG_WARN("SelfHealing", QString("Diagnostics reported issues/warnings: %1").arg(report.summary));

    // Step 1: Attempt non-elevated programmatic fixes first
    bool progFixed = executeProgrammaticFixes(report);

    // Step 2: Check if any failed or warning checks require root elevation (e.g., binderfs)
    bool hasElevatedIssues = false;
    for (const auto &c : fails) {
        if (c.requiresElevation) {
            hasElevatedIssues = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (!hasElevatedIssues) {
        for (const auto &c : warns) {
            if (c.requiresElevation || c.id == "KERNEL_BINDER") {
                hasElevatedIssues = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    if (hasElevatedIssues || (!progFixed && report.hasCriticalFailures)) {
        LOG_FAULT("SelfHealing", "FAULT_REQUIRES_ATTENTION",
                  "Unresolved faults or critical warnings remain. Presenting recovery options.",
                  "Launch elevated auto-heal or check logs.");
        showRecoveryDialog(report, m_parentUi);
    }
}

bool SelfHealingManager::executeProgrammaticFixes(const HealthReport &report)
{
    bool anyAttempted = false;
    bool allSuccess = true;

    for (const auto &c : report.checks) {
        if (c.status == CheckStatus::Passed || c.requiresElevation) {
            continue;
        }

        anyAttempted = true;
        emit healingStarted(QString("Resolving: %1").arg(c.name));

        if (c.id == "ADB_SOCKET") {
            LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "Auto-remediating ADB socket: starting adb server and connecting to 127.0.0.1:5555");
            QProcess p;
            p.start("adb", QStringList() << "start-server");
            p.waitForFinished(3000);

            QProcess pConnect;
            pConnect.start("adb", QStringList() << "connect" << "127.0.0.1:5555");
            pConnect.waitForFinished(3000);
            Logger::instance().logSubprocess("adb connect 127.0.0.1:5555", pConnect.exitCode(),
                                             pConnect.readAllStandardOutput(), pConnect.readAllStandardError());
        } else if (c.id == "ROOTFS_OVERLAY") {
            LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "Ensuring user storage directory exists with correct permissions...");
            QString dir = QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::AppLocalDataLocation);
            if (dir.isEmpty()) {
                dir = QDir::homePath() + "/.local/share/linStack";
            }
            QDir().mkpath(dir);
        }
    }

    if (anyAttempted) {
        emit healingFinished(allSuccess, "Programmatic fixes applied.");
    }
    return allSuccess;
}

bool SelfHealingManager::executeElevatedFixes(const HealthReport &report)
{
    emit repairStarted();
    emit healingStarted("Executing elevated kernel & service repair via pkexec...");

    QStringList commands;
    QString resDir = PathResolver::resolveResourcesDir();
    QString coreDir = PathResolver::resolveCoreDir();

    // 1. Ensure core backend is installed if missing
    if (!QFileInfo::exists("/usr/bin/linstack") && !coreDir.isEmpty()) {
        commands << QString("make -C \"%1\" install 2>/dev/null || true").arg(coreDir);
    }

    // 2. Ensure container config exists and images_path points to resolved resources
    if (!QFileInfo::exists("/var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg")) {
        commands << QString("linstack init -f -i \"%1\" 2>/dev/null || true").arg(resDir);
    } else if (!resDir.isEmpty()) {
        commands << QString("sed -i 's|images_path = .*|images_path = %1|' /var/lib/linstack/linstack.cfg 2>/dev/null || true").arg(resDir);
    }

    // 3. Kernel binder IPC module & filesystem check
    bool needBinder = false;
    for (const auto &c : report.checks) {
        if (c.id == "KERNEL_BINDER" && c.status != CheckStatus::Passed) {
            needBinder = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    if (needBinder || !isBinderAccessible()) {
        // Check if binderfs is already mounted (kernel built-in binder, e.g. Fedora 6.x)
        bool binderfsAlreadyMounted = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binderfs/binder");
        bool binderDevExists = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binder");

        if (!binderfsAlreadyMounted && !binderDevExists) {
            // Module not loaded at all — attempt modprobe then mount binderfs
            commands << "modprobe binder_linux devices=binder,hwbinder,vndbinder 2>/dev/null || true";
            commands << "mkdir -p /dev/binderfs";
            commands << "mount -t binder binder /dev/binderfs 2>/dev/null || true";
        }
        // Always try to fix permissions on whichever nodes exist
        commands << "chmod 0666 /dev/binder /dev/binderfs/binder /dev/vndbinder /dev/hwbinder 2>/dev/null || true";
    }

    // 4. Raw mouse input permissions for smooth 1:1 Aim Lock on Wayland
    commands << "echo 'KERNEL==\"mice\", SUBSYSTEM==\"input\", MODE=\"0666\"' > /etc/udev/rules.d/99-linstack-raw-mouse.rules 2>/dev/null || true";
    commands << "chmod 0666 /dev/input/mice 2>/dev/null || true";

    // 5. Ensure container daemon service is enabled and restarted
    commands << "systemctl enable --now linstack-container.service 2>/dev/null || true";
    commands << "systemctl restart linstack-container.service 2>/dev/null || true";

    QString bashCmd = commands.join(" && ");
    LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", QString("Spawning pkexec command: %1").arg(bashCmd));

    QProcess proc;
    proc.start("pkexec", QStringList() << "bash" << "-c" << bashCmd);

    if (!proc.waitForFinished(20000)) {
        LOG_CRITICAL("SelfHealing", "pkexec repair timed out after 20 seconds.");
        emit repairFinished(false);
        emit healingFinished(false, "Elevated repair timed out.");
        return false;
    }

    int exitCode = proc.exitCode();
    QString stdOut = proc.readAllStandardOutput();
    QString stdErr = proc.readAllStandardError();
    Logger::instance().logSubprocess(QString("pkexec bash -c '%1'").arg(bashCmd), exitCode, stdOut, stdErr);

    bool success = (exitCode == 0);
    emit repairFinished(success);
    emit healingFinished(success, success ? "Elevated repair completed successfully." : "pkexec repair failed.");

    if (success) {
        ensureSessionRunning();
    }
    return success;
}

void SelfHealingManager::showRecoveryDialog(const HealthReport &report, QWidget *parent)
{
    if (!m_recoveryDialog) {
        m_recoveryDialog = new RecoveryDialog(parent);

        connect(m_recoveryDialog, &RecoveryDialog::autoHealRequested, this, [this]() {
            m_recoveryDialog->setStatus("Running automated elevated healing...", true);
            QThread::msleep(200);

            // Execute elevated repair in background or process
            bool ok = executeElevatedFixes(m_engine.latestReport());
            if (ok) {
                m_recoveryDialog->setStatus("Repair finished! Re-running diagnostics...", true);
                m_engine.runDiagnosticsAsync();
            } else {
                m_recoveryDialog->setStatus("Repair encountered an error. Check logs below.", false);
            }
        });

        connect(m_recoveryDialog, &RecoveryDialog::recheckRequested, this, [this]() {
            m_recoveryDialog->setStatus("Re-scanning system health...", true);
            m_engine.runDiagnosticsAsync();
        });

        connect(m_recoveryDialog, &RecoveryDialog::ignoreAndContinue, this, [this]() {
            LOG_WARN("SelfHealing", "User elected to ignore diagnostic warnings and continue execution.");
            m_recoveryDialog->accept();
            ensureSessionRunning();
        });
    }

    m_recoveryDialog->setReport(report);
    m_recoveryDialog->show();
    m_recoveryDialog->raise();
    m_recoveryDialog->activateWindow();
}

// ── Backward-compatible helper methods ────────────────────────────────────────

bool SelfHealingManager::isBinderAccessible()
{
    bool devBinder = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binder") && QFileInfo("/dev/binder").isReadable();
    bool binderfs = QFileInfo::exists("/dev/binderfs/binder") && QFileInfo("/dev/binderfs/binder").isReadable();
    return devBinder || binderfs;
}

bool SelfHealingManager::isSessionActive()
{
    QProcess proc;
    PathResolver::configureProcess(&proc, QStringList() << "status");
    proc.start();
    if (!proc.waitForFinished(1500)) {
        proc.kill();
        proc.waitForFinished(300);
        return false;
    }
    QString output = proc.readAllStandardOutput() + proc.readAllStandardError();
    return output.contains("RUNNING", Qt::CaseInsensitive) && !output.contains("STOPPED", Qt::CaseInsensitive);
}

bool SelfHealingManager::ensureSessionRunning()
{
    QString runtimeDir = QStandardPaths::writableLocation(QStandardPaths::RuntimeLocation);
    if (runtimeDir.isEmpty()) runtimeDir = "/tmp";
    QString socketPath = runtimeDir + "/wayland-linstack-0";

    // Enforce environment variables
    qputenv("WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
    qputenv("LINSTACK_WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
    qputenv("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", runtimeDir.toUtf8());

    if (isSessionActive()) {
        LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "LinStack session is already active. Launching show-full-ui on wayland-linstack-0...");

        QProcess *uiProc = new QProcess(this);
        connect(uiProc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardOutput, this, [uiProc]() {
            const QString out = QString::fromUtf8(uiProc->readAllStandardOutput()).trimmed();
            if (!out.isEmpty()) LOG_INFO("UI[STDOUT]", out);
        });
        connect(uiProc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardError, this, [uiProc]() {
            const QString err = QString::fromUtf8(uiProc->readAllStandardError()).trimmed();
            if (!err.isEmpty()) LOG_WARN("UI[STDERR]", err);
        });
        connect(uiProc, QOverload<int, QProcess::ExitStatus>::of(&QProcess::finished), this, [uiProc](int code, QProcess::ExitStatus) {
            LOG_INFO("UI", QString("linstack show-full-ui process exited with code %1").arg(code));
            uiProc->deleteLater();
        });

        QProcessEnvironment uiEnv = QProcessEnvironment::systemEnvironment();
        uiEnv.insert("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", runtimeDir);
        uiEnv.insert("WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
        uiEnv.insert("LINSTACK_WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
        uiProc->setProcessEnvironment(uiEnv);
        PathResolver::configureProcess(uiProc, QStringList() << "show-full-ui");
        uiProc->start();
        return true;
    }

    // Verify embedded compositor socket exists before starting session
    int socketWaitRetries = 0;
    while (!QFile::exists(socketPath) && socketWaitRetries < 20) {
        QThread::msleep(100);
        socketWaitRetries++;
    }

    if (!QFile::exists(socketPath)) {
        LOG_WARN("SelfHealing", QString("Embedded Wayland socket %1 not found yet. Deferring session start.").arg(socketPath));
        return false;
    }
    LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", QString("Verified active embedded Wayland socket: %1. Starting session.").arg(socketPath));

    LOG_INFO("SelfHealing", "Starting LinStack session with WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-linstack-0...");
    QProcess *proc = new QProcess(this);
    connect(proc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardOutput, this, [proc]() {
        const QString out = QString::fromUtf8(proc->readAllStandardOutput()).trimmed();
        if (!out.isEmpty()) LOG_INFO("Session[STDOUT]", out);
    });
    connect(proc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardError, this, [proc]() {
        const QString err = QString::fromUtf8(proc->readAllStandardError()).trimmed();
        if (!err.isEmpty()) LOG_WARN("Session[STDERR]", err);
    });
    connect(proc, QOverload<int, QProcess::ExitStatus>::of(&QProcess::finished), this, [proc](int code, QProcess::ExitStatus) {
        LOG_INFO("Session", QString("linstack session start process exited with code %1").arg(code));
        proc->deleteLater();
    });

    QProcessEnvironment env = QProcessEnvironment::systemEnvironment();
    env.insert("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", runtimeDir);
    env.insert("WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
    env.insert("LINSTACK_WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
    proc->setProcessEnvironment(env);
    PathResolver::configureProcess(proc, QStringList() << "session" << "start");
    proc->start();

    // Trigger show-full-ui after session starts
    QTimer::singleShot(2500, this, [this, runtimeDir]() {
        QProcess *uiProc = new QProcess(this);
        connect(uiProc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardOutput, this, [uiProc]() {
            const QString out = QString::fromUtf8(uiProc->readAllStandardOutput()).trimmed();
            if (!out.isEmpty()) LOG_INFO("UI[STDOUT]", out);
        });
        connect(uiProc, &QProcess::readyReadStandardError, this, [uiProc]() {
            const QString err = QString::fromUtf8(uiProc->readAllStandardError()).trimmed();
            if (!err.isEmpty()) LOG_WARN("UI[STDERR]", err);
        });
        connect(uiProc, QOverload<int, QProcess::ExitStatus>::of(&QProcess::finished), this, [uiProc](int code, QProcess::ExitStatus) {
            LOG_INFO("UI", QString("linstack show-full-ui process exited with code %1").arg(code));
            uiProc->deleteLater();
        });

        QProcessEnvironment uiEnv = QProcessEnvironment::systemEnvironment();
        uiEnv.insert("XDG_RUNTIME_DIR", runtimeDir);
        uiEnv.insert("WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
        uiEnv.insert("LINSTACK_WAYLAND_DISPLAY", "wayland-linstack-0");
        uiProc->setProcessEnvironment(uiEnv);
        PathResolver::configureProcess(uiProc, QStringList() << "show-full-ui");
        uiProc->start();
    });

    return true;
}

bool SelfHealingManager::checkHealth()
{
    // Fast synchronous check
    HealthReport rep = m_engine.runDiagnosticsSync();
    if (!rep.isHealthy) {
        LOG_WARN("SelfHealing", QString("checkHealth() detected issues: %1").arg(rep.summary));
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool SelfHealingManager::promptRepair()
{
    HealthReport rep = m_engine.latestReport();
    if (rep.checks.isEmpty()) {
        rep = m_engine.runDiagnosticsSync();
    }

    RecoveryDialog dlg(nullptr);
    dlg.setReport(rep);

    connect(&dlg, &RecoveryDialog::autoHealRequested, this, [this, &dlg, &rep]() {
        dlg.setStatus("Executing auto-repair...", true);
        bool ok = executeElevatedFixes(rep);
        if (ok) {
            dlg.accept();
        } else {
            dlg.setStatus("Auto-repair failed. Review logs or continue anyway.", false);
        }
    });

    connect(&dlg, &RecoveryDialog::ignoreAndContinue, &dlg, &QDialog::accept);

    return (dlg.exec() == QDialog::Accepted);
}

bool SelfHealingManager::executeRepair()
{
    HealthReport rep = m_engine.latestReport();
    return executeElevatedFixes(rep);
}

RecoveryDialog::RecoveryDialog(QWidget *parent)
    : QDialog(parent)
{
    setWindowTitle("linStack Runtime Diagnostics & Self-Healing");
    setFixedSize(740, 560);
    setWindowFlags(Qt::Dialog | Qt::FramelessWindowHint);
    setAttribute(Qt::WA_TranslucentBackground, true);
    setStyleSheet(Theme::cyberEmeraldStyleSheet());

    setupUi();
}

void RecoveryDialog::setupUi()
{
    auto *rootLayout = new QVBoxLayout(this);
    rootLayout->setContentsMargins(16, 16, 16, 16);
    rootLayout->setSpacing(0);

    // Main styled container widget hosting cyber-emerald styling
    m_mainContainer = new QWidget(this);
    m_mainContainer->setObjectName("recoveryContainer");
    m_mainContainer->setAttribute(Qt::WA_StyledBackground, true);
    m_mainContainer->setStyleSheet(
        "#recoveryContainer {"
        "  background-color: #0B0F19;"
        "  border: 1px solid #10B981;"
        "  border-radius: 10px;"
        "}"
    );

    // Smooth drop shadow around the frameless dialog container
    auto *shadow = new QGraphicsDropShadowEffect(m_mainContainer);
    shadow->setBlurRadius(28);
    shadow->setColor(QColor(0, 0, 0, 200));
    shadow->setOffset(0, 6);
    m_mainContainer->setGraphicsEffect(shadow);

    rootLayout->addWidget(m_mainContainer);

    auto *containerLayout = new QVBoxLayout(m_mainContainer);
    containerLayout->setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0);
    containerLayout->setSpacing(0);

    // ── 1. Custom Draggable Title Bar ─────────────────────────────────────────
    m_titleBarWidget = new QWidget(m_mainContainer);
    m_titleBarWidget->setObjectName("recoveryTitleBar");
    m_titleBarWidget->setAttribute(Qt::WA_StyledBackground, true);
    m_titleBarWidget->setFixedHeight(44);
    m_titleBarWidget->setStyleSheet(
        "#recoveryTitleBar {"
        "  background-color: #111827;"
        "  border-top-left-radius: 9px;"
        "  border-top-right-radius: 9px;"
        "  border-bottom: 1px solid #1F2937;"
        "}"
    );
    m_titleBarWidget->installEventFilter(this);

    auto *titleLayout = new QHBoxLayout(m_titleBarWidget);
    titleLayout->setContentsMargins(14, 0, 8, 0);
    titleLayout->setSpacing(10);

bool RecoveryDialog::eventFilter(QObject *watched, QEvent *event)
{
    if (watched == m_titleBarWidget || watched == m_titleLabel || watched == m_errorCodeBadge) {
        if (event->type() == QEvent::MouseButtonPress) {
            auto *me = static_cast<QMouseEvent *>(event);
            if (me->button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
                if (windowHandle() && windowHandle()->startSystemMove()) {
                    return true;
                }
                m_isDragging = true;
                m_dragStartPos = me->globalPosition().toPoint() - frameGeometry().topLeft();
                return true;
            }
        } else if (event->type() == QEvent::MouseMove) {
            auto *me = static_cast<QMouseEvent *>(event);
            if (m_isDragging && (me->buttons() & Qt::LeftButton)) {
                move(me->globalPosition().toPoint() - m_dragStartPos);
                return true;
            }
        } else if (event->type() == QEvent::MouseButtonRelease) {
            auto *me = static_cast<QMouseEvent *>(event);
            if (me->button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
                m_isDragging = false;
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return QDialog::eventFilter(watched, event);
}

void RecoveryDialog::mousePressEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton && m_titleBarWidget) {
        QPoint ptInTitle = m_titleBarWidget->mapFrom(this, event->position().toPoint());
        if (m_titleBarWidget->rect().contains(ptInTitle)) {
            QWidget *child = m_titleBarWidget->childAt(ptInTitle);
            if (child != m_minBtn && child != m_closeBtn) {
                if (windowHandle() && windowHandle()->startSystemMove()) {
                    event->accept();
                    return;
                }
                m_isDragging = true;
                m_dragStartPos = event->globalPosition().toPoint() - frameGeometry().topLeft();
                event->accept();
                return;
            }
        }
    }
    QDialog::mousePressEvent(event);
}

void RecoveryDialog::mouseMoveEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (m_isDragging && (event->buttons() & Qt::LeftButton)) {
        move(event->globalPosition().toPoint() - m_dragStartPos);
        event->accept();
        return;
    }
    QDialog::mouseMoveEvent(event);
}

void RecoveryDialog::mouseReleaseEvent(QMouseEvent *event)
{
    if (event->button() == Qt::LeftButton) {
        m_isDragging = false;
    }
    QDialog::mouseReleaseEvent(event);
}

void RecoveryDialog::paintEvent(QPaintEvent *event)
{
    Q_UNUSED(event);
    // Background is translucent to permit QGraphicsDropShadowEffect rendering around m_mainContainer
}

void RecoveryDialog::setReport(const HealthReport &report)
{
    m_report = report;

    auto fails = report.failedChecks();
    auto warns = report.warningChecks();

    if (!fails.isEmpty()) {
        m_errorCodeBadge->setText(QString("[%1]").arg(fails.first().errorCode));
        m_errorCodeBadge->setStyleSheet(
            "background-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: #EF4444; border: 1px solid #EF4444; "
            "border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 7px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; font-family: monospace;"
        );
    } else if (!warns.isEmpty()) {
        m_errorCodeBadge->setText(QString("[%1]").arg(warns.first().errorCode));
        m_errorCodeBadge->setStyleSheet(
            "background-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: #F59E0B; border: 1px solid #F59E0B; "
            "border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 7px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; font-family: monospace;"
        );
    } else {
        m_errorCodeBadge->setText("[HEALTHY]");
        m_errorCodeBadge->setStyleSheet(
            "background-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #00FF66; border: 1px solid #10B981; "
            "border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 7px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; font-family: monospace;"
        );
    }

    QString desc = QString("<b>Status Summary:</b> %1<br><br>").arg(report.summary);
    if (!fails.isEmpty()) {
        desc += "<b>Critical Faults:</b><ul style='margin-top: 4px; margin-bottom: 4px;'>";
        for (const auto &f : fails) {
            desc += QString("<li><b>%1:</b> %2<br><span style='color:#34D399;'>Remediation: %3</span></li>")
            .arg(f.name, f.details, f.remediationHint);
        }
        desc += "</ul>";
    }
    if (!warns.isEmpty()) {
        desc += "<b>Warnings Requiring Attention:</b><ul style='margin-top: 4px; margin-bottom: 4px;'>";
        for (const auto &w : warns) {
            if (w.requiresElevation) {
                desc += QString("<li><b>%1:</b> %2<br><span style='color:#FBBF24;'>Auto-Fix: %3</span></li>")
                .arg(w.name, w.details, w.remediationHint);
            }
        }
        desc += "</ul>";
    }

    m_descriptionLabel->setText(desc);


    // Update log console with recent lines
    m_logConsole->setPlainText(Logger::instance().recentLogsText(50));
    m_logConsole->verticalScrollBar()->setValue(m_logConsole->verticalScrollBar()->maximum());
}

void RecoveryDialog::setStatus(const QString &status, bool inProgress)
{
    m_titleLabel->setText(status);
    if (inProgress) {
        m_progressBar->show();
        m_btnAutoHeal->setEnabled(false);
        m_btnRecheck->setEnabled(false);
    } else {
        m_progressBar->hide();
        m_btnAutoHeal->setEnabled(true);
        m_btnRecheck->setEnabled(true);
    }
}

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/InputTranslator.cpp ---
#include "InputTranslator.h"
#include "UInputTouchBridge.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>

InputTranslator::InputTranslator(UInputTouchBridge *bridge, QObject *parent)
: QObject(parent)
, m_bridge(bridge)
{
    m_dpadNode.type = KeyNodeType::Dpad;
    m_dpadNode.relX = 0.18;
    m_dpadNode.relY = 0.70;
    m_dpadNode.radius = 60.0;
    m_dpadNode.scanUp = 0;
    m_dpadNode.scanLeft = 0;
    m_dpadNode.scanDown = 0;
    m_dpadNode.scanRight = 0;

    m_swipeTimer = new QTimer(this);
    m_swipeTimer->setInterval(16);
    connect(m_swipeTimer, &QTimer::timeout, this, &InputTranslator::processSwipeStep);

    m_edgeScrollTimer = new QTimer(this);
    m_edgeScrollTimer->setInterval(30);
    connect(m_edgeScrollTimer, &QTimer::timeout, this, &InputTranslator::processEdgeScroll);
}

void InputTranslator::setScreenGeometry(int width, int height)
{
    m_screenWidth = qMax(320, width);
    m_screenHeight = qMax(240, height);
}

void InputTranslator::setNodes(const QList<KeyBindingNode> &nodes)
{
    m_nodes = nodes;
    // تصفير D-Pad و FreeLook أولاً حتى لا يعملا إذا قام المستخدم بحذفهما
    m_dpadNode = KeyBindingNode();
    m_dpadNode.scanUp = 0; m_dpadNode.scanDown = 0; m_dpadNode.scanLeft = 0; m_dpadNode.scanRight = 0;
    m_freeLookNode = KeyBindingNode();
    m_freeLookNode.primaryScanCode = 0;

    for (const auto &node : m_nodes) {
        if (node.type == KeyNodeType::Dpad) {
            m_dpadNode = node;
        } else if (node.type == KeyNodeType::FreeLook) {
            m_freeLookNode = node;
        }
    }
}

QPointF InputTranslator::activeAimAnchorNormalized() const
{
    if (m_aimLockActive && m_activeAimIndex >= 0 && m_activeAimIndex < m_nodes.size()) {
        return QPointF(m_nodes[m_activeAimIndex].relX, m_nodes[m_activeAimIndex].relY);
    }
    if (m_freeLookActive) {
        return QPointF(m_freeLookNode.relX, m_freeLookNode.relY);
    }
    return QPointF(0.5, 0.5);
}

void InputTranslator::setAimLockActive(bool active, int nodeIndex)
{
    if (active && (nodeIndex < 0 || nodeIndex >= m_nodes.size() || m_nodes[nodeIndex].type != KeyNodeType::AimShoot)) {
        return;
    }

    if (m_aimLockActive == active && (!active || m_activeAimIndex == nodeIndex)) {
        return;
    }

    if (m_aimLockActive && m_bridge) {
        m_bridge->touchUp(1);
        if (m_firing) {
            m_firing = false;
            m_bridge->touchUp(2);
            emit touchInjected(2, 0, 0, false);
        }
        emit touchInjected(1, 0, 0, false);
    }

    m_aimLockActive = active;
    m_activeAimIndex = active ? nodeIndex : -1;
    m_aimSwipeAccumX = 0;
    m_aimSwipeAccumY = 0;

    QPointF anchorNorm(0.5, 0.5);
    if (m_aimLockActive) {
        const auto &aim = m_nodes[m_activeAimIndex];
        anchorNorm = QPointF(aim.relX, aim.relY);
        int cx = static_cast<int>(aim.relX * m_screenWidth);
        int cy = static_cast<int>(aim.relY * m_screenHeight);
        if (m_bridge) {
            m_bridge->touchDown(1, cx, cy);
        }
        emit touchInjected(1, cx, cy, true);
    }

    emit aimLockToggled(m_aimLockActive, anchorNorm);
}

bool InputTranslator::handleScanCodePress(quint32 scanCode, int fallbackKey)
{
    if (scanCode == 0) return false;

    // 1. AimLock (Toggle)
    for (int i = 0; i < m_nodes.size(); ++i) {
        if (m_nodes[i].type == KeyNodeType::AimShoot && m_nodes[i].primaryScanCode == scanCode) {
            if (m_aimLockActive && m_activeAimIndex == i) {
                setAimLockActive(false, -1);
            } else {
                setAimLockActive(true, i);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    // 2. ESC unlocks AimLock or FreeLook
    if (scanCode == 9 || fallbackKey == Qt::Key_Escape) {
        if (m_aimLockActive) {
            setAimLockActive(false, -1);
            return true;
        }
        if (m_freeLookActive) {
            m_freeLookActive = false;
            if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(6);
            emit touchInjected(6, 0, 0, false);
            emit freeLookToggled(false, QPointF(0.5, 0.5));
            return true;
        }
    }

    m_heldScanCodes.insert(scanCode);

    // 3. D-Pad
    if (scanCode == m_dpadNode.scanUp || scanCode == m_dpadNode.scanDown ||
        scanCode == m_dpadNode.scanLeft || scanCode == m_dpadNode.scanRight) {
        updateDpad();
        return true;
    }

    // 4. Other custom nodes
    for (auto &node : m_nodes) {
        if (node.primaryScanCode == scanCode) {
            if (node.type == KeyNodeType::BurstTap) {
                startBurstTap(node);
                return true;
            }
            // FreeLook: works ONLY while held down (Hold-to-Look)
            if (node.type == KeyNodeType::FreeLook) {
                if (!m_freeLookActive) {
                    m_freeLookActive = true;
                    m_freeLookNode = node;
                    m_freeLookAccumX = 0;
                    m_freeLookAccumY = 0;
                    int cx = static_cast<int>(node.relX * m_screenWidth);
                    int cy = static_cast<int>(node.relY * m_screenHeight);
                    if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchDown(6, cx, cy);
                    emit touchInjected(6, cx, cy, true);
                    emit freeLookToggled(true, QPointF(node.relX, node.relY));
                }
                return true;
            }
                if (node.type == KeyNodeType::EdgeScroll) {
                    int dx = 0, dy = 0;
                    if (node.direction == "up")    dy = -1;
                    if (node.direction == "down")  dy =  1;
                    if (node.direction == "left")  dx = -1;
                    if (node.direction == "right") dx =  1;
                    startEdgeScroll(dx, dy, node);
                    return true;
                }
                if (node.type == KeyNodeType::Swipe) {
                    triggerSwipe(node);
                    return true;
                }
                if (node.type == KeyNodeType::SmartCast) {
                    m_smartCasting = true;
                    m_activeSmartCastNode = node;
                    m_smartCastAccumX = 0.0;
                    m_smartCastAccumY = 0.0;
                    int cx = static_cast<int>(node.relX * m_screenWidth);
                    int cy = static_cast<int>(node.relY * m_screenHeight);
                    if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchDown(4, cx, cy);
                    emit touchInjected(4, cx, cy, true);
                    emit smartCastAimUpdated(node.id, QPointF(cx, cy), QPointF(cx, cy));
                    return true;
                }
                if (node.type == KeyNodeType::Tap) {
                    int slot = -1;
                    for (int s = 5; s < 10; ++s) {
                        if (!m_scanToSlot.values().contains(s)) {
                            slot = s;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (slot != -1) {
                        m_scanToSlot.insert(scanCode, slot);
                        int px = static_cast<int>(node.relX * m_screenWidth);
                        int py = static_cast<int>(node.relY * m_screenHeight);
                        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchDown(slot, px, py);
                        emit touchInjected(slot, px, py, true);
                    }
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
}

bool InputTranslator::handleScanCodeRelease(quint32 scanCode, int fallbackKey)
{
    Q_UNUSED(fallbackKey);
    if (scanCode == 0) return false;
    m_heldScanCodes.remove(scanCode);

    // تحرير Free Look فور رفع اليد عن الزر
    if (m_freeLookActive && m_freeLookNode.primaryScanCode == scanCode) {
        m_freeLookActive = false;
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(6);
        emit touchInjected(6, 0, 0, false);
        emit freeLookToggled(false, QPointF(0.5, 0.5));
        return true;
    }

    if (scanCode == m_dpadNode.scanUp || scanCode == m_dpadNode.scanDown ||
        scanCode == m_dpadNode.scanLeft || scanCode == m_dpadNode.scanRight) {
        updateDpad();
        return true;
    }

    if (m_smartCasting && m_activeSmartCastNode.primaryScanCode == scanCode) {
        m_smartCasting = false;
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(4);
        emit touchInjected(4, 0, 0, false);
        return true;
    }

    if (m_burstTimers.contains(scanCode)) {
        stopBurstTap(scanCode);
        return true;
    }

    for (const auto &node : m_nodes) {
        if (node.type == KeyNodeType::EdgeScroll && node.primaryScanCode == scanCode) {
            stopEdgeScroll();
            return true;
        }
    }

    if (m_scanToSlot.contains(scanCode)) {
        int slot = m_scanToSlot.take(scanCode);
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(slot);
        emit touchInjected(slot, 0, 0, false);
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

void InputTranslator::updateDpad()
{
    bool w = m_heldScanCodes.contains(m_dpadNode.scanUp);
    bool s = m_heldScanCodes.contains(m_dpadNode.scanDown);
    bool a = m_heldScanCodes.contains(m_dpadNode.scanLeft);
    bool d = m_heldScanCodes.contains(m_dpadNode.scanRight);

    qreal dx = 0, dy = 0;
    if (w) dy -= 1.0;
    if (s) dy += 1.0;
    if (a) dx -= 1.0;
    if (d) dx += 1.0;

    if (dx == 0 && dy == 0) {
        if (m_dpadActive) {
            m_dpadActive = false;
            if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(0);
            emit touchInjected(0, 0, 0, false);
        }
        return;
    }

    qreal len = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    dx /= len;
    dy /= len;

    int cx = static_cast<int>(m_dpadNode.relX * m_screenWidth);
    int cy = static_cast<int>(m_dpadNode.relY * m_screenHeight);
    int targetX = cx + static_cast<int>(dx * m_dpadNode.radius);
    int targetY = cy + static_cast<int>(dy * m_dpadNode.radius);

    if (!m_dpadActive) {
        m_dpadActive = true;
        if (m_bridge) {
            m_bridge->touchDown(0, cx, cy);
            m_bridge->touchMove(0, targetX, targetY);
        }
    } else {
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchMove(0, targetX, targetY);
    }

    emit touchInjected(0, targetX, targetY, true);
}

void InputTranslator::triggerSwipe(const KeyBindingNode &node)
{
    m_activeSwipeNode = node;
    m_swipeStart = QPointF(node.relX * m_screenWidth, node.relY * m_screenHeight);
    m_swipeEnd = QPointF(node.endRelX * m_screenWidth, node.endRelY * m_screenHeight);
    m_swipeCurrentStep = 0;
    m_swipeTotalSteps = qMax(2, node.durationMs / 16);

    if (m_bridge) {
        m_bridge->touchDown(3, static_cast<int>(m_swipeStart.x()), static_cast<int>(m_swipeStart.y()));
    }
    emit touchInjected(3, static_cast<int>(m_swipeStart.x()), static_cast<int>(m_swipeStart.y()), true);
    m_swipeTimer->start();
}
void InputTranslator::processSwipeStep()
{
    m_swipeCurrentStep++;
    qreal progress = qBound(0.0, static_cast<qreal>(m_swipeCurrentStep) / m_swipeTotalSteps, 1.0);

    int currentX = 0;
    int currentY = 0;

    // إذا كان للزر مسار حر مرسوم يدوياً (Freehand Swipe)، نتتبع نقاط المسار بدقة
    if (m_activeSwipeNode.pathPoints.size() >= 2) {
        const auto &pts = m_activeSwipeNode.pathPoints;
        qreal scaledPos = progress * (pts.size() - 1);
        int idx0 = qBound(0, static_cast<int>(std::floor(scaledPos)), static_cast<int>(pts.size() - 1));
        int idx1 = qBound(0, idx0 + 1, static_cast<int>(pts.size() - 1));
        qreal localT = scaledPos - idx0;

        qreal rx = pts[idx0].x() + (pts[idx1].x() - pts[idx0].x()) * localT;
        qreal ry = pts[idx0].y() + (pts[idx1].y() - pts[idx0].y()) * localT;
        currentX = static_cast<int>(rx * m_screenWidth);
        currentY = static_cast<int>(ry * m_screenHeight);
    } else {
        currentX = static_cast<int>(m_swipeStart.x() + (m_swipeEnd.x() - m_swipeStart.x()) * progress);
        currentY = static_cast<int>(m_swipeStart.y() + (m_swipeEnd.y() - m_swipeStart.y()) * progress);
    }

    if (m_swipeCurrentStep >= m_swipeTotalSteps) {
        m_swipeTimer->stop();
        if (m_bridge) {
            m_bridge->touchMove(3, currentX, currentY);
            m_bridge->touchUp(3);
        }
        emit touchInjected(3, currentX, currentY, false);
    } else {
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchMove(3, currentX, currentY);
        emit touchInjected(3, currentX, currentY, true);
    }
}

bool InputTranslator::handleMouseMove(int deltaX, int deltaY, const QPoint &globalPos)
{
    m_lastMousePos = globalPos;

    // 1. Smart Cast: يحرك نقطة الإلقاء نحو مؤشر الماوس (أو بالإزاحة النسبية إذا كان المؤشر مقفلاً)
    if (m_smartCasting) {
        int cx = static_cast<int>(m_activeSmartCastNode.relX * m_screenWidth);
        int cy = static_cast<int>(m_activeSmartCastNode.relY * m_screenHeight);

        qreal mx = 0.0;
        qreal my = 0.0;

        if (m_aimLockActive && (deltaX != 0 || deltaY != 0)) {
            m_smartCastAccumX += deltaX * 1.5;
            m_smartCastAccumY += deltaY * 1.5;
            mx = m_smartCastAccumX;
            my = m_smartCastAccumY;
        } else {
            mx = globalPos.x() - cx;
            my = globalPos.y() - cy;
        }

        qreal dist = std::sqrt(mx * mx + my * my);
        qreal maxR = m_activeSmartCastNode.castRadius;

        if (dist > maxR && dist > 0.001) {
            mx = (mx / dist) * maxR;
            my = (my / dist) * maxR;
            m_smartCastAccumX = mx;
            m_smartCastAccumY = my;
        }

        int targetX = std::clamp(cx + static_cast<int>(mx), 0, m_screenWidth - 1);
        int targetY = std::clamp(cy + static_cast<int>(my), 0, m_screenHeight - 1);

        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchMove(4, targetX, targetY);
        emit smartCastAimUpdated(m_activeSmartCastNode.id, QPointF(cx, cy), QPointF(targetX, targetY));
        emit touchInjected(4, targetX, targetY, true);
        return true;
    }

    // 2. Free Look (يعمل أثناء الضغط المستمر على الزر فقط)
    if (m_freeLookActive) {
        int cx = static_cast<int>(m_freeLookNode.relX * m_screenWidth);
        int cy = static_cast<int>(m_freeLookNode.relY * m_screenHeight);

        qreal effDx = static_cast<qreal>(deltaX);
        qreal effDy = static_cast<qreal>(deltaY);
        if (m_freeLookNode.acceleration) {
            qreal speed = std::sqrt(effDx * effDx + effDy * effDy);
            qreal factor = 1.0 + qMin(speed * 0.02, 1.5);
            effDx *= factor;
            effDy *= factor;
        }

        m_freeLookAccumX += static_cast<int>(effDx * m_freeLookNode.sensitivityX);
        m_freeLookAccumY += static_cast<int>(effDy * m_freeLookNode.sensitivityY);

        const int maxSweep = static_cast<int>(m_freeLookNode.radius > 10 ? m_freeLookNode.radius * 4.0 : 160);
        int distSq = m_freeLookAccumX * m_freeLookAccumX + m_freeLookAccumY * m_freeLookAccumY;

        if (distSq >= maxSweep * maxSweep) {
            if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(6);
            m_freeLookAccumX = 0;
            m_freeLookAccumY = 0;
            if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchDown(6, cx, cy);
            emit touchInjected(6, cx, cy, true);
        } else {
            int tx = std::clamp(cx + m_freeLookAccumX, 0, m_screenWidth - 1);
            int ty = std::clamp(cy + m_freeLookAccumY, 0, m_screenHeight - 1);
            if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchMove(6, tx, ty);
            emit touchInjected(6, tx, ty, true);
        }
        return true;
    }

    // 3. Aim Lock (تبديل بالضغط)
    if (m_aimLockActive && m_activeAimIndex >= 0 && m_activeAimIndex < m_nodes.size()) {
        const auto &aim = m_nodes[m_activeAimIndex];
        int cx = static_cast<int>(aim.relX * m_screenWidth);
        int cy = static_cast<int>(aim.relY * m_screenHeight);

        qreal effDx = static_cast<qreal>(deltaX);
        qreal effDy = static_cast<qreal>(deltaY);

        if (aim.acceleration) {
            qreal speed = std::sqrt(effDx * effDx + effDy * effDy);
            qreal factor = 1.0 + qMin(speed * 0.02, 1.5);
            effDx *= factor;
            effDy *= factor;
        }

        m_aimSwipeAccumX += static_cast<int>(effDx * aim.sensitivityX);
        m_aimSwipeAccumY += static_cast<int>(effDy * aim.sensitivityY);

        const int maxSweepRadius = static_cast<int>(aim.radius > 10 ? aim.radius * 4.0 : 160);
        int distSq = m_aimSwipeAccumX * m_aimSwipeAccumX + m_aimSwipeAccumY * m_aimSwipeAccumY;

        if (distSq >= maxSweepRadius * maxSweepRadius) {
            if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(1);
            m_aimSwipeAccumX = 0;
            m_aimSwipeAccumY = 0;
            if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchDown(1, cx, cy);
            emit touchInjected(1, cx, cy, true);
        } else {
            int tx = std::clamp(cx + m_aimSwipeAccumX, 0, m_screenWidth - 1);
            int ty = std::clamp(cy + m_aimSwipeAccumY, 0, m_screenHeight - 1);
            if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchMove(1, tx, ty);
            emit touchInjected(1, tx, ty, true);
        }
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

bool InputTranslator::handleMousePress(Qt::MouseButton btn)
{
    if (btn == Qt::LeftButton && m_aimLockActive && m_activeAimIndex >= 0 && m_activeAimIndex < m_nodes.size()) {
        const auto &aim = m_nodes[m_activeAimIndex];
        if (!aim.enableFireButton) return false;
        m_firing = true;
        int fx = static_cast<int>(aim.fireRelX * m_screenWidth);
        int fy = static_cast<int>(aim.fireRelY * m_screenHeight);
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchDown(2, fx, fy);
        emit touchInjected(2, fx, fy, true);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool InputTranslator::handleMouseRelease(Qt::MouseButton btn)
{
    if (btn == Qt::LeftButton && m_firing) {
        m_firing = false;
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(2);
        emit touchInjected(2, 0, 0, false);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void InputTranslator::startBurstTap(const KeyBindingNode &node)
{
    if (m_burstTimers.contains(node.primaryScanCode)) return;

    int slot = -1;
    for (int s = 5; s < 10; ++s) {
        if (!m_scanToSlot.values().contains(s)) { slot = s; break; }
    }
    if (slot == -1) return;

    m_scanToSlot.insert(node.primaryScanCode, slot);
    const int px = static_cast<int>(node.relX * m_screenWidth);
    const int py = static_cast<int>(node.relY * m_screenHeight);

    // سرعة الضغط من 1 إلى 100 ضغطة في الثانية
    const int hz = qBound(1, node.burstHz, 100);
    const int intervalMs = qMax(10, 1000 / hz);

    // تنفيذ أول ضغطة فوراً دون انتظار
    if (m_bridge) {
        m_bridge->touchDown(slot, px, py);
        m_bridge->touchUp(slot);
    }
    emit touchInjected(slot, px, py, true);
    emit touchInjected(slot, 0, 0, false);

    QTimer *timer = new QTimer(this);
    timer->setInterval(intervalMs);

    const int capturedSlot = slot;
    connect(timer, &QTimer::timeout, this, [this, capturedSlot, px, py]() {
        if (m_bridge) {
            m_bridge->touchDown(capturedSlot, px, py);
            m_bridge->touchUp(capturedSlot);
        }
        emit touchInjected(capturedSlot, px, py, true);
        emit touchInjected(capturedSlot, 0, 0, false);
    });
    timer->start();
    m_burstTimers.insert(node.primaryScanCode, timer);
}

void InputTranslator::stopBurstTap(quint32 scanCode)
{
    if (QTimer *t = m_burstTimers.take(scanCode)) {
        t->stop();
        t->deleteLater();
    }
    if (m_scanToSlot.contains(scanCode)) {
        int slot = m_scanToSlot.take(scanCode);
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(slot);
        emit touchInjected(slot, 0, 0, false);
    }
}

void InputTranslator::startEdgeScroll(int dx, int dy, const KeyBindingNode &node)
{
    m_edgeScrollDirX = dx;
    m_edgeScrollDirY = dy;
    m_edgeScrollActive = true;

    const int cx = static_cast<int>(node.relX * m_screenWidth);
    const int cy = static_cast<int>(node.relY * m_screenHeight);
    if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchDown(9, cx, cy);

    m_edgeScrollTimer->start();
}

void InputTranslator::stopEdgeScroll()
{
    m_edgeScrollActive = false;
    m_edgeScrollTimer->stop();
    if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(9);
    emit touchInjected(9, 0, 0, false);
}

void InputTranslator::processEdgeScroll()
{
    if (!m_edgeScrollActive) { m_edgeScrollTimer->stop(); return; }

    qreal speed = 12.0;
    for (const auto &node : m_nodes) {
        if (node.type == KeyNodeType::EdgeScroll) { speed = node.edgeScrollSpeed; break; }
    }

    static int accumX = 0;
    static int accumY = 0;
    accumX += static_cast<int>(m_edgeScrollDirX * speed);
    accumY += static_cast<int>(m_edgeScrollDirY * speed);

    if (std::abs(accumX) > 200 || std::abs(accumY) > 200) {
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchUp(9);
        accumX = 0; accumY = 0;
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchDown(9, m_screenWidth / 2, m_screenHeight / 2);
    } else {
        int tx = m_screenWidth / 2 + accumX;
        int ty = m_screenHeight / 2 + accumY;
        if (m_bridge) m_bridge->touchMove(9, tx, ty);
        emit touchInjected(9, tx, ty, true);
    }
}

#include "Logger.h"
#include "PathResolver.h"

#include <QDir>
#include <QFileInfo>
#include <QTextStream>
#include <QThread>
#include <QStandardPaths>
#include <iostream>
#include <execinfo.h>
#include <cstdlib>

Logger &Logger::instance()
{
    static Logger s_instance;
    return s_instance;
}

Logger::Logger(QObject *parent)
    : QObject(parent)
{
    // XDG-compliant state directory via portable PathResolver: ~/.local/state/linStack
    QString stateDir = PathResolver::userStateDir();
    setLogFilePath(stateDir + "/linstack.log");
}

Logger::~Logger()
{
    QMutexLocker locker(&m_mutex);
    if (m_logFile.isOpen()) {
        m_logFile.close();
    }
}

void Logger::setLogFilePath(const QString &path)
{
    QMutexLocker locker(&m_mutex);
    if (m_logFile.isOpen()) {
        m_logFile.close();
    }

    m_logFilePath = path;
    QFileInfo fi(m_logFilePath);
    QDir().mkpath(fi.absolutePath());

    m_logFile.setFileName(m_logFilePath);
    if (!m_logFile.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Append | QIODevice::Text)) {
        // Fallback to /tmp if target directory is read-only or restricted
        QString fallbackPath = QString("/tmp/linstack_%1.log").arg(qgetenv("USER").isEmpty() ? "runtime" : QString::fromUtf8(qgetenv("USER")));
        m_logFilePath = fallbackPath;
        m_logFile.setFileName(m_logFilePath);
        if (!m_logFile.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Append | QIODevice::Text)) {
            std::cerr << "[Logger] Failed to open fallback log file: " << fallbackPath.toStdString() << std::endl;
        }
    }
}

QString Logger::levelToString(LogLevel level)
{
    switch (level) {
    case LogLevel::Info:          return "INFO";
    case LogLevel::Warning:       return "WARNING";
    case LogLevel::Fault:         return "FAULT";
    case LogLevel::CriticalFatal: return "CRITICAL_FATAL";
    }
    return "UNKNOWN";
}

void Logger::checkRotation()
{
    if (m_logFile.isOpen() && m_logFile.size() >= m_maxFileSize) {
        m_logFile.close();
        QString oldPath = m_logFilePath + ".old";
        QFile::remove(oldPath);
        QFile::rename(m_logFilePath, oldPath);
        if (!m_logFile.open(QIODevice::WriteOnly | QIODevice::Append | QIODevice::Text)) {
            std::cerr << "[Logger] Failed to reopen log file after rotation: " << m_logFilePath.toStdString() << std::endl;
        }
    }
}

void Logger::writeToFile(const QString &formattedLine)
{
    checkRotation();
    if (m_logFile.isOpen()) {
        QTextStream stream(&m_logFile);
        stream << formattedLine << "\n";
        stream.flush();
    }
}

void Logger::log(LogLevel level, const QString &category, const QString &message, const QString &details)
{
    QMutexLocker locker(&m_mutex);

    QString timestamp = QDateTime::currentDateTime().toString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.zzz");
    QString threadId = QString("0x%1").arg(reinterpret_cast<quintptr>(QThread::currentThreadId()), 0, 16);
    QString levelStr = levelToString(level);

    QString line = QString("[%1] [Thread %2] [%3] [%4] %5")
                       .arg(timestamp, threadId, levelStr, category, message);

    if (!details.isEmpty()) {
        line += QString(" | Details: %1").arg(details);
    }

    writeToFile(line);

    m_recentBuffer.append(line);
    while (m_recentBuffer.size() > m_maxBufferSize) {
        m_recentBuffer.removeFirst();
    }

    if (m_consoleEcho) {
        if (level == LogLevel::CriticalFatal || level == LogLevel::Fault) {
            std::cerr << line.toStdString() << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << line.toStdString() << std::endl;
        }
    }

    emit logAppended(line, level);
}

void Logger::logFault(const QString &category, const QString &errorCode, const QString &message, const QString &remediationHint)
{
    QString detailedMsg = QString("[%1] %2").arg(errorCode, message);
    if (!remediationHint.isEmpty()) {
        detailedMsg += QString(" (Remediation: %1)").arg(remediationHint);
    }
    log(LogLevel::Fault, category, detailedMsg);
}

void Logger::logCritical(const QString &category, const QString &message, bool captureTrace)
{
    QString fullMsg = message;
    if (captureTrace) {
        QString trace = captureStackTrace(20);
        fullMsg += QString("\n--- Stack Trace ---\n%1").arg(trace);
    }
    log(LogLevel::CriticalFatal, category, fullMsg);
}

void Logger::logSubprocess(const QString &command, int exitCode, const QString &stdoutStr, const QString &stderrStr)
{
    LogLevel lvl = (exitCode == 0) ? LogLevel::Info : LogLevel::Fault;
    QString summary = QString("Process '%1' exited with code %2").arg(command).arg(exitCode);

    QString details;
    if (!stdoutStr.trimmed().isEmpty()) {
        details += QString("STDOUT: %1").arg(stdoutStr.trimmed().left(500));
    }
    if (!stderrStr.trimmed().isEmpty()) {
        if (!details.isEmpty()) details += " | ";
        details += QString("STDERR: %1").arg(stderrStr.trimmed().left(500));
    }

    log(lvl, "Subprocess", summary, details);
}

QString Logger::captureStackTrace(int maxFrames)
{
    void *buffer[128];
    int frames = backtrace(buffer, qMin(maxFrames, 128));
    char **symbols = backtrace_symbols(buffer, frames);

    if (!symbols) {
        return "Unable to resolve stack symbols";
    }

    QStringList traceLines;
    for (int i = 0; i < frames; ++i) {
        traceLines.append(QString("#%1 %2").arg(i, 2, 10, QChar('0')).arg(symbols[i]));
    }
    free(symbols);

    return traceLines.join("\n");
}

QStringList Logger::recentLogs(int maxLines) const
{
    QMutexLocker locker(&m_mutex);
    if (maxLines <= 0 || maxLines >= m_recentBuffer.size()) {
        return m_recentBuffer;
    }
    return m_recentBuffer.mid(m_recentBuffer.size() - maxLines);
}

QString Logger::recentLogsText(int maxLines) const
{
    return recentLogs(maxLines).join("\n");
}

void Logger::clearRecentLogs()
{
    QMutexLocker locker(&m_mutex);
    m_recentBuffer.clear();
}

static void qtMessageOutput(QtMsgType type, const QMessageLogContext &context, const QString &msg)
{
    QString category = context.category ? QString::fromUtf8(context.category) : "Qt";
    LogLevel level = LogLevel::Info;

    switch (type) {
    case QtDebugMsg:
        level = LogLevel::Info;
        break;
    case QtInfoMsg:
        level = LogLevel::Info;
        break;
    case QtWarningMsg:
        level = LogLevel::Warning;
        break;
    case QtCriticalMsg:
        level = LogLevel::Fault;
        break;
    case QtFatalMsg:
        level = LogLevel::CriticalFatal;
        break;
    }

    Logger::instance().log(level, category, msg);
}

void Logger::installQtMessageHandler()
{
    qInstallMessageHandler(qtMessageOutput);
}

        "}"
        "QPushButton:pressed {"

        connect(btn, SIGNAL(clicked()), this, slot);

}

#ifndef UINPUTTOUCHBRIDGE_H
#define UINPUTTOUCHBRIDGE_H

#include <QString>
#include <QObject>

struct libevdev;
struct libevdev_uinput;

/**
 * @brief High-performance, low-latency multi-touch injection bridge using Linux uinput and libevdev.
 * Creates a virtual multi-touch device exposed to Linstack container (/dev/input/event*).
 */
class UInputTouchBridge : public QObject
{
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    explicit UInputTouchBridge(QObject *parent = nullptr);
    ~UInputTouchBridge() override;

    bool initialize(int screenWidth = 1920, int screenHeight = 1080);
    void closeDevice();

    bool isReady() const { return m_isReady; }
    bool isMockMode() const { return m_mockMode; }
    QString devicePath() const { return m_devicePath; }
    QString lastError() const { return m_lastError; }

    // Multi-touch slot injection (slots 0 to 9)
    void touchDown(int slot, int x, int y);
    void touchMove(int slot, int x, int y);
    void touchUp(int slot);
    void sendKeyEvent(unsigned int keyCode);
    void sync();

signals:
    void deviceCreated(const QString &devicePath);
    void errorOccurred(const QString &error);
    void touchEventInjected(int slot, int x, int y, bool isDown);

private:
    void emitEvent(unsigned int type, unsigned int code, int value);

    struct libevdev *m_dev = nullptr;
    struct libevdev_uinput *m_uinputDev = nullptr;
    int m_fd = -1;

    int m_screenWidth = 1920;
    int m_screenHeight = 1080;
    static constexpr int MAX_SLOTS = 10;

    struct SlotState {
        bool active = false;
        int x = 0;
        int y = 0;
        int trackingId = -1;
    };
    SlotState m_slots[MAX_SLOTS];
    int m_nextTrackingId = 1;

    bool m_isReady = false;
    bool m_mockMode = false;
    QString m_devicePath;
    QString m_lastError;
};

#endif // UINPUTTOUCHBRIDGE_H

    Logger::instance().log(LogLevel::Info, category, msg)

    Logger::instance().log(LogLevel::Warning, category, msg)

    Logger::instance().logFault(category, code, msg, hint)

#ifndef LINSTACKSERVICE_H
#define LINSTACKSERVICE_H

#include <QObject>
#include <QProcess>
#include <QTcpSocket>
#include <QTimer>
#include <QString>
#include <QStringList>
#include <QMap>

/**
 * @brief Diagnostic report for Linux kernel and subsystem readiness for Linstack.
 */
struct KernelDiagnostic {
    bool binderFound = false;
    bool binderfsMounted = false;
    bool vndbinderFound = false;
    bool hwbinderFound = false;
    bool ashmemOrMemfdFound = false;
    bool systemdActive = false;
    bool linstackInstalled = false;
    bool adbInstalled = false;

    QString summary;
    QStringList issues;
    QStringList remediationCommands;

    bool isReady() const {
        return (binderFound || binderfsMounted) && linstackInstalled;
    }
};

/**
 * @brief Predefined device spoofing profile for unlocking 90/120/144 FPS in games.
 */
struct DeviceProfileInfo {
    QString displayName;
    QString manufacturer;
    QString brand;
    QString model;
    QString device;
    QString fingerprint;
    int maxSupportedFps = 120;
};

/**
 * @brief High-performance background service managing Linstack, linstack-scripts, and ADB socket integration.
 */
class LinstackService : public QObject
{
    Q_OBJECT

public:
    enum class ContainerState {
        Stopped,
        Starting,
        Running,
        Stopping,
        Failed
    };
    Q_ENUM(ContainerState)

    enum class SessionState {
        Idle,
        Starting,
        Active,
        Stopping,
        Terminated,
        Failed
    };
    Q_ENUM(SessionState)

    enum class ServiceError {
        NoError,
        KernelBinderMissing,
        BinderfsNotMounted,
        SystemdServiceFailed,
        LinstackSessionFailed,
        LinstackScriptsNotFound,
        PythonScriptExecutionFailed,
        AdbConnectionRefused,
        AdbInstallFailed,
        PermissionDenied
    };
    Q_ENUM(ServiceError)

    explicit LinstackService(QObject *parent = nullptr);
    ~LinstackService() override;

    // --- Pre-flight Kernel & Environment Diagnostics ---
    KernelDiagnostic runKernelDiagnostics();

    // --- Container Lifecycle (systemctl / linstack container) ---
    void startContainerService();
    void stopContainerService();
    void restartContainerService();
    ContainerState containerState() const { return m_containerState; }

    // --- Session Lifecycle (linstack session start/stop) ---
    void setDesiredResolution(int width, int height) { m_desiredWidth = width; m_desiredHeight = height; }
    int desiredWidth() const { return m_desiredWidth; }
    int desiredHeight() const { return m_desiredHeight; }
    void startSession();
    void stopSession();
    void launchFullUi();
    bool isSessionRunning() const;
    bool isSessionActive() const { return m_sessionState == SessionState::Active; }
    SessionState sessionState() const { return m_sessionState; }
    void setHasFirstFrame(bool hasFrame);
    bool hasFirstFrame() const { return m_hasFirstFrame; }

    // --- LinStack_Scripts Integration ---
    void setScriptsPath(const QString &path);
    QString scriptsPath() const { return m_scriptsPath; }
    bool isScriptsInstalled() const;
    void installScriptsEnvironment();

    void installGApps();
    void installLibndk();
    void installLibhoudini();

    QList<DeviceProfileInfo> predefinedProfiles() const;
    void applyDeviceProfile(const DeviceProfileInfo &profile);
    void applyDeviceProfileByName(const QString &profileName);

    // --- ADB Socket Connection & APK Installation (127.0.0.1:5555) ---
    bool isAdbConnected() const { return m_adbConnected; }
    void checkAdbConnection();
    void installApk(const QString &apkFilePath);
    void sendAndroidKeyEvent(int androidKeyCode);

    // --- Status Query ---
    void refreshStatus();

signals:
    // Status signals
    void containerStateChanged(LinstackService::ContainerState state);
    void sessionStateChanged(LinstackService::SessionState state);
    void adbConnectionStatusChanged(bool connected);
    void waylandCompositorRestartRequested();

    // Error & Diagnostics
    void errorOccurred(LinstackService::ServiceError error, const QString &message, const QStringList &remediation);
    void diagnosticFinished(const KernelDiagnostic &diagnostic);

    // Logging & Console Output
    void logMessage(const QString &category, const QString &message);

    // Script Operations
    void scriptOperationStarted(const QString &operation);
    void scriptOperationProgress(const QString &operation, int percent, const QString &statusText);
    void scriptOperationFinished(const QString &operation, bool success, const QString &details);

    // APK Installation
    void apkInstallStarted(const QString &apkPath);
    void apkInstallProgress(const QString &apkPath, int percent, const QString &status);
    void apkInstallFinished(const QString &apkPath, bool success, const QString &message);

private slots:
    void handleSessionProcessFinished(int exitCode, QProcess::ExitStatus exitStatus);
    void handleSessionProcessError(QProcess::ProcessError error);
    void handleSessionStdout();
    void handleSessionStderr();
    void checkSessionStartupStatus();
    void retryFullUi();

    void handleAdbSocketConnected();
    void handleAdbSocketError();

private:
    void setContainerState(ContainerState state);
    void setSessionState(SessionState state);
    void executeScriptCommand(const QString &operationName, const QStringList &scriptArgs);
    void executeInstallProcess(const QString &apkPath);
    void executeAdbInstallProcess(const QString &apkPath) { executeInstallProcess(apkPath); }
    QString findPythonInterpreter() const;

    ContainerState m_containerState = ContainerState::Stopped;
    SessionState m_sessionState = SessionState::Idle;

    // Active long-running session process
    QProcess *m_sessionProcess = nullptr;
    QProcess *m_uiProcess = nullptr;
    QTimer *m_sessionPollTimer = nullptr;
    QTimer *m_uiRetryTimer = nullptr;
    int m_sessionPollCount = 0;
    int m_uiRetryCount = 0;
    bool m_hasFirstFrame = false;
    bool m_isStopping = false;
    bool m_wasAlreadyRunning = false;

    // Active script operation process

    QProcess *m_scriptProcess = nullptr;
    QString m_activeScriptOp;

    // ADB Socket client & poller
    QTcpSocket *m_adbSocket = nullptr;
    QTimer *m_adbPollTimer = nullptr;
    QTimer *m_statusPollTimer = nullptr;
    bool m_adbConnected = false;

    // Active APK install processes queue
    struct ApkInstallJob {
        QString apkPath;
        QProcess *process;
    };
    QList<ApkInstallJob> m_activeInstalls;

    QString m_scriptsPath;
    QMap<QString, DeviceProfileInfo> m_profiles;

    int m_desiredWidth = 1920;
    int m_desiredHeight = 1080;
};

#endif // LINSTACKSERVICE_H

--- FILE: ./LinStack/src/PathResolver.h ---
#ifndef PATHRESOLVER_H
#define PATHRESOLVER_H

#include <QString>
#include <QStringList>
#include <QProcess>

class PathResolver
{
public:
    // Resolves a resource file path (e.g., "system.img", "vendor.img", or "resources/system.img").
    // Priority order:
    //   1. Relative to executable / project root (appDirPath, appDirPath/.., etc.)
    //   2. Relative to current working directory
    //   3. Standard system installation directories (/usr/share/linstack/resources, etc.)
    static QString resolveResource(const QString &fileName);

    // Returns the directory where system.img / vendor.img reside
    static QString resolveResourcesDir();

    // Resolves the linstack executable or script path:
    // Priority order:
    //   1. Local project/portable script: LinStack_core/linstack.py, ../LinStack_core/linstack.py, ./linstack
    //   2. Standard system install: /usr/bin/linstack, /usr/local/bin/linstack, PATH
    static QString resolveLinstackExecutable();

    // Resolves python3 executable
    static QString resolvePython3();

    // Resolves command & arguments for executing linstack (handles python3 invocation for .py scripts)
    static QString resolveLinstackCommand(QStringList &args);

    // Configures a QProcess instance to run linstack with proper executable, args, and PYTHONPATH
    static void configureProcess(QProcess *proc, const QStringList &args);

    // Helper to synchronously execute linstack
    static int executeLinstack(const QStringList &args, int timeoutMs = 1500);

    // Helper to start detached linstack
    static bool startDetachedLinstack(const QStringList &args);

    // Resolves tools directory
    static QString resolveToolsDir();

    // Resolves core source directory (where LinStack_core/Makefile lives)
    static QString resolveCoreDir();

    // Standard XDG directories
    static QString userDataDir();
    static QString userStateDir();
};

#endif // PATHRESOLVER_H

    : QDialog(parent)
{
    setWindowFlags(Qt::Dialog | Qt::FramelessWindowHint);
    setAttribute(Qt::WA_TranslucentBackground, false);
    setStyleSheet(Theme::cyberEmeraldStyleSheet());

    resize(780, 560);

InitializationDialog::~InitializationDialog()
{
    if (m_process && m_process->state() != QProcess::NotRunning) {
        m_process->kill();
        m_process->waitForFinished(500);
    }
}

QString InitializationDialog::systemImageUrl() const
